english_translation: So do you see laat / would be / ifs & buts and uzza / honour.
And manaat / longing third of the other?
Do you see who takes his own hawa / desire as god. What, would you be an advocate over him?
Do you call baal / husband and you leave the best of the creators.
And they planned a great plan.
And they said, dont leave your gods and do not leave wadda / love and not soowa / time / hour and not yaghoos / seek aid and not yaooq / delays and not nasr / vulture.
And when Ibraheem said to his father Aazar, do you take beloved idols as gods, surely I see you and your people in clear straying.
He said, do you serve what you have carved?

And he said, surely you have taken idolatry / idols other than Allah out of mutual love between yourselves in the life then on the day of judgement you shall reject some of you with some, and curse some of you of some. And your abode is the fire, and for you there will be no one from the helpers.
And by Allah, I will machinate / devise artfully to your idols after you turn your backs.
So he dodged towards their gods, then said, do you not eat?
What is the matter with you that you do not speak logically.
Then he dodged over them, striking with the right / correct.
So he made them chips / small pieces except Great One for them, so that they turn towards Him.
They said, who has done this with our gods, surely he must be from the oppressors.
They said, We have listened a young man mentioning them, for him they say Ibraheem (pbuh).
They said, Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may bear witness.
They said, are you the one who has done this with our gods, 'O' Ibraheem (pbuh)?
He said, but He has done it, This is their Great One, So ask / question them if they are logical.
So they turned towards their souls / selves / psyches and said, surely you, you are the oppressors.
Then they were turned upside down over their heads (and said) “Without doubt you knew that these (idols / gods) cannot be logical.
He (Ibraheem pbuh) said, do you then serve besides Allah that they can neither be of any advantage to you nor they do any harm to you in anything.
Word of contempt / dishonour for you, and for what you serve besides Allah. Then will you not use intellect?
What! For you, the masculine / male, and for Him the feminine / female.
Then it is, an unfair / unjust division.

They are not except names you have named them, you and your fathers, Allah has not sent down with them from the authority. They follow nothing except conjecture and what the souls / selves desire, and without doubt the guidance has come to them from their Lord.
It is not for a human that Allah speaks to him, except by inspiration or from behind a veil or He sends a messenger, then he inspires with His permission whatever He wills. Surely He is High, Wise.

And likewise from Our order We have inspired rooh / spirit towards you. You did not have the perception what was the Book and the belief, but We have made it (rooh / spirit) a light, We guide from Our servants with it (rooh / spirit) to whom We will. And surely you guide towards the straight path.
Surely We have revealed the zikr / remembrance and surely We are the preservers of it.

Say what thing is greatest evidence, say Allah is a witness between me and you and this Quran is inspired to me to warn all of you with it and to whom it is delivered. Do you surely bear witness that with Allah there are other gods? Say I do not bear witness. Say surely He is one God and surely I am exempted from what you associate (i.e. to give partners to Him).

And when Moosa (pbuh) said to his people, O’ my people, why do you hurt me? And without doubt you know that I am the messenger of Allah to you. So when they deviated, Allah deviated their hearts. And Allah does not guide the people who are fasiqeen / liberals.

And when Essa / Jesus the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) said, O’ children of Israel, surely I am a messenger of Allah to you, confirming what is between my two hands from At-Taurah / the law and giving you the good news with the messenger who will come after me whose name will be Ahmed / most praiseworthy. So when he came to them with clarifications they said, this is a clear magic.

O’ you who believe! Obey Allah and obey the messenger and obey the one who gives the order from you. So if you have dispute in anything, so return it to Allah and the messenger if you believe with Allah and the last day. That is better and the most beautiful interpretation.

Surely We have revealed At-Taurah / the law (i.e. hukum / the government of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs) in it is guidance and light, an-nabeeyoon / the prophets who submitted govern with it for those who are hadoo / jews and rabba-neeoon / the lords and ahbar / the scholars (govern with it), with what they were required to become the hafiz / those who memorize from the book of Allah, and they are witness over it. Then fear not mankind and fear Me and do not purchase My ayaat / signs with a little price. And who does not govern with what Allah has revealed, then they are kafiroon / rejecters.
And for Allah are the beautiful names so call Him with them, and leave those who use profanity / disrespect in His names, soon they will be giving penalty for what they are doing.
He is Allah, there is no god except Him. Knower of the absent and the evident. He is the most Gracious, most Merciful.
He is Allah, there is no god except Him. The King, The Holy One, The Peace, The Believer, The Guard, The Powerful, The Forceful, The Greatened. Glory to Allah, about what they associate.
He is Allah, The Creator, The Evolver, The Former / Shaper. For Him are the beautiful names. Whatever is in the skies and in the earth glorifies Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

Allah there is no god except Him. The Living, the ever Established. No slumber / drowsiness can seize Him nor sleep. Whatever is in the skies and in the earth is for Him. Who is there that can intercede in His presence except by His permission? He knows what is in front of them and behind them. And nor shall they encompass of His knowledge except with what He wills. His throne extends over the skies and the earth and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving both of them, And He is the High, the Supreme.

O’ mankind! If you are in doubt about the resurrection, so surely We have created you from dust, then from a sperm, then from a leech, then from created chewed form and other than created (chewed form), So that We clarify for you. And We cause whom We will to rest in the wombs for a stated term, then We bring you out as an infant (child), then you reach your age of full strength. And some of you are completed and some are sent back to the weakest / lowest age, so that they know nothing after having known.
And you see the earth extinguished / died out. So when We sent down rain on it, it is stirred / moved and it swelled / increased and grows from every delightful pair.
Do not the rejecters see that the skies and the earth were joined together, so We split both of them asunder. And We made every living thing from water. Then will they not then believe?
And if you are in doubt as to what We have revealed on Our servant, then come with a surah / chapter like it and call your witnesses besides Allah if you are truthful.
So if you cannot do it and you will never be able to do it then fear the fire whose fuel are people and stones which is prepared for the rejecters.
No sights can comprehend Him, and He comprehends the sights. And He is Fine, the Acquainted.

Without doubt come to you, from your Lord insights. If any one sees, it is for his own soul / self / psyche, and if anyone is blind, so it is over his own soul / self / psyche. And I am not a preserver over you.
Say, if you love Allah, then follow me, Allah will love you and forgive you your sins, and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Say, obey Allah and the messenger. Then if they turn back, then surely Allah does not love the rejecters.
Has he made the gods into one God? Surely this is an amazing thing.
And the chiefs separated from them that you walk away, (saying) have patience over your gods, Surely this is a thing being intended.
We have never heard of this in the other religion. This is nothing except a made up creation / invention.
And when Ibraheem (pbuh) said, O’ my Lord, make this city of peace and security, and keep me and my sons strangers to the serving of idols.
My Lord, Surely they have led astray majority from the people. He who follows me is surely of me. And who disobeys me, so surely You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
And from His ayaat / signs is the creation of the skies and the earth, and the difference of your languages and colours. Surely in that are ayaat / signs for those who know.

So when you completed your places of reclusions (Mina, Arafat & Muzdalifah) then remember Allah like you remember your fathers / ancestors or more stronger in remembrance. Then from the mankind who says O’ our Lord give us in the world, and there is nothing in the hereafter for him from the share.
When your Lord said for the angels surely I am the Creator of a human being from clay.
When I have made him even and breathed into him from My spirit, then fall down prostrating for him.
So the angels prostrated, all of them together.
Except iblees / devil who sought greatness and became from the rejecters.
He said, O' iblees / devil, what prevented you to prostrate for what I have created with My both hands. Did you seek greatness or are you from the higher class?
He (iblees / devil) said I am the better one from him. You created me from fire and You created him from clay.

He (iblees) said, do You see this is the one You have honored over me? Definitely if You will give me respite towards the day of judgement I will definitely make him and his descendants worldly experienced except a few.
He (Allah) said go away whosoever follows you from them, surely, hell is your reward an abundant reward.

And you can stir up / excite with your voice / sound effects whosoever is obedient from them and import on them with your thought and your masculine manners and be their partner in wealth and children and promise them. And shaitaan / satan promises them nothing except delusion.
Surely My servants over them, you will never have any authority and sufficient advocate is with your Lord.
He (iblees) said so with what You have tempted me, definitely I will sit on Your straight path for them.
Then definitely I will come to them from their front and from their behind and about their right and about their left and you will not find the majority of them thankful.
He (iblees) said, My Lord! With what You have tempted me, definitely I will decorate in the earth for them and definitely tempt them together.
Except Your sincere servants from them.

And definitely I will lead them astray, and definitely I will make them wishful and I will order them so definitely they will cut off the ears of cattle and I will order them so definitely they will alter the creation of Allah. And who takes the satan a protector from other than Allah then without doubt he is at loss, a clear loss.
And people follow what shayateen / satan recited over the kingdom of Sulaiman. And Sulaiman did not reject but the shayateen / satans rejected and taught mankind magic.
The works of shaitaan / satan are intoxicants / gambling stones / statues and arrows.
Shaitaan / satan promises you of poverty and orders you with fahisha / adultery / fornication / homosexuality / lesbianism.
Shaitaan / satan has touched him to madness who will eat riba / increase.
Shaitaan / satan's brothers are spendthrifts.
Shaitaan / satan suggests to fear from his protectors.
Shaitaan / satan inspires their protectors to argue with you.
Shaitaan / satan causes grief to believers from secret consultations.
Shaitaan / satan intends to create enmity / hatred amongst you from intoxicants and gambling, and opposition about rememberance of Allah and salaah / prayers.
Shaitaan / satan dominated them so he has made them forget the remembrance of Allah.
And O' Adam, you and your pair stay in the garden then both of you eat from wherever you wish and both of you do not go near this tree so you will become from the oppressors.

O' mankind! Surely We have created you from a male and a female and We made you shuoob / nations (i.e. aggregate of persons of the same territory and language) kabail / tribes (i.e aggregate of people united by ties of common descent, ancestry, customs / culture and traditions) so that you recognize each other. Surely the most honorable in the nearness of Allah is the one who mostly take guard (of Allah). Surely Allah is the Knowledgeable, well Acquainted.
Do you not see how Allah strikes an example of a good word is like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed, and its branches (reach) in the sky.
It brings forth its fruit at all times, with the permission of her Lord. And Allah strikes an examples for mankind so that they may remember
And the example of an evil word is like an evil tree, It is torn up by the root from the surface of the earth, it has no stability.
Allah will steadfast those who believe with the steady word in the life of the world and in the hereafter. And Allah astrays the oppressors and Allah does what He wants.
Surely you are not to be hungry and naked in it.
And surely, you are neither to be thirsty nor you become victim in it.
So shaitaan / satan whispered to him saying, O' Adam, do I give you the evidence over the tree of eternity and the kingdom that does not decay.

Then shaitaan / satan whispered for both of them so that he made for both of them evident from their ills / badness / hurts which were behind them and said, that your Lord has forbidden both of you from this tree except that both of you become angels or both of you become from the eternal ones.
And he divided both of them, surely I am from the advisers for both of you.

Then with delusion he made evident to both of them, when both of them tasted the tree then their ills appeared to both of them, and both of them began to sew the leaves from the garden over both of them. And their Lord called both of them, did I not forbid both of you about that tree and I said to both of you surely the shaitaan / satan is a clear enemy for both of you.
And without doubt iblees / devil made true his conjecture over them, so they followed him except a division from the believers.
And without doubt We covenanted to Adam from before, then he forgot and We did not find firmness for him.
And remember Our servant Ayub, when he called to his Lord that shaitaan / satan has touched me with a portion and punishment.
Race with your masculine manners, this is the cool bath and drink.
And We granted for him his people and with them their example a mercy from Us and remembrance for those who have understanding.
And take the chimera with your hand then strike with it, and you do not perjure. Surely We found him patient, blessed is Our servant surely he did return.

And We have not sent from before you a messenger nor a prophet except when he wishes, shaitaan / satan encounters in his wish. So Allah cancels what shaitaan / satan then Allah governs His ayaat / signs. And Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise.

And likewise, We have made for every prophet the shayateen / satans of the mankind and of the jinn the enemy. They inspire the golden deluding some of them towards some. And if your Lord have willed they would not have done it, so leave them and what they have invented.
Shall I give you the news on whom the shayateen / satans descend?
They descend on every lying, wicked person.
They encounter the listening and the majority of them are liars.
And (on) the poets, who follow their tempters.
And shayateen / satans have not descended with it.
And it is not desirable for them and they do not have capacity.
They are definitely isolated about the listening.
Surely this is the saying of an honorable messenger.
And it is not with the saying of shaitaan / satan stoned.
Then where are you going?
It is nothing except the remembrance for the worlds.
And whosoever is dim-sighted about the remembrance of the most Gracious, We barter for him a shaitaan / satan so he will be connected for him.
And surely, they definitely will oppose them about the way and they calculate that they are the guided ones.
So when you read the Quran then seek Allah's protection from the shaitaan / satan the stoned.
Surely he has no authority over those who believe and over those who put their trust over their Lord.
Surely he has an authority over those who make him a protector and those who associate with Him.
And if you are incited from the shaitaan / satan to incitement so seek refuge with Allah. Surely He is Listener, Knowledgeable
Surely those who take guard when they are encircled from the touch of shaitaan / satan so they are those who have sight.
And their brothers expand them in the wrong then they do not relax.
Repel the ills with that which is good. We know very well with what they describe.
And say my Lord, I seek refuge with You from the spurs of shayateen / satans.
And I seek refuge with You my Lord, that they attend me.
And the day the sky is split up with clouds and the angels are sent down descending.
That day, the kingdom of truth, shall be for the most Gracious! and the day will become very difficult over the rejecters.

And the shaitaan / satan says when the order is complete, surely Allah promised you the promise of truth and I promised you, then I opposed you and it was not for me from any authority over you except to call you, so you answered me, so you do not blame me and blame your souls / selves / psyches. I am not with your screams and you are not with my screams. Surely I reject with what you have been re Surely a grievous punishment is for the oppressors.
Did I not covenant to you, O' children of Adam, that you will not serve the shaitaan / satan, surely he is a clear enemy for you.
And that to serve Me, this is the straight path.
And without doubt he led astray the major temperament from you. So do you not understand.
This is the hell that you were promised.
And that day the oppressor will bite over his hand and will say O' alas! I wish I should have taken the way along with the messenger.
O' alas! I wish I would not have taken so and so as a friend.
Without doubt he has led me astray about the remembrance after it came to me and the shaitaan / satan is a forsaker for man.
And Ayub, when he called his Lord that distress has touched me and You are the most Merciful of those who are merciful.
They both said, O' our Lord! we have oppressed our souls / selves / psyches and if You did not forgive for us and have mercy on us, definitely we will be from the losers.

Then with delusion he made evident to both of them, when both of them tasted the tree then their ills appeared to both of them, and both of them began to sew the leaves from the garden over both of them. And their Lord called both of them, did I not forbid both of you about that tree and I said to both of you surely the shaitaan / satan is a clear enemy for both of you.
Surely you are not to be hungry and naked in it.
And surely, you are neither to be thirsty nor you become victim in it.
He said all of you get down all together from it (garden). So whenever a guidance comes to you from Me, so whosoever follows My guidance so no fear over them and they will not grieve.

And near Him are the keys of the absent, none knows it except Him. And He knows what is in the land and the sea. And a leaf does not fall except He knows it and nor the grain in the darkness of the earth and neither the wet and nor the dry except in a clear book.

And likewise We appointed them so that they question between themselves. From them the speaker said, How long you have stayed, They said, we have stayed a day, or part of a day. They said your Lord knows more with what (number) you stayed. Then appoint one of you with this your leaf paper money towards Al-Madina / The city. So he should view which is justified food. Then he will come with sustenance to you from it (city). And he should be courteous / well mannered. And definitely he should not make anyone aware / conscious with you.
And when We said for the angels, prostrate for Adam and they prostrated except Iblees. He refused and sought greatness. And he became from the rejecters.

And when We said for the angels, prostrate for Adam and they prostrated except iblees. He (Iblees) became from the jinn / shielded ones so he took liberty about the order of his Lord. So will you take him and his offspring protectors besides Me. And they are enemy for you. Bad is the substitution for the oppressors.
And He created jinns from corals from fire.
And the jinns / shielded ones We have created from before, from the porous fire.
I did not make them witness on the creation of the skies and the earth, and nor on the creation of their own souls / selves / psyches. And I was not taking the support of those who astray.

Our Lord, appoint in them a messenger from them who recites Your ayaat / signs over them and who gives the knowledge of Al-Kitab / The Book and Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom and justify them. Surely your Lord is the Mighty, the Wise.
Shall I give you the prophecy on whom the shayateen / satans descend?
They descend on every lying, wicked person.
They encounter the listening and the majority of them are liars.
And (on) the poets, who follow their tempters.
Did you not see them wandering distracted in every valley?
And that they say what they do not practice.
Except those who believe and correct their deeds and remember Allah much and defend themselves after they are oppressed. And soon those who are oppressed will know what turn their affairs will take.

arabic_text: وَإِذِ ابْتَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ رَبُّهُ بِكَلِمَاتٍ فَأَتَمَّهُنَّ قَالَ إِنِّي جَاعِلُكَ لِلنَّاسِ إِمَامًا قَالَ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي قَالَ لَا يَنَالُ عَهْدِي الظَّالِمِينَ
english_translation: And when his Lord put Ibraheem (pbuh) to trial with words, then he completed them. He said, surely I am making you Imam / Leader for mankind. He said, and from my offsprings? He said, My promise will not reach the oppressors.

arabic_text: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
english_translation: O' my Lord, grant for me from those who correct.

arabic_text: فَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِغُلَامٍ حَلِيمٍ
english_translation: So We gave him good news of a tolerant / forbearing boy.

arabic_text: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَبِيًّا
english_translation: And remember Ismael (pbuh) in The Book, surely he was truthful of the promise and he was a messenger, prophet.

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْيَ قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّي أَرَى فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَى قَالَ يَا أَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ
english_translation: So when he reached to make an effort / endeavor with him, he said, O' my son, surely I saw in the sleep that I am slaughtering you, so view it, what you see? He said, O' my father, do what you are being ordered. Soon you will find me, if Allah wills, from those who have patience.

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ
english_translation: When both of them submitted, and he (Ibraheem pbuh) elevated him (Ismaeel pbuh) for the front.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ جَعَلْنَا الْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَأَمْنًا وَاتَّخِذُوا مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى وَعَهِدْنَا إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ أَنْ طَهِّرَا بَيْتِيَ لِلطَّائِفِينَ وَالْعَاكِفِينَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ
english_translation: And when We made the house a place of reward and safety / security for people. And you take the place of salah / prayer from the standing position of Ibraheem (pbuh). And We took a covenant towards Ibraheem (pbuh) and Ismaeel (pbuh) that both of you should purify My house for those who make rounds and those who intent upon and those who bow, prostrate.

arabic_text: لَقَدْ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ الرُّؤْيَا بِالْحَقِّ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ آمِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا فَجَعَلَ مِنْ دُونِ ذَلِكَ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا
english_translation: Without doubt Allah made true the vision of His messenger with the truth. If Allah wills definitely you will enter the sacred / forbidden mosque in security, your heads shaved and (salah / prayer) curtailed / shortened. You will not fear. So He knew what you did not know then He made besides that a near / close opening.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ يَرْفَعُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ الْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
english_translation: And when Ibraheem (pbuh) and Ismaeel (pbuh) raised the foundations / principles from "The House"; our Lord, accept (the sacrifice) from both of us. Surely You are the Listener, the Knowledgeable.

arabic_text: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُسْلِمَةً لَكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
english_translation: O' our Lord and make both of us muslims / submitters for You and from our offsprings a muslim / submitter nation for You. And show us our places of reclusion and turn upon us. Surely You are the Acceptor of repentance, the Merciful.

arabic_text: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
english_translation: O' My Lord, make me one who establishes salah / prayer, and also from my offsprings, our Lord, and You accept my call.

arabic_text: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
english_translation: O' our Lord, have forgiveness for me and for my parents and for the believers when the day of account is established.

arabic_text: رَبَّنَا وَابْعَثْ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْهُمْ يَتْلُو عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتِكَ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
english_translation: O' our Lord, appoint in them a messenger from them who recites Your ayaat / signs on them and he teaches them The Book and The Wisdom and justify them. Surely You are the Mighty, the Wise.

arabic_text: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ أَنْ يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ
english_translation: And We called him that O' Ibraheem (pbuh).

arabic_text: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ الرُّؤْيَا إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
english_translation: Without doubt you have made the vision true. Surely like that We reward those who are good doers.

arabic_text: إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْبَلَاؤُ الْمُبِينُ
english_translation: Surely this is definitely the clear trial.

arabic_text: وَفَدَيْنَاهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
english_translation: And We redeemed him with a great sacrifice.

arabic_text: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُمْ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لِيَفْتَدُوا بِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ مَا تُقُبِّلَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
english_translation: Surely those who reject, if they had everything what is in the earth and the like of it with it that they redeem with it from the punishment of the day of judgement, it would not be accepted from them. And for them is a painful punishment.

arabic_text: وَكَذَلِكَ زَيَّنَ لِكَثِيرٍ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ قَتْلَ أَوْلَادِهِمْ شُرَكَاؤُهُمْ لِيُرْدُوهُمْ وَلِيَلْبِسُوا عَلَيْهِمْ دِينَهُمْ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا فَعَلُوهُ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ
english_translation: And like that their associators have adorned the killing of their children for many of those who associate, to destroy them and to clothe their judgment on them. And if Allah had willed they would have not done it. So leave them and what they are inventing.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِالنَّاسِ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا الرُّؤْيَا الَّتِي أَرَيْنَاكَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَالشَّجَرَةَ الْمَلْعُونَةَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا طُغْيَانًا كَبِيرًا
english_translation: And when We said to you, surely your Lord encompasses mankind. And We did not make the vision / dream that We showed you except a fitna / captivation / fascination for mankind and the cursed tree in the Quran. And We frighten them. Then it does not increase them except in great tyranny / unjust harshness.

arabic_text: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَفَرْعُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ
english_translation: Do you not see how Allah strikes an example of a good word is like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed, and it's branch in the sky.

arabic_text: تُؤْتِي أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
english_translation: It brings forth its fruit at all times, with the permission of her Lord. And Allah strikes examples for mankind so that they may remember.

arabic_text: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ اجْتُثَّتْ مِنْ فَوْقِ الْأَرْضِ مَا لَهَا مِنْ قَرَارٍ
english_translation: And the example of an evil word is like an evil tree, it is uprooted from the surface of the earth, it has no stability.

arabic_text: يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ وَيُضِلُّ اللَّهُ الظَّالِمِينَ وَيَفْعَلُ اللَّهُ مَا يَشَاءُ
english_translation: Allah will steadfast those who believe with the steady word in the life of the world and in the hereafter. And Allah astrays the oppressors and Allah does what He wants.

arabic_text: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ
english_translation: And We left on him in the others / last.

arabic_text: سَلَامٌ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ
english_translation: Salam / peace be upon Ibraheem (pbuh).

arabic_text: كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
english_translation: Like that We reward the good doers.

arabic_text: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
english_translation: Surely he was from Our believing servants.

arabic_text: وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ نَبِيًّا مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
english_translation: And We gave him (Ibraheem pbuh) the good news with Ishaq (pbuh), a prophet from those who correct.

arabic_text: قَالَ أَبَشَرْتُمُونِي عَلَى أَنْ مَسَّنِيَ الْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
english_translation: He said, do you give me good news over that old age has touched me, so on what you give good news?

arabic_text: وَامْرَأَتُهُ قَائِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَاهَا بِإِسْحَاقَ وَمِنْ وَرَاءِ إِسْحَاقَ يَعْقُوبَ
english_translation: And his wife was standing so she laughed then We gave her the good news with Is'haq (pbuh) and from the back of Is'haq (pbuh), Yaqoob (pbuh).

arabic_text: قَالَتْ يَا وَيْلَتَى أَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا عَجُوزٌ وَهَذَا بَعْلِي شَيْخًا إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
english_translation: She said, O' alas! Do I give birth? And I am incapable old, and this husband of mine is old. Surely this is an amazing thing.

arabic_text: قَالُوا أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ رَحْمَتُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ إِنَّهُ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
english_translation: They said, are you amazed from the order of Allah, the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of The House. Surely, He is Praiseworthy, Glorious.

arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي وَهَبَ لِي عَلَى الْكِبَرِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَسَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
english_translation: Praise be to Allah who has granted me over old age, Ismaeel (pbuh) and Is'haq (pbuh). Surely, my Lord is the Listener of the calls.

arabic_text: رَبَّنَا إِنِّى أَسْكَنْتُ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِي زَرْعٍ عِنْدَ بَيْتِكَ الْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ فَاجْعَلْ أَفْئِدَةً مِنَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِي إِلَيْهِمْ وَارْزُقْهُمْ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ
english_translation: O' our Lord! I have settled from my offsprings with a valley without cultivation, near Your sacred house, O' our Lord, that they establish salah / prayer, then make the hearts of mankind desirous towards them and give them sustenance from the fruits so that they may give thanks.

arabic_text: وَجَاهِدُوا فِي اللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ هُوَ اجْتَبَاكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ مِلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ هُوَ سَمَّاكُمُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَفِي هَذَا لِيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِاللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَاكُمْ فَنِعْمَ الْمَوْلَى وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ
english_translation: And you strive in Allah as the right of His strive. He has chosen you and He has made no difficulty over you in deen / the judgement. The millah / religion of your father / ancestor Ibraheem (pbuh). And He has named you (all) muslimeen / submitters from before and in this, so that the messenger becomes a witness over you and you become witnesses over mankind. Then establish salah / prayer and give zakah / justification and hold fast with Allah. He is your Protector, then blessed protector and the blessed Helper.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا كُونُوا هُودًا أَوْ نَصَارَى تَهْتَدُوا قُلْ بَلْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
english_translation: And they say, become hood / lenient / jews or nasara / helpers / christians you will be guided. Say, but the millah / religion of true Ibraheem (pbuh) and he was not from those who associates.

arabic_text: أَمْ تَقُولُونَ إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَالْأَسْبَاطَ كَانُوا هُودًا أَوْ نَصَارَى قُلْ أَأَنْتُمْ أَعْلَمُ أَمِ اللَّهُ وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَتَمَ شَهَادَةً عِنْدَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَمَا اللَّهُ بِغَافِلِ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
english_translation: Or they say, surely Ibraheem (pbuh) and Ismaeel (pbuh) and Is'haq (pbuh) and Yaqoob (pbuh) and the tribes were hood / lenient / jews or nasara / helpers / christians. Say, do you know more or Allah? And who is more oppressive than the one who concealed the evidence he has from Allah? And Allah is not unaware about what you do.

arabic_text: وَلَنْ تَرْضَى عَنْكَ الْيَهُودُ وَلَا النَّصَارَى حَتَّى تَتَّبِعَ مِلَّتَهُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى اللَّهِ هُوَ الْهُدَى وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ بَعْدَ الَّذِي جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَلِيِّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
english_translation: And never will the yahood / lenient / jews or the nasara / helpers / christians be pleased with you unless you follow their millah / religion. Say, surely The Guidance of Allah, that is the guidance. And if you are to follow their desires after what has come to you from the knowledge then you would find neither a protector nor a helper from Allah.

arabic_text: قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةً فِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ إِذْ قَالُوا لِقَوْمِهِمْ إِنَّا بُرَآءُ مِنْكُمْ وَمِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ كَفَرْنَا بِكُمْ وَبَدَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ الْعَدَاوَةُ وَالْبَغْضَاءُ أَبَدًا حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ إِلَّا قَوْلَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَا أَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
english_translation: Without doubt there is for you the most beautiful pattern in Ibraheem (pbuh) and those with him, when they said to their people surely, we are free from you and from what you serve other than Allah. We have rejected you, and there has appeared between us and between you, enmity and hatred forever, unless you believe with Allah and Him alone except the saying of Ibraheem (pbuh) for his father, certainly I will ask forgiveness for you and I have no authority from Allah in anything for you. O' our Lord, on You we trust, and towards You we depute, and towards You is our determination.

arabic_text: أَمْ يَحْسُدُونَ النَّاسَ عَلَى مَا آتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ فَقَدْ آتَيْنَا آلَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ مُلْكًا عَظِيمًا
english_translation: Are they jealous of mankind on what Allah gave them from His bounty? So without doubt We gave to the followers of Ibraheem (pbuh) The Book and The Wisdom and We gave them a great kingdom.

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّنِي هَدَانِي رَبِّي إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ دِينًا قِيَمًا مِلَّةَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
english_translation: Say, surely my Lord has guided me to a straight way, a judgement established. The millah / religion of true Ibraheem (pbuh) and he was not from those who associate.

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
english_translation: Say, surely my prayer and my reclusions (when one is cut off or away from the worldly activities in religious obligations) and my life and my death are for Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
english_translation: There are no associates for Him and I am ordered with it and I am the first of the muslims / submitters.

arabic_text: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ فَمَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا وَمَنْ تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
english_translation: Surely Safa and Marwah are from the consciousness of Allah. So whosoever performs hajj / pilgrimage of The House or umrah / visit so it is not a sin over him, that he makes round with both of them. And whosoever volunteers is better, then surely Allah is Thankful, Knowledgeable.

arabic_text: لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللَّهُ بِاللَّغْوِ فِي أَيْمَانِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يُؤَاخِذُكُمْ بِمَا عَقَدْتُمُ الْأَيْمَانَ فَكَفَّارَتُهُ إِطْعَامُ عَشَرَةِ مَسَاكِينَ مِنْ أَوْسَطِ مَا تُطْعِمُونَ أَهْلِيكُمْ أَوْ كِسْوَتُهُمْ أَوْ تَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ ذَلِكَ كَفَّارَةُ أَيْمَانِكُمْ إِذَا حَلَفْتُمْ وَاحْفَظُوا أَيْمَانَكُمْ كَذَلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ آيَاتِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
english_translation: Allah will not catch you with nonsensical / ungrammatical talk in your rights and He will catch you with what you fastened / tied the knot in your rights and the atonement / amendment / correction is feeding of ten needy persons from an average of what you feed to your family garb them (distinctive uniform kind) or liberate / free a slave. Then whosoever does not find (this) then fast for three days. That is an atonement / amendment / correction of your rights when you take an oath. And preserve your rights. Likewise Allah clarifies His ayaat / signs for you so that you may be thankful.

arabic_text: وَأَتِمُوا الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ لِلَّهِ فَإِنْ أُحْصِرْتُمْ فَمَا اسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ الْهَدْيِ وَلَا تَحْلِقُوا رُءُوسَكُمْ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ الْهَدْيُ مَحِلَّهُ فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ مَرِيضًا أَوْ بِهِ أَذًى مِنْ رَأْسِهِ فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ فَإِذَا أَمِنْتُمْ فَمَنْ تَمَتَّعَ بِالْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ فَمَا اسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ الْهَدْيِ فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فِي الْحَجِّ وَسَبْعَةٍ إِذَا رَجَعْتُمْ تِلْكَ عَشَرَةٌ كَامِلَةٌ ذَلِكَ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ أَهْلُهُ حَاضِرِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
english_translation: And complete hajj / pilgrimage and umrah / visit for Allah. If you are being restricted so seek what is easy from the gift (i.e. from the cattle) and you do not shave your heads until your gift has reached its place of slaughter. So whosoever is sick from you or with him there is a hurt from his head then you ransom / redeem from fasting or charity or reclusion / solitude. Then when you are secure so who enjoyed with umrah / visit towards hajj / pilgrimage so seek what is easy from the gift (i.e. from the cattle) then whosoever does not find then fasting for three days in hajj / pilgrimage and seven when you return. That is complete ten. That is to whom his family is not present at the sacred mosque. And take guard of Allah and know that surely Allah is strong in pursuit.

arabic_text: لِيَشْهَدُوا مَنَافِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ فِي أَيَّامٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ عَلَى مَا رَزَقَهُمْ مِنْ بَهِيمَةِ الْأَنْعَامِ فَكُلُوا مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا الْبَائِسَ الْفَقِيرَ
english_translation: That they witness the advantage for them and remember the name of Allah in the known days over that which He has provided them from cattles. So eat from them and feed the distressed needy person.

arabic_text: لَنْ يَنَالَ اللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَاؤُهَا وَلَكِنْ يَنَالُهُ التَّقْوَى مِنْكُمْ كَذَلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا اللَّهَ عَلَى مَا هَدَاكُمْ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
english_translation: It is neither their meat nor their blood that reaches Allah but the taqwa / guard reaches Him from you. Like that He subjugated for you that you greaten Allah over what He guided you. And give good news to those who are good doers.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّبِعُوا مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ قَالُوا بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا أَلْفَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَنَا أَوَلَوْ كَانَ آبَاؤُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ
english_translation: And when it is said to them follow what Allah has revealed, they said but we follow what we have found our forefathers over it. What if their forefathers did not use intellect in anything and nor they get guided.

arabic_text: لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ يَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ إِنَاثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ الذُّكُورَةَ
english_translation: For Allah is the kingdom of the skies and the earth. He creates what He wills. He grants females for whom He wills and He grants males for whom He wills[cite: 97].

arabic_text: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا وَيَجْعَلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ عَقِيمًا إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ
english_translation: Or He pairs / couples / joins them males and females, and He makes (male or female) whom He wills barren / futile / unproductive. Surely He is Knowledgeable, Evaluator[cite: 97].

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ عِمْرَانَ رَبِّ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطْنِي مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
english_translation: When the wife of Imran (mother of Maryam pbuh) said, my Lord surely I have dedicated for You what is in my belly, freed / liberated. So accept from me, surely You, You are the Listener, the Knowledgeable[cite: 100].

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَضَعْتُهَا أُنْثَى وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ الذَّكَرُ كَالْأُنْثَى وَإِنِّي سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَإِنِّي أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
english_translation: So when she gave birth to her she said, my Lord surely I gave birth to her (as) a female. And Allah knows more with what she gave birth. And a male is not like a female. And surely I have named her Maryam / Mary (pbuh) and surely I seek refuge for her and her offspring / progeny with You, from the satan, the stoned[cite: 100].

arabic_text: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَا مَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَاكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَاصْطَفَاكِ عَلَى نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ
english_translation: And when the angels said O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh), surely Allah has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds[cite: 101].

arabic_text: يَا مَرْيَمُ اقْنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَاسْجُدِي وَارْكَعِي مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ
english_translation: O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh) be devout for your Lord and prostrate and bow down with those who bow down[cite: 101].

arabic_text: ذَلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَامَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
english_translation: That is from the prophecies of the absent, We inspire towards you. And you were not with them when they are throwing their pens (an enclosure used for confinement or safe keeping) who would be responsible for / to take charge of Maryam / Mary (pbuh). And you were not with them when they are arguing / disputing[cite: 101].

arabic_text: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَأَنْبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا الْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا رِزْقًا قَالَ يَا مَرْيَمُ أَنَّى لَكِ هَذَا قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
english_translation: So her Lord accepted her with a beautiful acceptance and He made her grow a beautiful growth, and Zakariya (pbuh) was responsible / took charge of her. Whenever Zakariya (pbuh) entered on her in the chamber and found sustenance near her, he said, O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh)! How is this for you? She said, it is from the nearness of Allah. Surely Allah gives sustenance to whom He wills without any counting / calculation[cite: 102].

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَا مَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِنْهُ اسْمُهُ الْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيهًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
english_translation: When the angels said, O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh), surely Allah gives you the good news with a word from Him, his name will be Al-Maseeh Essa / Christ Jesus (pbuh), the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh), honorable in this world and in the hereafter and from those who are close ones[cite: 103].

arabic_text: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ قَالَ كَذَلِكِ اللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ إِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
english_translation: She said, O' my Lord! How can there be a son for me when no human has touched me? He said, even so, Allah creates what He wills. When He completed the order, then surely He says for it, "Be" then it is[cite: 103].

arabic_text: ادْعُوهُمْ لِآبَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا آبَاءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَمَوَالِيكُمْ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا أَخْطَأْتُمْ بِهِ وَلَكِنْ مَا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا
english_translation: Call them by their fathers. That is more just near Allah. So if you do not know their fathers then (they are) your brothers and protectors in the judgement. And there is no sin on you in what you make mistake with it, and but what your hearts intended. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful[cite: 104].

arabic_text: وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
english_translation: And they ask you about Ar-Rooh / The Spirit. Say, Ar-Rooh / The Spirit is from the order of my Lord, and you have not been given from the knowledge, except little[cite: 105].

arabic_text: وَالَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَاهَا وَابْنَهَا آيَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ
english_translation: And she (Maryam pbuh) who fortified / guarded her gap / private part. So We breathed into her (soul / self) from Our Rooh / Spirit and made her and her son a sign for the worlds[cite: 105].

arabic_text: وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ
english_translation: And Maryam / Mary (pbuh) the daughter of Imran who fortified / guarded her gap / private part and We breathed into it (i.e. gap / private part) of Our Rooh / Spirit and she was truthful with the words of her Lord and His books and she was from the devotees[cite: 105].

arabic_text: قَالَ كَذَلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَى هَيِّنٌ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُ آيَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَقْضِيًّا
english_translation: He said likewise, your Lord said it is easy over Me, and so that We make him (i.e. Essa/Jesus pbuh) a sign and mercy for mankind from Us (i.e. Allah), and the order was completed We will make him. And the order was completed[cite: 106].

arabic_text: فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَانْتَبَذَتْ بِهِ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
english_translation: So she conceived him and she separated with him to a remote place. (i.e. distant place in time)[cite: 106].

arabic_text: فَأَجَاءَهَا الْمَخَاضُ إِلَى جِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَا لَيْتَنِي مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَذَا وَكُنْتُ نَسْيًا مَنْسِيًّا
english_translation: So the pains drove her towards the trunk of the palm tree, she said Oh! I wish I had died before this and I was lost, forgotten[cite: 106].

arabic_text: فَنَادَاهَا مِنْ تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا
english_translation: Then from beneath her he (i.e. spirit / essence) called her, that you do not grieve, without doubt your Lord has made a livelihood beneath you[cite: 106].

arabic_text: وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
english_translation: And shake towards you with the trunk of the palm tree, the fresh ripe dates will fall on you[cite: 106].

arabic_text: فَكُلِي وَاشْرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيْنًا فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِي إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنْسِيًّا
english_translation: So eat (fresh ripe dates) and drink (from the spring) and cool your eyes, then if you see anyone from a human, so say, surely I have dedicated a fast for the most Gracious so I will not speak to any man today[cite: 107].

arabic_text: فَأَتَتْ بِهِ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُ قَالُوا يَا مَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْئًا فَرِيًّا
english_translation: Then she came with him (people carrying) they said, O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh)! Without doubt you have brought up an invented thing[cite: 107].

arabic_text: يَا أُخْتَ هَارُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ امْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وََمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
english_translation: O' sister of Haroon / Aaron (pbuh)! Neither your father was a bad man and nor your mother was wrong[cite: 107].

arabic_text: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ جَاؤُوا بِالْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌ مِنْكُمْ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا لَكُمْ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ مَا اكْتَسَبَ مِنَ الْإِثْمِ وَالَّذِي تَوَلَّى كِبْرَهُ مِنْهُمْ لَهُ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
english_translation: Surely those who came forward with slander / defamation are a group from yourselves. You do not calculate it to be bad / worse for you but it is better for you. For every man among them is what he earned from the sin. And among them the one who turned away with his greatness / pride from them is a great punishment[cite: 108].

arabic_text: لَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتُ بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًا وَقَالُوا هَذَا إِفْكٌ مُبِينٌ
english_translation: When you heard it why did not the believing men and women speculate better with their souls and they should have said this is a clear slander / defamation[cite: 108].

arabic_text: لَوْلَا جَاؤُوا عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِالشُّهَدَاءِ فَأُولَئِكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ
english_translation: Why they did not bring four witnesses over it, so when they did not come up with witnesses, then in the nearness of Allah they are liars[cite: 108].

arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِي مَا أَفْضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
english_translation: And if it was not the bounty of Allah and His mercy over you in the world and the hereafter, definitely a great punishment would have touched you in whatever you spread in it[cite: 109].

arabic_text: إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ مَا لَيْسَ لَكُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ
english_translation: When you are receiving it with your tongues and you are saying with your mouths which you have no knowledge with it, and you estimate it to be a light matter and in the nearness of Allah it is a big matter[cite: 109].

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَلَدًا
english_translation: And they said, the most Gracious (Allah) has taken a son[cite: 111].

arabic_text: لَقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْئًا إِدًّا
english_translation: Without doubt you have come with a horrible thing[cite: 111].

arabic_text: تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنْشَقُّ الْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
english_translation: (As if) The skies are about to burst from it and the earth to split asunder and the mountains (to) fall down in destruction[cite: 111].

arabic_text: أَنْ دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَلَدًا
english_translation: That they call a son for the most Gracious (Allah)[cite: 111].

arabic_text: وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلرَّحْمَنِ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
english_translation: And it is not the desire for the most Gracious (Allah) that He takes a son[cite: 111].

arabic_text: قُولُوا آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَالْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَا أُوتِيَ مُوسَى وَعِيسَى وَمَا أُوتِيَ النَّبِيُّونَ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ
english_translation: You say, we believe with Allah and what has been revealed towards us and what has been revealed towards Ibraheem / Abraham (pbuh) and Ismail / Ismael (pbuh) and Ishaq / Isaac (pbuh) and Yaqoob / Jacob (pbuh) and the tribes and what has been given to Moosa / Moses (pbuh) and Essa / Jesus (pbuh) and what has been given to the prophets from their Lord. We do not differentiate (in the revelation) between anyone from them, and we are muslims / submitters for Him[cite: 112].

arabic_text: تِلْكَ الرُّسُلُ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ كَلَّمَ اللَّهُ وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَهُمْ دَرَجَاتٍ
english_translation: Those are the messengers We gave superiority to some of them over some. From them are those to whom Allah spoke and rafa / He raised some of them in degrees[cite: 112].....

arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُمْ مَا يَكُونُ لَنَا أَنْ نَتَكَلَّمَ بِهَذَا سُبْحَانَكَ هَذَا بُهْتَانٌ عَظِيمٌ
english_translation: And when you heard it why did you not say that it is not for us that we talk with this. Glory to You, this is a big false charge[cite: 113].

arabic_text: وَبِكُفْرِهِمْ وَقَوْلِهِمْ عَلَى مَرْيَمَ بُهْتَانًا عَظِيمًا
english_translation: And with their rejection and (with) their saying a big false charge on Maryam / Mary (pbuh)[cite: 113].

arabic_text: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ قَالُوا كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
english_translation: So she pointed towards him (i.e. Essa / Jesus pbuh). They said how can we talk to a youth who is in the cradle[cite: 113].

arabic_text: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَالتَّوْرَاةَ وَالْإِنْجِيلَ
english_translation: And He (Allah) will teach him (Essa / Jesus pbuh) Al-Kitab / The Book and Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom and At-Taurah / The Law and Al-Injeel / The Good News[cite: 114].

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ آتَانِيَ الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيًّا
english_translation: He said, surely I am the servant of Allah. He has given me Al-Kitab / The Book and He has made me a prophet[cite: 114].

arabic_text: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُ وَأَوْصَانِي بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَاةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا
english_translation: And He has made me blessed wheresoever I am, and has given me the testament with prayer and justification as long as I am alive[cite: 114].

arabic_text: وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَتِي وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِي جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
english_translation: And has made me kind with my mother and never made me forceful, miserable[cite: 114].

arabic_text: وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدْتُ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
english_translation: And salam / peace is on me the day I was born and (peace is on me) the day I will die and (peace is on me) the day I will be appointed alive[cite: 114].

arabic_text: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَى عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ آدَمَ خَلَقَهُ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
english_translation: Surely the example of Essa / Jesus (pbuh) in the nearness of Allah is like the example of Adam. He created him from dust then said for him "Be" then he was[cite: 115].

arabic_text: ذَلِكَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ قَوْلَ الْحَقِّ الَّذِي فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
english_translation: That is Essa / Jesus (pbuh) son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh). A saying of truth that in which they dispute[cite: 115].

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُمْ آيَةً وَآوَيْنَاهُمَا إِلَى رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ
english_translation: And We made the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) and his mother a sign, and We gave shelter to both of them (from their rejection) towards a hill / height that has stillness / is static and has fountain / spring (i.e. to know the truth about both of them)[cite: 115].

arabic_text: مَا الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ وَأُمُّهُ صِدِّيقَةٌ كَانَا يَأْكُلَانِ الطَّعَامَ انْظُرْ كَيْفَ نُبَيِّنُ لَهُمُ الْآيَاتِ ثُمَّ انْظُرْ أَنَّى يُؤْفَكُونَ
english_translation: Al-Maseeh / the Christ (pbuh) son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) is not except a messenger, truly messengers have passed before him. And his mother is truthful. They both ate food. See how We clarify for them the ayaat / signs, then see how they are deluded[cite: 116].

arabic_text: يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لَا تَغْلُوا فِي دِينِكُمْ وَلَا تَقُولُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ إِنَّمَا الْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُ أَلْقَاهَا إِلَى مَرْيَمَ وَرُوحٌ مِنْهُ فَآمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَلَا تَقُولُوا ثَلَاثَةٌ انْتَهُوا خَيْرًا لَكُمْ إِنَّمَا اللَّهُ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ سُبْحَانَهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ لَهُ ما فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
english_translation: O' people of the Book! Do not exaggerate / exceed in your judgement and do not say on Allah except the truth. Surely Al-Maseeh Essa / Christ Jesus son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) is a messenger of Allah and His word, He threw it towards Maryam / Mary (pbuh), and a rooh / spirit from Him, so believe with Allah and His messengers. And you do not say trinity. Stop! It is better for you. Surely Allah is one God. Glory to Him, that, there is / can be a son for Him. Whatever is in the skies and in the earth is for Him. And Allah is a sufficient advocate[cite: 116].

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
english_translation: Surely Allah and His angels pray over the prophet. O' you who believe! Pray over him and submit by submitting[cite: 118].

arabic_text: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا مُهِينًا
english_translation: Surely those who hurt Allah and His messenger, Allah cursed them in the world and the hereafter and He has prepared a humiliating punishment for them[cite: 118].

arabic_text: وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا اكْتَسَبُوا فَقَدِ احْتَمَلُوا بُهْتَانًا وَإِثْمًا مُبِينًا
english_translation: And those who hurt the believing men and the believing women without what they earned, then they have carried a false charge and a clear sin[cite: 118].

arabic_text: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا امْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَامْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَالِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَقِيلَ ادْخُلَا النَّارَ مَعَ الدَّاخِلِينَ
english_translation: Allah strikes an example for those who rejected, the wife of Nooh/Noah (pbuh) and the wife of Lut / Lot (pbuh). They were under Our two servants, from Our servants the two who corrected. Then they were unfaithful to both of them so they both did not benefit from Allah in anything about themselves and both were told to enter the fire with those who entered[cite: 119].

arabic_text: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
english_translation: And Allah strikes an example for those who believed, the wife of pharaoh when she said, O' my Lord! Build for me, a house near You in the garden, and save me from pharaoh and his doings, and save me from the people who are oppressors[cite: 119].

arabic_text: وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ
english_translation: And Maryam / Mary (pbuh) the daughter of Imran, who fortified / guarded her gap / private part, then We breathed into it from (i.e. soul / self) Our rooh / spirit. And she was truthful with the words of her Lord and His books and she was from the devout ones[cite: 120].

arabic_text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَذُرِّيَّةً وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ بِآيَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ لِكُلِّ أَجَلٍ كِتَابٌ
english_translation: And without doubt We sent messengers from before you and We made for them pairs / wives and offspring / progeny. And it is not for any messenger that he comes with an ayah / sign except with the permission of Allah. There is a book for every appointed time[cite: 121].

arabic_text: لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَوتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ يَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ إِنَاثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ الذُّكُورَة
english_translation: For Allah is the kingdom of the skies and the earth. He creates what He wills. He grants females for whom He wills and He grants males for whom He wills.

arabic_text: اويُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا وَيَجْعَلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ عَقِيمًا إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ
english_translation: Or He pairs / couples / joins them males and females, and He makes (males or females) whom He wills barren / futile / unproductive. Surely He is Knowledgeable, Evaluator.

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ عِمْرَانَ رَبِّ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطْنِي مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
english_translation: When the wife of Imran (mother of Maryam pbuh) said, my Lord surely I have dedicated for You what is in my belly, freed / liberated. So accept from me, surely You, You are the Listener, the Knowledgeable.

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَضَعْتُهَا أُنْثَى وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ الذَّكَرُ كَالَانْثَى وَإِنِّي سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَإِنِّي أَعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّحِيمِ
english_translation: So when she gave birth to her she said, my Lord surely I gave birth to her (as) a female. And Allah knows more with what she gave birth. And a male is not like a female. And surely I have named her Maryam / Mary (pbuh) and surely I seek refuge for her and her offspring/progeny with You from the satan, the stoned.

arabic_text: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولِ حَسَنٍ وَأَنْبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا الْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا رِزْقًا قَالَ يَمَرْيَمُ أَنَّى لَكِ هَذَا قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
english_translation: So her Lord accepted her with a beautiful acceptance and He made her grow a beautiful growth, and Zakariya (pbuh) was responsible / took charge of her. Whenever Zakariya (pbuh) entered on her in the chamber and found sustenance near her, he said, O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh)! How is this for you? She said, it is from the nearness of Allah. Surely Allah gives sustenance to whom He wills without any counting / calculation.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يُمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَاكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَاصْطَفَاكِ عَلَى نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ
english_translation: And when the angels said O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh), surely Allah has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds.

arabic_text: يُمَرْيَمُ اقْنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَاسْجُدِي وَارْكَعِي مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ
english_translation: O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh) be devout for your Lord and prostrate and bow down with those who bow down.

arabic_text: ذَلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَامَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
english_translation: That is from the prophecies of the absent, We inspire towards you. And you were not with them when they are throwing their pens who would be responsible for / to take charge of Maryam / Mary (pbuh). And you were not with them when they are arguing / disputing.

arabic_text: إِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يُمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنْهُ اسْمُهُ الْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيهًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
english_translation: When the angels said O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh), surely Allah gives you the good news with a word from Him, his name will be Al-Maseeh Essa / Christ Jesus (pbuh), the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh), honorable in this world and in the hereafter and from those who are close ones.

arabic_text: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ قَالَ كَذَلِكِ اللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ إِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
english_translation: She said, O' my Lord! How can there be a son for me when no human has touched me? He said, even so, Allah creates what He wills. When He completed the order, then surely He says for it, "Be" then it is.

arabic_text: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَى عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ آدَمَ خَلَقَهُ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
english_translation: Surely the example of Essa / Jesus (pbuh) in the nearness of Allah is like the example of Adam. He created him from dust then said for him "Be" then he was.

arabic_text: وَبِكُفْرِهِمْ وَقَوْلِهِمْ عَلَى مَرْيَمَ بُهْتَانًا عَظِيمًا
english_translation: And with their rejection and (with) their saying a big false charge on Maryam / Mary (pbuh).

arabic_text: وَإِن مِّنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ إِلَّا لَيُؤْمِنَنَّ بِهِ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا
english_translation: And there is no one from the people of the Book except, he must believe with it before his (own) death. And on the day of judgement he (Essa / Jesus pbuh) will be a witness over them.

arabic_text: يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لَا تَغْلُوا فِي دِينِكُمْ وَلَا تَقُولُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ إِنَّمَا الْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُ أَلْقَاهَا إِلَى مَرْيَمَ وَرُوحٌ مِّنْهُ فَآمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَلَا تَقُولُوا ثَلَاثَةٌ انتَهُوا خَيْرًا لَّكُمْ إِنَّمَا اللَّهُ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ سُبْحَانَهُ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
english_translation: O' people of the Book! Do not exaggerate / exceed in your judgement and do not say on Allah except the truth. Surely Al-Maseeh Essa / Christ Jesus son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) is a messenger of Allah and His word, He threw it towards Maryam / Mary (pbuh), and a rooh / spirit from Him, so believe with Allah and His messengers. And you do not say trinity. Stop! It is better for you. Surely Allah is one God. Glory to Him, that, there is / can be a son for Him. Whatever is in the skies and in the earth is for Him. And Allah is a sufficient advocate.

arabic_text: مَّا الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ وَأُمُّهُ صِدِّيقَةٌ كَانَا يَأْكُلَانِ الطَّعَامَ انْظُرْ كَيْفَ نُبَيِّنُ لَهُمُ الْآيَاتِ ثُمَّ انْظُرْ أَنَّى يُؤْفَكُونَ
english_translation: Al-Maseeh / the Christ (pbuh) son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) is not except a messenger. Without doubt the messengers passed before him. And his mother is truthful. They both ate food. See how We clarify for them the ayaat / signs, then see how they are deluded.

arabic_text: وَإِذْ قَالَ اللَّهُ يَا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ أَأَنتَ قُلْتَ لِلنَّاسِ اتَّخِذُونِي وَأُمِّيَ إِلَهَيْنِ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قَالَ سُبْحَانَكَ مَا يَكُونُ لِي أَنْ أَقُولَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِحَقٍّ إِنْ كُنْتُ قُلْتُهُ فَقَدْ عَلِمْتَهُ تَعْلَمُ مَا فِي نَفْسِي وَلَا أَعْلَمُ مَا فِي نَفْسِكَ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ
english_translation: And when Allah said O' Essa / Jesus (pbuh) the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh), did you say to mankind, you take me and my mother as two gods other than Allah? He said, glory to You, never could I say with what I had no right. If I had said such a thing, so definitely You would have known it. You know what is in my soul / self / psyche and I do not know what is in Your soul / self / psyche. Surely You, You are Knowledgeable of all that is absent.

arabic_text: مَا قُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِلَّا مَا أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبَّكُمْ وَكُنتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا مَّا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي كُنتَ أَنْتَ الرَّقِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَنتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
english_translation: I never said to them except what You ordered me with it, that is, you serve Allah, my Lord and your Lord. And I was a witness over them while I lived among them. When You tawaffaitani / completed me (my soul / self / psyche) You were the Watcher over them. And You are a Witness over all things.

arabic_text: إِنْ تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ وَإِنْ تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
english_translation: If You punish them then surely they are Your servants, and if You forgive them then surely You, You are the Mighty, the Wise.

arabic_text: قَالَ اللَّهُ هَذَا يَوْمُ يَنْفَعُ الصَّادِقِينَ صِدْقُهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ ذَلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
english_translation: Allah said, this is the day (on which) the truthful will profit from their truth. For them are gardens with rivers flowing from beneath it, dwellers therein forever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. That is the great success.

arabic_text: مَّا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِّنْ قَلْبَيْنِ فِي جَوْفِهِ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَاجَكُمُ اللَّائِي تُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدْعِيَاءَكُمْ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ ذَلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُمْ بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ وَاللَّهُ يَقُولُ الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِي السَّبِيلَ
english_translation: Allah has not made for any man from two hearts in his hollow cavity (chest). And He has not made your pairs / wives that you make obvious from them as your mothers. And He has not made your called ones as your sons. That is your sayings with your mouths. And Allah says the truth and He guides to the way.

arabic_text: ادْعُوهُمْ لِآبَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوا آبَاءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَمَوَالِيكُمْ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا أَخْطَأْتُمْ بِهِ وَلَكِنْ مَّا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
english_translation: Call them by their fathers. That is more just near Allah. So if you do not know their fathers then (they are) your brothers and your protected ones in the judgement. And there is no sin on you in what you made mistake with it, and but that your hearts intended. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

arabic_text: وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي وَمَا أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
english_translation: And they ask you about Ar-Rooh / The Spirit. Say Ar-Rooh / The Spirit is from the order of my Lord. And from the knowledge you are not given except little.

arabic_text: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ انْتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا
english_translation: And mention Maryam / Mary (pbuh) in the Book when she separated from her family to an eastern place.

arabic_text: فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
english_translation: Then apart from them she took a hijab / veil, then We sent to her Our rooh / spirit / essence. So he was an even example of a human for her.

arabic_text: قَالَتْ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِالرَّحْمَنِ مِنْكَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَقِيًّا
english_translation: She said, "I seek refuge with the most Gracious, from you, if you are guarded".

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَنَا رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَامًا زَكِيًّا
english_translation: He said, surely I am a messenger from your Lord, to grant you the justified son.

arabic_text: قَالَتْ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا
english_translation: She said, how can there be a son for me, when no human has touched me, and I am not wrong.

arabic_text: قَالَ كَذَلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُ آيَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَقْضِيًّا
english_translation: He said likewise, your Lord said it is easy over Me. And so that We make him (i.e. Essa / Jesus pbuh) a sign and mercy from Us (i.e. Allah), for mankind. And the order was completed.

arabic_text: فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَانْتَبَذَتْ بِهِ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
english_translation: Then she conceived him, and so she separated with him to a remote place.

arabic_text: فَأَجَاءَهَا الْمُخَاضُ إِلَى جِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَا لَيْتَنِي مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَذَا وَكُنْتُ نَسْيًا مَنْسِيًّا
english_translation: So the pains drove her towards the trunk of the palm tree, she said Oh! I wish I had died before this and I was lost, forgotten.

arabic_text: فَنَادَاهَا مِنْ تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا
english_translation: Then from beneath her he (i.e. spirit / essence) called her, that you do not grieve, without doubt your Lord has made living / subsistence beneath / under you.

arabic_text: وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
english_translation: And shake towards you with the trunk of the palm tree, the fresh ripe dates will fall on you.

arabic_text: فَكُلِي وَاشْرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيْنًا فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِي إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنْسِيًّا
english_translation: So eat (fresh ripe dates) and drink (from the spring) and cool your eyes, then if you see anyone from a human, so say, surely I have dedicated a fast for the most Gracious so I will not speak to any man today.

arabic_text: فَأَتَتْ بِهِ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُ قَالُوا يَا مَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْئًا فَرِيًّا
english_translation: Then she came with him to her people carrying him. They said, O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh)! Without doubt you have brought up an invented thing.

arabic_text: يَا أُخْتَ هَارُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ امْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
english_translation: O' sister of Haroon / Aaron (pbuh) neither your father was a bad man and nor your mother was wrong.

arabic_text: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ قَالُوا كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
english_translation: So she pointed towards him (i.e. Essa / Jesus pbuh). They said how can we talk to a youth who is in the cradle.

arabic_text: قَالَ إِنِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ آتَانِي الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيًّا
english_translation: He said, surely I am the servant of Allah. He has given me Al-Kitab / The Book and He has made me a prophet.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُ وَأَوْصَانِي بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَاةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا
english_translation: And He has made me blessed wheresoever I am, and has given me the testament with salah / prayer and zakah / the justification as long as I am alive.

arabic_text: وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَتِي وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِي جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
english_translation: And (has made me) kind with my mother and never made me forceful, miserable.

arabic_text: وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدْتُ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
english_translation: And salam / peace is on me the day I was born and peace is on me the day I die and the day I will be appointed alive.

arabic_text: ذَلِكَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ قَوْلَ الْحَقِّ الَّذِي فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
english_translation: That is Essa / Jesus (pbuh) son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh). A saying of the truth that in which they dispute.

arabic_text: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَلَدًا
english_translation: And they said, the most Gracious (Allah) has taken a son.

arabic_text: لَقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْئًا إِدًّا
english_translation: Without doubt you have come with a horrible thing.

arabic_text: تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنْشَقُّ الْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
english_translation: (As if) The skies are about to burst from it and the earth to split asunder and the mountains (to) fall down in destruction.

arabic_text: أَنْ دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَلَدًا
english_translation: That they call a son for the most Gracious (Allah).

arabic_text: وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلرَّحْمَنِ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
english_translation: And it is not the desire for the most Gracious (Allah) that He takes a son.

arabic_text: وَالَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَاهَا وَابْنَهَا آيَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ
english_translation: And she (Maryam pbuh) who fortified / guarded her gap / private parts. So We breathed into her (soul / self) from Our Rooh / Spirit and made her and her son a sign for the worlds.

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ آيَةً وَآوَيْنَاهُمَا إِلَى رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ
english_translation: And We made the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) and his mother a sign, and We gave shelter to both of them (from their rejection) towards a hill / height that has stillness / is static and has fountain / spring (i.e. to know the truth about both of them).

arabic_text: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ جَاؤُوا بِالْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌ مِّنْكُمْ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا لَكُمْ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ مَّا اكْتَسَبَ مِنَ الْإِثْمِ وَالَّذِي تَوَلَّى كِبْرَهُ مِنْهُمْ لَهُ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
english_translation: Surely those who came forward with slander / defamation are a group from yourselves. You do not calculate it to be bad / worse for you but it is better for you. For every man among them is what he earned from the sin. And among them the one who turned away with his greatness / pride for him is a great punishment.

arabic_text: لَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتُ بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًا وَقَالُوا هَذَا إِفْكٌ مُّبِينٌ
english_translation: When you heard it why did not the believing men and women speculate better with their souls and they should have said this is a clear slander / defamation.

arabic_text: لَوْلَا جَاؤُوا عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِالشُّهَدَاءِ فَأُولَئِكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ
english_translation: Why they did not bring four witnesses over it, so when they did not come up with witnesses, then in the nearness of Allah, they are liars.

arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِي مَّا أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
english_translation: And if it was not the bounty of Allah and His mercy over you in the world and the hereafter, definitely a great punishment would have touched you in whatever you spread in it.

arabic_text: إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًا وَهْوَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ
english_translation: When you are receiving it with your tongues and you are saying with your mouths which you have no knowledge with it, and you estimate it to be a light matter and in the nearness of Allah it is a big matter.

arabic_text: وَلَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُم مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَا أَنْ نَتَكَلَّمَ بِهَذَا سُبْحَانَكَ هَذَا بُهْتَانٌ عَظِيمٌ
english_translation: And when you heard it why did you not say that it is not for us that we talk with this. Glory to You, this is a big false charge.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُ لَعِلْمٌ لِلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُونِ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
english_translation: Surely he (Essa / Jesus pbuh) is definitely the knowledge for the hour (of the day of judgement). So do not doubt with it and follow me. This is the straight path.

arabic_text: وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ
