english_translation: And Maryam / Mary (pbuh) the daughter of Imran who fortified / guarded her gap / private part and We breathed into it (i.e. gap / private part) of Our Rooh / Spirit and she was truthful with the words of her Lord and His books and she was from the devotees.

When the angels said, O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh) surely Allah gives you the good news of a word from Him, his name will be Al-Maseeh Essa / Christ Jesus (pbuh) the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh), held in honour in this world and in the hereafter and from those who are close ones.

She said, my Lord how he will become a son for me when no man has touched me? He said, even so Allah creates what He wills. When the order is complete, then surely He said for him, "be" and he became.
And He (Allah) will teach him (Essa / Jesus pbuh) Al-Kitab / The Book and Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom and At-Taurah / The Law and Al-Injeel / The Good News.

And a messenger to the children of Israel, that is without doubt I have come to you with an ayat / sign from your Lord. Surely that I create for you from the clay, as it was the figure of a bird (flyer) so I breathe in it so it becomes a bird (flyer) with the permission of Allah. And I heal the blind and the lepers and I give life to the dead with the permission of Allah. And I inform you with what you consume / eat and what you store in your houses. Surely in that is an ayat / sign for you if you are believers.

When Essa / Jesus (pbuh) felt the rejection from them, he said, who are my helpers towards Allah? The companions / disciples said we are helpers of Allah. We believe with Allah and you bear witness that we are muslims / submitters.
O' our Lord, we believe with what You have revealed and we follow the Messenger, then write us with those who bear witness.
And they (rejecters) planned and Allah planned and Allah is the best of the planners.

And when Allah said, O' Essa / Jesus (pbuh)! Surely I will mutawaffika / complete you (your soul / self / psyche) and raafiooka / raise you (in degrees) to Myself and purify you from those who reject, and I will make those who follow you, superior to those who reject, towards the day of judgement. english_translation: Who Enlightens
Warner / Giver of Good News / Entirely for People

He gave Shara / road for you from the judgement, what He gave testament with it to Nooh / Noah (pbuh) and We inspired to you, and that (shara / road) what testament We gave with it (shara / road) to Ibraheem / Abraham (pbuh) and Moosa / Moses (pbuh) and Essa / Jesus (pbuh) that you establish the judgement and you do not differentiate in it. It appears big over those who associate to what you invite them towards it. Allah chooses towards it whom He wills and He guides towards it who deputises.

Or for them are associates, they have made a shara / road for them from the judgement, for which Allah has never given permission with it. And if the word was not explanatory, definitely (the matter) would have been completed between them. And surely the oppressors, for them is a painful punishment.
Nothing is said for you except what surely was said for the messengers from before you. Surely your Lord is definitely Who forgives and Who is a painful chaser.

Say that, I am not from the messengers making bid'an / innovation (i.e. to make new changes) and I neither have perception what will be done with me and nor with you. I follow not except what is inspired towards me and I am not except a clear warner.
Those who rejected and opposed about the way of Allah, He astrayed their doings / works.

And those who believed and did corrections and believed with what is being revealed on Muhammad (pbuh) and it is the truth from their Lord. He has covered from them their badness and He corrected their condition.

Muhammad (pbuh) is the Messenger of Allah and those who are with him, (i.e. the believers) are more stronger over the rejecters, are merciful amongst each other. You see them bowing, prostrating, they seek the bounty and good pleasures from Allah...
And he does not apply logic about the desire.
It is not except an inspiration, to which he is being inspired.

And when Essa / Jesus (pbuh) son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) said O' children of Israel, surely I am a Messenger of Allah towards you, confirming for what is between my two hands from At-Taurah / The Law and giver of a good news with the Messenger, he will come after me, whose name is Ahmed / more praiseworthy. So when he (i.e. Muhammad pbuh) came to them with clarifications, they said, this is a clear magic.
He (Allah) is the First and the Last. And the Obvious and the Hidden. And He is Knowledgeable with everything.
And surely you are on a great moral character.

Surely it is the qaul / saying of an honourable messenger. And it is not with the qaul / saying of a shair / poet. Little is what you believe. And (it is) not with the qaul / saying of a kahin / storyteller. Little is what you remember. A revelation from the Lord of the worlds. And if he had said some of the aqwal / sayings on Us. Definitely We would have caught him with the right. Then definitely We would have cut off from his aorta.

And We have not sent from a messenger to clarify for them except with the language of his people (i.e. translation / clarification of the Quranic Arabic spirit). So Allah astrays whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And He is the Mighty, the Wise.

He (Moosa pbuh) said O' my Lord, expand my chest for me. And make my order / task easy for me. And open the knot from my language. (i.e.translation / clarification of the Quranic Arabic spirit). So they understand what I say.

And this Al-Quran / The Reading is not that can be produced from other than Allah, but it is a confirmation that is between his two hands and a detail of Al-Kitab / The Book, there is no doubt in it, from the Lord of the worlds.

Surely, We have revealed At-Taurah / The law, in it is guidance and light. an-nabeeyoon / the prophets who submitted governed with it for those who are hadoo / lenient / jews, and rabba-neeon / the lords and ahbar / the scholars (governed with it), with what they were made to seek to memorize / preserve from Kitab / Book of Allah and they were witnesses over it. So you do not fear mankind and fear Me, and you do not purchase My ayaat / signs for a little price. And whoever does not govern with what Allah has revealed they are rejecters.

And We have written in it (i.e. At-Taurah / The law) on them, that the soul is with the soul and the eye is with the eye and the nose is with the nose and the ear is with the ear and the tooth is with the tooth and there is a relation of the wounds (i.e. physical injuries or hurt of the feelings). So who gives charity with it then there is an atonement (i.e. amendment) for him. And whoever does not govern with what Allah has revealed then they are the zalimoon / oppressors.
And remember Moosa / Moses (pbuh) in Al-Kitab / The Book, surely he was devout / sincere and a Messenger, Prophet.
And when he (Moses pbuh) attained maturity to his full strength, We gave him governance and knowledge. And likewise We reward those who do good.

And when Moosa / Moses (pbuh) came to Our appointed time, and his Lord spoke to him. He said, O' my Lord show me, that I may look towards You., He said, you can never see Me, but look towards the mountain, if it remains in its place, so you may see Me. Then his Lord threw light for the mountain, He made it crumbled and Moosa / Moses (pbuh) fell down stunned, then when he excelled. He said, glory to You and I return towards You and I am first of the believers.
Surely I am your Lord so take off both of your shoes. Surely you are within the holy valley of folds.
Surely I am Allah, there is no god except Me, so serve Me, and establish salah / prayer for My remembrance.

O' our Lord, surely I have settled from my offsprings within the valley which is without cultivation near Your sacred house. O' our Lord, so that they establish salah / prayer. So make the hearts of the people desirable towards them and give them sustenance from the fruits so that they may be thankful.
Surely, the first house placed for people (mankind), surely is that which is with Bakka, blessing and guidance for the worlds.

Surely, Safa and Marwah are the consciousness / awareness of Allah, so whosoever performs hajj / pilgrimage or umrah of the House, it is no offence on him, that he makes rounds by both of them and whosoever voluntarily does betterment so surely Allah is Thankful, Knowledgeable.
And I have manufactured / made you for Myself.
And I have selected you, so listen to what is being inspired.

He (Allah) said, O' Moosa / Moses (pbuh), surely I have chosen you over mankind with My risalaat / messages and with My kalaam / words. So hold fast to what I gave you and become of those who are thankful.

And We wrote for him in Alwah / the Tablets, sermon from everything and explanation for everything. So hold fast to it with strength and order your people that they should hold it beautifully. Soon I will show you the circles of the liberals.
But it is a glorious Quran. In a preserved Loh / Tablet.
And without doubt We gave Moosa / Moses (pbuh) Al-Kitab / The Book so that they may be guided.
That is Al-Kitab / The Book, no doubt in it, a guidance for those who guard.
Without doubt for you there is a good pattern (to follow) in rasool / messenger of Allah for the one who has hope in Allah and the last day and he remembers Allah a lot.

Then We gave Moosa / Moses (pbuh) Al-Kitab / The Book completely on to the one who does good and an explanation for everything and a guidance and mercy so that they may believe with the meeting of their Lord.

So who is on clarity from his Lord and a witness recites it from it. And from before it is book of Moosa / Moses (pbuh), a leader and mercy. They believe with it and whosoever rejects with it from the groups so fire is his promised place. So you do not be in doubt from it. Surely it is the truth from your Lord but the majority of mankind do not believe.
And without doubt, We gave Moosa / Moses (pbuh) Al-Kitab / The Book so you (Mohammad pbuh) do not be in doubt from receiving it and We made it a guidance for the children of Israel.

And those who believe and do corrections and believe with what is being revealed on Muhammad (pbuh). And it is the truth from their Lord. He will cover their ills from them and correct their conditions.

And when We inflect / turn towards you (Muhammad) a group from the jinns / the shielded ones, they listen Al-Quran / The Reading. So when they were in its presence, they said listen quietly. Then when it was completed they turn as warners to their people.
They said, 'O' our people, we have listened Kitab / A Book revealed after Moosa / Moses (pbuh) confirming for what is between his two hands, it guides towards the truth and towards a straight way.

When the truth came to them from Our nearness, they said why is not given similar like what was given to Moosa / Moses (pbuh). And do they not reject with what was given to Moosa / Moses (pbuh) from before. They said these two are magics backing each other. And they said surely we are rejecters of all.
And from before it, book of Moosa / Moses (pbuh) is a leader and mercy. And this Kitab / Book is confirming the Arabic language, so that He warns oppressors and a good news for good doers.
Say, then come with Kitab / a Book from the nearness of Allah, that which is more in guidance from both of them, I will follow it if you are truthful.
That you say surely Al-Kitab / The Book was revealed on the two groups from before us and that we surely remain unaware about their studies.

And the yahood / lenient / jews said that nasara / helpers / christians are not on anything. And the nasara / helpers / christians said that the yahood / lenient / jews are not on anything. And both of them are reciting Al-Kitab / The Book. Like that those who do not know said like their saying. So Allah will govern between them on the day of judgement in what they were differing.

Or you say that if Al-Kitab / The Book was revealed on us, definitely we would have been more guided from them. So without doubt there has come to you a clarity from your Lord and guidance and mercy. So who is more oppressor from the one who belies with ayaat / signs of Allah and dissuades / not persuading about them. Soon We will reward those who dissuades / not persuading about our signs with a severe punishment with what they are dissuading / not persuading.

And they did not evaluate Allah as His true evaluation, when they said Allah has not revealed on any human being from anything. Say, who has revealed Al-Kitab / The Book, that Moosa / Moses (pbuh) came with it? A light and a guidance for mankind. You have made it papers, you show it and you conceal most of it. And He taught you what you know not, neither you nor your ancestors. Say, Allah (has revealed). Then leave them in their wading sports.
question_text: Q2. If the book of Moses (pbuh) and the book revealed on Muhammad (pbuh) same then are there any earlier records available which prove that this book was on papers?

english_translation: And without doubt, We gave Moosa / Moses (pbuh) Al-Kitab / The Book then it was differed in it. And word had not definitely it would have finished off (the differences in the book) between them. And surely they are in suspicion from it doubting.
And without doubt We sent Moosa / Moses (pbuh) with Our ayaat / signs towards firoun / pharaoh and his chiefs, so he (Moses pbuh) said surely I am the Messenger from the Lord of the worlds.
When he (Moosa / Moses pbuh) came to them with Our ayaat / signs then they ridiculed from it.
And We did not show them from the ayat / sign except that was greater than its sister (ayat / sign). And We caught them with the punishment so that they return.
And they said O' magician call your Lord for us with what He took a pact / covenant with you. Surely we will be guided ones.
So when We removed the punishment from them, then they break (pact/covenant).
And firoun / pharoah called in his people, he said O' my people! Is not the kingdom of Egypt for me, and the streams that flow underneath me?. So do you not have sight.
Or am I not better than this, who is despised / humiliated and he is not even near to clarify?
Then why not has he received bracelets from gold or the angels came joining with him?

When he (Moosa / Moses pbuh) came to them with the truth from Our nearness. They said kill the sons of those who believe with him and shame / keep alive their women. And the machination of the unbelievers is not except in straying.
And firoun / pharoah said leave me that I kill Moosa / Moses and he should call his Lord. Surely I fear that he will change your deen / judgement or that he will manifest corruption in the earth.
And Moosa / Moses (pbuh) said surely I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant, who does not believe with the day of account.

And Moosa / Moses (pbuh) said O' our Lord, surely You gave firoun / pharoah and his chiefs / councils the adornment and wealth in this worldly life, O' our Lord so that they mislead about Your way. O' our Lord obliterate them on their wealth and make them rigid on their hearts, so they will not believe until they see the painful punishment.
He said without doubt your call has been answered so both of you remain steadfast and both of you do not follow the way of those who do not know.
So he (firoun / pharoah) eased out his people so they followed him, surely they became liberal people.
So when they regretted Us, We took vengeance from them, then We drowned them all together.
So We made them the past and an example for others.

And when Moses (pbuh) said for his people, people Remember the blessing of on you when He (Allah) made prophets in you and made you kings and He gave you what He did not give to anyone from the worlds.
question_text: Q1. Did Moses go to the holy land of Jerusalem?

english_translation: O' my people! Enter the holy land which Allah wrote for you, and you do not turn on your backs. Then you turned losers.

And if We had revealed on you a book in paper even then they would have touched it with their hands, definitely those who rejected would have definitely said that this is nothing except a clear magic.

The example of those who were made to carry At-Taurah / The Law (i.e. hukum / the governance of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs) then they did not carry it, is like an example of a donkey carrying journeys. Bad is the example of the people who belie with the ayaat / signs of Allah. And Allah does not guide the people who are oppressors.

O' People of The Book! Without doubt Our messenger has come to you. He clarifies for you a lot of from what you were hiding from The Book and he overlooks / pardons about a lot (of it). Without doubt a light and a clear book has come to you from Allah.
question_text: Q3. If the book of Moses (pbuh.) and the book given to Muhammad (pbuh) is same then why has it been revealed again on Muhammad (pbuh)?

english_translation: And how can they govern you and At-Taurah / The Law is near them, in it is hukm / governance of Allah. Then after that they turn away and they are not with the believers.
question_text: Q4. In Al-Maida 5:45, it says that in At-Taurah / The Law it is written that 'the soul is with the soul' etc. Then, can we say that this is the only verse for At-Taurah / The Law of the book.?

english_translation: It is He Who has revealed Al-Kitab / The Book over you. In it are muhkamat / governing ayaat / signs. They are the mother of Al-Kitab / The Book and others are mutashabehat / resembling (ayaat / signs). So in whose hearts is deviation then they follow that resembles from it seeking captivation and its interpretation and no one knows its interpretation except Allah. And those who are stable in knowledge they say "we believe with it, all is from the nearness of our Lord." And no one remembers except those who possess the core. (i.e. innermost part of anything).

Allah has revealed the most beautiful hadith / the event as a book mutashabiha / resembling, repeating itself. Those who fear from their Lord their skins shiver from it. Then their skins and their hearts soften towards the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah. He guides whom He wills with it. And to whom Allah leaves astray so for him there is no one who can guide.
Has hadith / event of Moosa (pbuh) come to you?

And know that surely whatever ghanim / profit you get from anything, if you believe in Allah then surely 1/5th of it (sadaqah/charity) is for Allah / God and for Rasool / the Messenger and (for) qurba / the relatives and (for) yatama / the orphans and (for) masakeen / the needy (who are reduced to poverty) and for ibn-e-sabeel / the son of the way and whatever We sent down over Our servant on the day of the division, the day when the two accumulations are met/collected (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim/profit). And Allah has power over everything.

Whatever Allah has bestowed (i.e. the 1/5th of the ghanim / profit and any amount according to the means) from the people of the cities over His Messenger then it (sadaqah / charity) is for Allah / God and for Rasool / the Messenger and (for) qurba / the relatives and (for) yatama / the orphans and (for) masakeen / the needy (who are reduced to poverty) and (for) ibn-e-sabeel / the son of the way so that it may not be a circulating thing amongst the rich from you and whatever the messenger gives you so take it and whatever he forbids you about it, so abstain. And take guard of Allah. Surely Allah is strong in pursuit.

It (sadaqah / the charity) is for fuqara muhajireen / the poor migrants those who have been expelled from their circles and their wealth, seeking the bounty from Allah and good pleasure and helping Allah and His Messenger, they are those who are truthful.

And (sadaqah / the charity is for) those who settled in the circle and the belief (who migrated) from before them, they love whosoever migrated towards them and they do not find in their chest any need from what they have been given and they do not have any effect over themselves even if poverty is with them. And whosoever is guarded against the stinginess of his soul, then they are those who are prosperous.

O' you who believe! When you consult the Messenger then advance sadaqah / the charity that is between two hands of your consultation. (i.e. any amount according to your means). That is better and purer for you, so if you do not find (to advance sadaqah / charity), then surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
And other people, they have confessed with their sins, they have mixed correct acts and other bad (acts), it may be that Allah will return over them. Surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

Take sadaqah / the charity (i.e. any amount according to the means), from their wealth so that you purify them and justify them with it and pray over them. Surely your prayer is a satisfaction for them and Allah is Listener, Knowledgeable.
Then eat from whatever your (4/5th of the) ghanim / profit which is halal / lawful, tayyab / good and take guard of Allah. Surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
And definitely We will test you with something from fear and hunger and loss from the wealth and selves / souls / psyches and the fruits. And give good news to those who are patient.
Those when misfortune (i.e. the trial) reaches them, they say surely we are for Allah and surely towards Him we return.
They are those on whom are prayers and mercy from their Lord. And they are those who are the guided ones.

Do they not know that Allah is He who accepts the repentance from His servants and He takes sadaqat / the charities (i.e.1/5 of the ghanim / profit and any amount according to the means), and that Allah is He, Who is the Returning, the Merciful.

Do you feel pity that you advance sadaqat / the charities between two hands (i.e. any amount according to the means), of your consultation. So when you did not do it and Allah returned over you then establish salah / prayer and give zakah / justification and obey Allah and His Messenger. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do.

Surely sadaqat / the charities (i.e. any amount according to their means) are for fuqara / those who are poor and (for) masakeen / the needy (who are reduced to poverty) and (for) amileen / those who work on it (sadaqat / charities), and (for) whose hearts are composed and in riqab / who are in slavery to pay fine and (for) fi sabeelillah / in the way of Allah and (for) gharimeen / who have to pay fine and (for) ibn-e-sabeel / the son of way, an obligation from Allah and Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise.

Righteousness is not that you turn your faces towards the east and the west (i.e. the direction of belief) and but righteousness is that who believed with Allah and last day and the angels and the Book and the prophets, and upon His (Allah) love he gave wealth (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit and any amount according to his means) to those who are qurba / relatives and yatama / orphans and masakeen / needy (who are reduced to poverty) and ibn-e-sabeel / son of the way and as-saileen/those who ask and those in ar-riqab / who are in slavery. And they established salah / prayer and they gave zakah / justification and when they promised, they fulfill their promises. And the patient in misery and harm and during the time of misery. Those are who spoke the truth and they are those who guard.
He who gives his wealth, to justify, (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit and any amount according to his means).
And from his nearness he does not expect from anyone a favor of reward.
Except seeking the face of his Lord, the most High.
And definitely soon he will be pleased.
And in their wealth is the known right (indices of the category) (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit and any amount according to the means).
For saail / who asks and for mahroom / who are deprived (among the categories).

Surely those who recite Kitab / book of Allah (with understanding) and establish salah / prayer and from whatever sustenance We gave them they spend (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit and any amount according to the means) secretly and in announcement hoping of a business that will never ruin / be useless.

The example of those who spend in the way of Allah (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit and any amount according to the means) is like the example of a grain that grows 7 ears (i.e. part of grains), in every ear (i.e. a part of grain) are 100 grains. And Allah multiplies for whom He wills. And Allah is Spacious, Knowledgeable.

Allah directs you in your children for the male is a portion equal to that of two females, so if only daughters, two or more, so for them is two-thirds of the inheritance; and if only one, so for her is a half. And for parents, a sixth share of the inheritance for each, then if the deceased left children for him; then if no children for him, and his parents are the (only) heirs, then for his mother is a third; then if for him (the deceased) are brothers then for his mother is a sixth (The distribution in all cases) after the payment of legacies and debts. You don't know, your parents and your children, which ones are nearest for you in benefit. Ordained / obligation from Allah. Surely Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise.
question_text: Q1. In which category do the parents and real brothers and sisters come? Can we share with them from the 20% percent?

english_translation: They ask you what they should spend. Say whatever you spend that is from good, is for parents and relatives and orphans and the needy and for the sons of the way. And whatever you do from good, So surely Allah is Knowledgeable with it.
And for everyone, We have made heirs to property left by parents and relatives. And those to whom your right hand was pledged, give them their portion. Surely Allah is a Witness over all things.

From what is left by parents and those nearest related there is a portion for men and a portion for women, from what is left by parents and those nearest related small from it or large. A determined / obligatory portion.
And if at the time of division other relatives, or orphans or poor are present, so feed them from it. And speak to them a recognized saying.

And test the orphans (after the age of puberty i.e. maturity / fully grown up developed in body and mind) until when they reached (after the age of puberty). Then if you become familiar (of) sobriety from them, marriage so disburse / i.e. to pay out their wealth to them and you do not eat it excessively and with hurriedness / quickly that they become older / grown up. And whosoever is rich then he should refrain and whosoever is poor then he should eat with acknowledgment / recognition. So when you disburse / pay out their wealth to them, then take a witness over them and Allah is sufficient in taking account.
question_text: Q2. Can you please clarify who comes in the yateem category?

english_translation: And give to orphans their wealth and do not change bad with good and do not eat their wealth (by mixing it up) towards your wealth. Surely it is a great sin.
And you do not give your wealth to those weak of understanding which Allah has made a means of support for you, but feed them in it and clothe them and speak to them a recognized saying.

And they seek your legal advice in women. Say Allah gives you a legal advice for them and whatever is recited over you in the book for the orphan women that you do not give them what has been written for them and you desire to marry them and (you do not give) to those who are weak amongst the children. And that you take a stand for the orphan (women) with justice and what you do from the betterment then surely Allah is Knowledgeable with it.
question_text: Q3. Is the widow and divorcee come in the 8 categories?

english_translation: You will never attain righteousness until you spend from what you love and whatever you spend from any thing, then surely Allah is Knowledgeable with it.
question_text: Q6. In Aal-e-Imran 3:92 Allah is saying that you will not attain righteousness unless you spend from that which you love. We love our children most, so please clarify how we will spend them?

english_translation: When the wife of Imran said my Lord surely I have dedicated what is in my belly, freed / liberated for You. So accept from me, surely You are the Listener, the Knowledgeable.

And (Aziz / mighty) who purchased him (Yousuf pbuh) from Egypt said to his wife, make his stay honorable, may be he gives us benefit or we take him a son. And likewise We gave power for Yousuf (pbuh) in the earth. And so that We teach him from the interpretation of the events. And Allah is dominant over His order but majority of people do not know.
And wife of pharaoh said, (this child) is the coolness of eyes for me and for you. You do not kill him. Perhaps he might give benefit to us or we take him a son. And they are not conscious.

Call them by their fathers. That is more just near Allah. So if you do not know their fathers then (they are) your brothers and protectors in the judgement. And there is no sin on you in what you made mistake with it, and but that you have intended in your hearts. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

So when she gave birth to her she said, my Lord surely I gave birth to her (as) a female. And Allah knows more with what she gave birth. And a male is never like a female. And surely I have named her Maryam / Mary (pbuh). And surely I seek refuge for her with You and her offspring / progeny from the satan the stoned.

So her Lord accepted her with a beautiful acceptance and He made her grow a beautiful growth, and Zakariya (pbuh) was responsible / took charge of her, whenever Zakariya (pbuh) entered on her in the chamber and found sustenance near her, he said, Maryam Mary pbuh how this for you. She said, it is from the nearness of Allah. Surely Allah gives sustenance whom He wills without any counting / calculation.

So we inspired to the mother of Moosa / Moses (pbuh) suckle / feed(your child) then when you feared on him, then cast him into the river, and you do not fear and you do not grieve, surely We shall restore him to you, and We shall make him from Our messengers.

Then the people of Pharaoh picked him up (from the river) (it was intended) that he (Moosa / Moses pbuh) should be to them an enemy and a cause of sorrow. Surely Pharaoh and Hamaan and their groups were sinners.

And know that surely whatever ghanim / profit you get from anything, if you believe in Allah then surely 1/5th of it (sadaqah/charity) is for Allah / God and for Rasool / the Messenger and (for) qurba / the relatives and (for) yatama / the orphans and (for) masakeen / the needy (who are reduced to poverty) and for ibn-e-sabeel / the son of the way and whatever We sent down over Our servant on the day of the division, the day when the two accumulations are met/collected (1/5th of the ghanim/profit). And Allah over everything.

And take guard of Allah. Surely Allah is strong in pursuit.

It (sadaqah / the charity) is for fuqara muhajireen / the poor migrants those who have been expelled from their circles and their wealth, seeking the bounty from Allah and good pleasure and helping Allah and His Messenger, they are those who are truthful.

And (sadaqah / the charity is for) those who settled in the circle and the belief (who migrated) from before them, they love whosoever migrated towards them and they do not find in their chest any need from what they have been given and they do not have any effect over themselves even if poverty is with them. And whosoever is guarded against the stinginess of his soul, then they are those who are prosperous.
Then eat from whatever your (4/5th of the) ghanim / profit which is halal / lawful, tayyab / good and take guard of Allah. Surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

O' you who believe! When you consult the Messenger then advance sadaqah / the charity (i.e. any amount according to your means) that is between two hands of your consultation. That is better and purer for you, so if you do not find (to advance sadaqah / charity), then surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Who accumulates wealth and count it.

And their taking of Ar-riba / the increase (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit) and without doubt they were prohibited about it. And their eating of the money of the people (of the categories) with falsehood and for the rejecters from them We have prepared a painful punishment.
O' you who believe! Do not eat / consume Ar-riba / the increase, (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit) double redouble and take guard of Allah so that you may prosper.
O' you who believe! Take guard of Allah and leave off what remains from Ar-riba / the increase (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit), if you are believers.

And what you give from riba / increase (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit), to increase in the wealth of people (the categories) then it does not increase in the nearness of Allah and what you give from zakah / the justification (sadaqah / charity i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit), intending the face of Allah so they are those who get manifolds.

And if a one in difficulty, (who eats Ar-riba / the increase) then respite is (given to him) towards easiness and that you give sadaqah / charity, (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit) that is better for you, if you know.
Allah cancels Ar-riba / the increase (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit), and increases sadaqat / the charities (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit), and Allah does not love any rejecter, sinner.
Surely the life of this world is play and distraction. And if you believe and take guard, He will give you, your wages, and He does not ask you of your wealth (i.e. 4/5th of the ghanim/profit).
If He asks you of it (i.e. 4/5th of the ghanim/profit of your wealth), then presses you, you do stinginess and He will bring out your (secret) hates.

Those who eat / consume Ar-riba / the increase (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit) do not stand except like the one who stands, shaitaan / satan makes him mad from the touch. That is because they say that Al-bai / the deal (i.e. interest of the bank) is the example of Ar-riba / the increase (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit). And Allah has made Al-bai / the deal (i.e. interest of the bank) lawful and has made Ar-riba / the increase unlawful. So to comes the sermon from his Lord then he abstains, that is past for him. And his order is towards Allah. And whosoever returns (to eat Ar-riba / the increase i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit), then they are the companions of the fire, they will abide in it.

Then if you did not do, (leave off, what remains from Ar-riba / the increase i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit), so take a notice of war from Allah and His Messenger. And if you turn back, so the heads of your wealth are for you. (i.e. 4/5th of the ghanim / profit) You do not oppress and you will not be oppressed.

Surely the reward of those who wage war against Allah and His messenger and they move around in the earth to cause corruption, is that they will be killed, or they will be crucified, or their hands and their feet will be cut off from the opposite sides or they will be exiled from the land. For them that is a disgrace in this world and in the hereafter is a great punishment for them.

Except those who repented / turned from before you (i.e. believers) evaluate / gain power over them (by guiding them that how Allah has accepted their repentance). Then know, that surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

You are those who are invited to spend in the way of Allah (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit) there are amongst you who do stinginess and whosoever does stinginess then surely he is stingy about his own self / soul. And Allah is Sufficient / Rich, and you are poor. And if you turn back, He will exchange to people other than you, then they will not be of your examples.

The example of those who spend in the way of Allah (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit and any amount according to the means for the consultation of the Messenger) is like the example of a grain that grows 7 ears (i.e. parts of grain), in every ear (i.e. a part of grain) are 100 grains. And Allah multiplies for whom He wills. And Allah is Spacious, Knowledgeable.
And from them are who say O' our Lord, give us in the world good and in the hereafter good and save us from the punishment of the fire.
Who accumulates wealth and count it.

english_translation: (Sadaqat / charities) is for the poor, those who have been restricted in the way of Allah, they do not have the capacity to strike in the earth, the ignorant calculates them rich from their modesty, you will recognize them with their marks. english_translation: It is not for a human that Allah speaks to him, except by inspiration or from behind a hijab / veil or He sends a messenger, then he inspires with His permission whatever He wills. Surely He is High, Wise.
And mention Maryam / Mary (pbuh) in the book separated from her family to an eastern place.

When Our ayaat / signs are recited on him, he says, lines of the earlier people.
By no means, but what they earned have rusted their hearts.

Then surely they will roast in hell.

And when you read Al-Quran / the reading between you and those who do not believe with the last day, (We put) an invisible hijab / veil.

And We put a covering on their hearts that they should understand it and in their ears is deafness. And when you mention your Lord, Him alone in Al-Quran / the reading they turn on their backs fleeing.

.....And that they should not show their zeenat / adornment (feelings of love & passion) except for their husbands or their fathers or their husbands' fathers or their sons or their husbands' sons or their brothers or their brothers' sons, or their sisters' sons, or their women or what their right possess or their subordinates / followers other than from men who are skillful / professional, or except those children on whom women's pudendum / genitals are not obvious and that they should not strike with their feet so what is hidden from their zeenat / adornment (feeling of sex) is known and turn to Allah all together, O' believers, may be you will prosper.

O' Prophet! Say to your pairs / wives and your daughters and the women of the believers that they should make a base from their gowns on them. That is more basic that they are identified / recognized then they will not be hurt / teased. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

And keep a link in your houses and you do not decorate yourselves as you decorated previously in ignorance. Say for the believers that they lower themselves from their insights and that they preserve their gaps / private parts. That is more justified for them. Surely Allah is well acquainted with what you manufacture / invent.

Surely that hurts the prophet, so he is ashamed from you, and Allah is not ashamed from the truth. And when you ask them for any commodity so ask them from behind a hijab / veil that is purer for your hearts and for their hearts. And it is not for you to hurt the messenger of Allah, and that after him you ever marry his pairs / wives. Surely that would be a big (offence) in the nearness of Allah.
O' you who believe! You do not enter houses other than your houses until you are familiar of them and salute over its family. That is better for you so that you will remember.

So if you do not find any one in it, then do not enter it until permission is given to you, and if you are told, "return" so return, that is more justifiable for you and Allah is Knowledgeable with what you do.
There is no fault on you that you enter uninhabited houses (hotels etc.), in it is enjoyment for you. And Allah knows what you expose and what you hide.

O, you who believe! Those whom your right possess and those among you who have not reach puberty (sexual maturity), ask permission from you three times, before fajr / dawn prayer, and in the afternoon when you take off your garments and from after the ishaa / night prayer, three times of pudendum / genitals (sexual relation) for you. Then she (Maryam / Mary pbuh) came with it to her people carrying him (Essa / Jesus pbuh). They said, O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh) without doubt you have come with an invented thing.
O' sister of Haroon / Aaron (pbuh) your father was not a wicked man and nor your mother was wrong.
And when he (Moosa / Moses pbuh) turned his face towards Madiyan, he said, soon my Lord will guide me to an even way.

Say, who has forbidden the adornment of Allah which He has produced for His servants and good things from the sustenance. Say, they are for those who are believers in this worldly life and purely on the day of judgement. Likewise We detail the ayaat / signs for the people who know.

O' sons of Adam! Take your adornment near every mosque. And eat and drink and you do not exceed. Surely He (Allah) does not love those who exceed.

question_text: Q5. You told us 'SIYAB' means clothes and 'LIBAS' means wearing. Can you confirm these meanings from ayaat?

english_translation: Stand up, then warn.
And then you declare the greatness of your Lord.
And then purify your clothes / garments.
And every time surely I have called to them, that You forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, and then seek coverings with their clothes and they persist and proudly they seek greatness.

Surely! Is it not they fold their chests. So that they may hide from Him! Is it not at time they cover themselves with their clothes / garments, He knows what they conceal, and what they declare. Surely He knows with the one of the chests.

For them will be gardens of eternity, beneath them rivers will flow they will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold, and they will wear green garments of fine silk and heavy brocade, they will recline therein on raised thrones. How good the recompense! How beautiful a couch to recline on.

And test the orphans (after the age of puberty i.e. maturity / fully grown up develop in body and mind) until when they reach marriage (after the age of puberty). Then if you are familiar sobriety from them so disburse / i.e. to pay out their wealth to them and you do not eat it excessively and with hurriedness / quickly that they are older / grown up. And whosoever is rich then he should refrain and whosoever is poor then he should eat with acknowledgment / recognition. So when you disburse / pay out their wealth to them then take a witness over them and Allah is sufficient in taking account.

And you do not marry women who associates (with Allah) until they believe. And a believing slave women is better than a woman who associates (with Allah) and even if she amazes you. And you do not let your(women) who associates believe and a believing servant is better than one who associates (with Allah) even if he amazes you. They invites towards the fire and Allah invites towards the garden, and forgiveness with His permission, and He clarifies His ayaat / signs for the people so that they may remember.

The fornicator does not marry except a fornicatress or a woman who associates (with Allah). And the fornicatress does not marry except a fornicator or a man who associates (with Allah). And that is being unlawful / forbidden over the believers.
And you do not marry from women to whom your fathers / ancestors married except without doubt whatever is passed / bygone. Surely it is an obscenity and hateful. And a bad / evil way.

It is being unlawful / forbidden on you (in marriage) are your mothers and your daughters and your sisters and your father's sisters / paternal aunts and your mother's sisters / maternal aunts and your brother's daughters / nieces, and your sister's daughters / nieces and your mothers who (breast) fed you and your sisters from the (breast) feed and your women / wives mothers/mothers in law and your those step daughters (are unlawful in marriage) in your laps / custody from your wives whom you have entered with them. So if you have not entered with them then there is no offence on you (to marry step daughters). And your sons' lawful wives from your loins / backbones. And (unlawful in marriage is) that you join / combine between two sisters except without doubt what is passed / bygone. Surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

And fortified / married from the women (are unlawful in marriage) except what your right possess, Allah has written over you. And lawful / permitted for you what is behind those (relations) that you desire them with your wealth to be of those who fortify / marry them other than those who whore / commit prostitution. Then with it whatever enjoyment you seek from them so give them their ordained wages. And there is no offence on you in what you agreed together with it after the ordained wages. Surely Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise.

O' you who believe! When migrating believing women come to you then examine them (their belief). Allah knows more with their belief. So if you come to know they are believing women then do not return them to the rejecters they are not lawful (wives) for them and nor they are lawful (husbands) for them (to the migrating believing women) and you give them what they have spent and there is no offence on you that you marry them when you have given them their wages. And you do not hold fast to the rejecter women with ties / bond and you ask what you have spent (on them). And they should ask what they have spent. That is the governance of Allah. He governs between you and Allah is knowledgeable, wise.

And from you who did not have the capability in a long duration of life to marry a fortified / married believing women (that came to you migrating in belief) then (you marry) young believing girls from what your right possess. And Allah knows more with your belief. Some of you are from some. Then marry them with the permission of their family / people and give them their wages with recognition to those women who are fortifying / marrying women other than those who whore / commit prostitution. And they are not to be of those who take confidants / intimate friends. So when they are being fortified (married women) then if they come with obscenity the punishment is half on them to what is over the fortified / married women. That is for those who fear hardship from you. And that you may have patience it is better for you. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

And those from your women who comes with obscenity then take four witnesses from you on them, then if they bear witness so detain / hold them in the houses until the death is complete on them or Allah makes a way (of guidance) for them.

And those when they commit obscenity or oppressed their souls, they remember Allah then they seek forgiveness for their guilts / sins. And who can forgive guilts / sins except Allah And they do not persist over what they did and they know it.

And those who do not find marriage should be chaste (i.e not to involve in unlawful sexual intercourse) until Allah enriches them from His bounty. And from those whom your right possess who seeks the book, so write (the marriage contract) to them if you find any betterment in them and give them from the wealth of Allah that He has given you. And you do not compel your young girls to commit wrong act / prostitution if they intend to be fortified / married, that you seek the width of this worldly life and whosoever compels them, (to commit wrong act / prostitution) then surely Allah is Forgiving Merciful. From after their having been compelled.

O' you believe! When you attain or reach a judgement among each other with a judgement towards a fixed period of time then write it down.............. O' you who is the prophet! Surely We have made lawful for you your pairs to those whom you gave their wages and (made lawful) what your right possess from what Allah has bestowed on you. This is exclusively for you Without doubt We know what We have ordained over them in their pairs / wives and what their right possess. So that there is no difficulty over you and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

The day the goodness are being made lawful for you. And the food is lawful for you of those who were given the book and your food is lawful for them. And (lawful are) from the fortified / married believing women and the fortified / married women from those who were given the book from before you (who migrated in belief), when you give them their wages to be of those who fortify / marry them other than those who whore / commit prostitution and you do not be of those who take confidants / intimate friends. And whosoever rejects with the belief then definitely his work is failed / wasted and he will be from the lost ones in the last.

And marry the widows / widowers from you and those who corrects from your men servants and your slave women. If they are poor Allah will enrich them from His bounty. And Allah is Spacious, Knowledgeable.

And those from you who die / completes (the soul / self / psyche) and they leave pairs / wives they will wait with their souls / selves / psyche for four months and ten days. So when they reach their term then there is no offence over you in what they do in their souls / selves / psyche with the acknowledgment / recognition. And Allah is well acquainted with what you do.

And there is no offence on you from the engagement of the women in what you displayed / proposed with it or you concealed / hide in your souls / selves / psyches. Allah knows that you seek their remembrance but you do not promise them secretly except that you say a saying of acknowledgment / recognition. And you do not decide the knot of the marriage until the book reaches its term. And you know that Allah knows what is in your souls / selves / psyches. So be cautious of Him, and know that surely Allah is Forgiving, Tolerant.

And they seek your legal advice in concerning women. Say Allah gives you a legal advice concerning them and whatever is recited over you in the book concerning the orphan women that you do not give what has been written for them and you desire to marry them and (you do not give) to those who are weak amongst the children. And that you take a stand for the orphan (women) with justice. And what you do from the betterment then surely Allah knows with it.

And if you are fearful that you cannot do justice in the orphans so marry from women who seems good to you twos and threes and fours. Then if you are fearful that you cannot be equitable then (marry) one or what your right possess. That would be lowlier that you do not support.

And you do not have the capability / ability to be equitable between women even if you are eager / desirable, so you do not incline / bend inclining / bending totally (to anyone of them) then you leave her as suspended (by marrying more than one) and if you amend / correct and take guard then surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
And give the women their charities as a gift / present. So for you if they are good about anything from it (gift / present) to the soul / self / psyche so eat it wholesome pleasurable / tasty.

O, you who believe! Those whom your right possess and those among you who have not reach puberty (sexual maturity), ask permission from you three times, before fajr / dawn prayer, and in the afternoon when you take off your garments and from after the ishaa / night prayer, three times of pudendum / genitals (sexual relation) for you. Apart from these (timings), there is no fault on you or on them that you move about to one another. Likewise Allah clarifies ayaat / signs for you. And Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise.

And the foundations from women are such that they (men / husbands) do not hope marriage / sexual intercourse so there is no offence on them (i.e women) that they take off their clothes / garments (at the three times of pudendum / genitals sexual relation) other than / though they are decorative women with adornment and that they remain chaste / refraining that is better for them. And Allah is Listener, Knowledgeable.
And when he (Moosa / Moses pbuh) turned his face towards Madiyan, he said, soon my Lord will guide me to an even way.

He said, what is the matter with you? They said, we do not water (our flocks) until the shepherds drive off and our father is very old.
So he watered / gave drink for both of them then he turned away towards a shade then he said, my Lord surely for what I am poor / needy you have revealed towards me from betterment.

Then one of them came to him (i.e. Moses pbuh). She walks over shyness she said, surely my father invites you that he rewards you a wage of what you watered / gave drink for us. So when he came to him and he related / narrated over him the relationship / narration. He said you do not fear you have been saved from the people who are oppressors.
One of them said , surely it is better you hire who is strong and the trustworthy.

He said surely I intend to marry from one of my these two daughters with you on that you will be hired to me for eight pilgrimages. So if you complete ten then it is on you. And I do not intend to make hardship on you. If Allah wills soon you will find me from those who correct themselves.
He (Moses pbuh) said, that is between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I completed, so there will be no enmity on me. And Allah is an advocate over what we say.

And keep a link in your houses and you do not decorate yourselves as you decorated previously in ignorance. question_text: Q2.Can you clarify the difference between wives and those whom your right possess in surah Mominoon 23 verse 5 & 6?

english_translation: Except over their wives or those whom their right possess. Then surely they are other than those who are blamed.
And whosoever seeks other than that so they are those who are transgressors.
Except over their wives or those whom their right possess. Then surely they are other than those who are blamed.

And from His ayaat / signs is that He created for you pairs from your souls, so that you take satisfaction towards them and He has put love and mercy between you. Surely in that are ayaat / signs for people who consider.

O' mankind! Surely Allah loves those who return and He loves purified ones.

Your women are cultivated land for you so come to your cultivated land how you will / like and advance (good deeds) for your souls / selves / psyches and take guard of Allah and know that you are going to meet Him and give the good news to the believers.

And We gave testimony to man to be nice with his parents. His mother carried / pregnant with him dislikingly and she placed / gave birth to him dislikingly. And his carrying and his weaning / separation is thirty months.....
And the mothers suckle / nourish their children completing two surroundings / periods....
And you do not kill your children from the fear of poverty. We give sustenance to them and to you. Surely their killing is a big mistake.

The men are those who take a stand over the women with what Allah has given the bounty to any one of them over the other and with what they spend from their wealth. So women who correct and who are devout and are preservers in the absent with what Allah has preserved. And those women whom you fear of their jarring / emotional shock then sermon them, and abandon them in the beds and strike them, so if they obey you then do not seek over them a way. Surely Allah is High, Great.

So When you meet those who reject then striking of the necks, until you are thick to them then tie firmly. Then after that either a favour and either taking ransom until the war lays down its burdens. That is, if Allah wills He would have given help from them but He tries some of you with some. And those who were being killed in the way of Allah then He will never astray their deeds / actions.
Soon He will guide them and He will correct their condition.
And He will enter them into the garden, He made it known for them.
O' you who believe! If you help Allah He (Allah) will help you and make your feet firm.
And those who reject, so misery is for them and He (Allah) astrayed their deeds.
Surely those who turned on their backs from after the guidance has become clarified for them, the satan tempted for them and gave false hopes for them.

When your Lord inspires towards the angels, surely I am with you, so make firm those who believe. Soon I will put the fright in the hearts of those who reject, so strike on the neck and strike on every fingertips from them.

O' you who believe! Obey Allah and obey the messenger and obey the one who gives the order from you. So if you disputed in anything, so return it to Allah and the messenger if you believe with Allah and the last day. That is better and the most beautiful interpretation.

O' you who believe! Avoid much of suspicion, surely some suspicion is a sin and you do not spy and do not backbite one another. Would any one of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? So you would dislike it and take guard of Allah. Surely Allah is Returning, Merciful.

O' you who believe! If a liberal / immoral person comes to you with a prophecy, so seek clarification that you may reach people (the prophecy) with ignorance then you begin the day regretting over what you have done.

And those who throw / put a charge on guarded / married women then they do not come with four witnesses, so flog them with eighty stripes and do not ever accept their witness. And they are those who are the liberals.

And those who throw / put a charge on their wives / pairs and do not have witnesses for them except themselves, so the evidence of them alone is the bearing of witness four times with Allah, Surely that he is from the truthful ones.
And the (bearing of witness) fifth time that curse of Allah be over him if he is from the liars.
And He (Allah) will avert punishment from her if she witnesses four times by bearing witness with Allah, that surely he is from the liars.
And the (bearing of witness) fifth time that the anger of Allah be over her if he (her husband) is from the truthful ones.

O' you believe! When you attain or reach a judgement among each other with a judgement towards a fixed period of time then write it down...... And take two witnesses from your men then if there are no two men then take one man and two women from the witnesses from whom you are pleased, that if one of the two women astrays then the other reminds her.....

O' you who believe! It is not lawful for you to inherit women in disliking and do not become difficult for them that you may go off with a part of what you have given to them except that they come with a clear obscenity and accompany them with recognition, then if you dislike them (due to clear obscenity) so it may be that you dislike a thing and Allah has made much betterment in it.

And those from your women who comes with obscenity then take four witnesses from you on them, then if they bear witness so detain / hold them in the houses until the death is complete on them or Allah makes a way (of guidance) for them.
Surely your Lord spreads the sustenance for whom He (Allah) wants and He proportionates. Surely your Lord is Aware, Insightful with His servants.

And if you intend to change the place of a wife with another wife and you have given heaps to one of them so you do not take anything from that. Will you take it with false accusation and a clear sin?

And if a wife feared from her husband of the jarring / emotional shock or of being avoided / reluctant then there is no sin on both of them that they should amend / correct between themselves (for correction) and amendment is better. And the souls / selves/psyches are present to stinginess (reluctant to spend or give or share in wealth etc.) And if you do good and take guard so surely Allah is Acquainted with what you do.

And they seek your legal advice in women. Say Allah gives you a legal advice in them and whatever is recited over you in the book in the orphan women that you do not give them what has been written for them and you desire to marry them and (you do not give) to those who are weak amongst the children. And that you take a stand for the orphans (women) with justice and what you do from the betterment then surely Allah is Knowledgeable with it.

And if you are fearful that you cannot do justice in the orphans, so marry from women who seems good to you twos and threes and fours. Then if you are fearful that you cannot be equitable then (marry) one or what your rights possess. That would be lowlier that you do not support.

And you do not have the capability / ability to be equitable between women even if you are eager / desirable so you do not incline / bend inclining / bending totally (to anyone them) then you leave her as suspended (by marrying more than one) and if you amend / correct and take guard then surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

And if you fear of disunity between both of them then appoint a governor from his family and a governor from her family, if they both intend amendment / correction Allah will put harmony between both of them. Surely Allah is Knowledgeable, Acquainted.
And if both of them differ, Allah will make both of them free of need from His spaciousness and Allah is Spacious, Wise.
Do you call baal / husband and you leave the best of Creators.

O' you who believe! Surely from your pairs / wives and your children are enemies for you, so be cautious of them. And if you pardon and shake hands and forgive them, surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

Malicious / bad women are for malicious / bad men & malicious / bad men are for malicious / bad women and good women are for good men and good men are for good women. Those are free from what they say. For them is forgiveness and generous sustenance.

Surely the submitting men and the submitting women and the believing men and the believing women and the devout men and the devout women and the truthful men and the truthful women and the patient men and the patient women and the humble men and the humble women and the men and women who gives charity and the men and women who fast, and the men and women who guard their private parts and the men and women who remember Allah a lot, for them Allah has prepared forgiveness and a mighty wage.
And those who say, Our Lord, grant for us the cooling of the eyes from our pairs / wives and from our offsprings and make us a leader for those who guard.

And if you are fearful that you cannot do justice in the orphans, so marry from women who seems good to you twos and threes and fours. Then if you are fearful that you cannot be equitable then (marry) one or what your rights possess. That would be lowlier that you do not support.
question_text: Q1.Is the second marriage a mohkam / governing ayat?

english_translation: And you do not have the capability / ability to be equitable between women even if you are eager / desirable so you do not incline / bend inclining / bending totally (to anyone of them) then you leave her as suspended (by marrying more than one) and if you amend / correct and take guard then surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

And people followed whatever the satans recited over the kingdom of Suleman (pbuh). And Suleman (pbuh) did not reject and but the satans rejected. They taught people magic. And whatever is revealed on both the angels with Babil Haroot and Maroot and whatever both of them taught any one of them until both said we are captivation so you do not reject. Then from both of them people learn how to make difference between the man and his wife......
question_text: Q2.In Al-Baqara 2:102 what did people learn from the angels that created a difference between husband and wife and how can we take guidance from this ayat / sign in present time?

english_translation: The men are those who take a stand over the women with what Allah has given the bounty to any one of them over the other and with what they spend from their wealth. So women who correct and who are devout and are preservers in the absent with what Allah has preserved. And those women whom you fear of their jarring / emotional shock then sermon them, and abandon them in the beds and strike them, so if they obey you then do not seek over them a way. Surely Allah is High, Great.
question_text: Q3. Can married women work and earn money? Is there any share of her husband in her earning?

english_translation: And you do not go near fornication / adultery, surely that is an obscenity and a way to badness[cite: 250].
And you do not marry from women to whom your fathers / ancestors married except without doubt whatever is passed / bygone. Surely it is an obscenity and hateful. And a bad/evil way[cite: 250].
Surely those who love to publish / circulate the obscenity in those who believe, for them is a painful punishment in this life and in the hereafter. And Allah knows and you do not know[cite: 250].

Adornment for people is the love of desires from women and sons and heaped-up heaps of gold and silver and marked horses and cattles and cultivated land. That is the enjoyment of worldly life, and the beautiful resort is near Allah[cite: 251].
And when Lut / Lot (pbuh) said to his people (i.e. men and women), do you come with the obscenity and you have the insight?[cite: 251]
Surely do you come with sensual desire to men other than women? But you are ignorant people[cite: 251].
So his people gave no answer except that they said, drive out the followers of Lut / Lot (pbuh) from your city. Surely they are people who purify themselves[cite: 252].

They said! 'O' Lut / Lot (pbuh) surely We are the messengers of your Lord, they will never join towards you so travel with your family with the part from the night. And not anyone from you turn back except your wife. Surely it reached her what will reach them. Surely their promise time is the morning. Is not the morning near / close?[cite: 252]

And (Aziz / mighty) who purchased him (Yousuf pbuh) from Egypt said to his wife, make his stay honorable for me, may be he will give us benefit or we take him (as) a son. And likewise We gave power for Yousuf (pbuh) in the land. And We teach him from the interpretation of the events. And Allah is dominant over His order but majority of people do not know[cite: 253].
And when he (Yousuf pbuh) reached his full strength / maturity, We gave him governance (to govern) and knowledge. And likewise We reward the good doers[cite: 253].

And he (Yousuf pbuh) was in her house and she wanted to explore about his self. And she closed the doors and she said to him, come here. He (Yousuf pbuh) said, (I seek) refuge of Allah. Surely He is my Lord, He kept me in the most beautiful place of stay. Surely the oppressors do not prosper[cite: 254].

And without doubt she took interest with him and he would have taken interest with her, if he (Yousuf pbuh) had not seen the evidence of his Lord. Likewise for We turn away the badness / ill and the obscenity from him. Surely he was from Our sincere servants[cite: 254].

And those from your women who come with obscenity then take four witnesses from you on them, then if they bear witness so detain / hold them in the houses until the death is complete on them or Allah makes a way (of guidance) for them[cite: 255].
And from you if two men comes, (with obscenity) hurt both of them. So if they both repent and correct so avoid hurting about both of them. Surely Allah is Returning, Merciful[cite: 255].

And those who do not find marriage should be chaste (i.e not to involve in unlawful sexual intercourse) until Allah enriches them from His bounty. And from those whom your rights possess who seek the book, so write (the marriage contract) to them if you come to know any betterment in them and give them from the wealth of Allah that He has given to you. And you do not compel your young girls to commit wrong act / prostitution if they intend to be fortified / married, that you seek the width of this worldly life and whosoever compels them, to commit wrong surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful from after their compulsion[cite: 256].

The fornicatress and the fornicator, then lash each one of them hundred stripes and the pity is not to take hold of you with both of them in the judgment of Allah if you believe with Allah and the last day. And a party from the believers should witness their punishment[cite: 257].

The fornicator does not marry except a fornicatress or a woman who associates (with Allah). And the fornicatress does not marry except a fornicator or a man who associates (with Allah). And that has been unlawful / forbidden over the believers[cite: 257].

And those when they commit obscenity or oppressed their souls / selves / psyches, they remember Allah then they seek forgiveness for their guilts / sins. And who can forgive guilts / sins except Allah? And they do not persist over what they did and they know[cite: 258].

Recite what is inspired to you from the book and establish salah / prayer. Surely salah / prayer stops from obscenity and (from) disguised, and definitely the remembrance of Allah is greater and Allah knows what you manufacture[cite: 258].

Surely (to accept) repentance is over Allah for those who do badness / ill with ignorance then they repent from nearness. So they are those over whom Allah (accept) repentance. And Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise[cite: 259].

And there is no (acceptances of) repentance for those who do badness / ills until when death presents to anyone of them, he says, surely now I repent, and it is not for (Allah to accept the repentance) those who die and they are rejecters, they are those for whom We have prepared the painful punishment[cite: 259].

Allah strikes an example for those who reject the wife of Nooh (pbuh) and the wife of Lut (pbuh). They both were under Our two servants, from our servants who correct themselves. Then they became unfaithful to both of them so they both did not benefit from Allah and both were told to enter the fire with those who entered[cite: 260].

And Allah strikes an example for those who believe the wife of pharaoh when she said, O' my Lord! Build for me, a house near You in the garden, and save me from pharaoh and his doing, and save me from the people who are the oppressors[cite: 260].

And Maryam / Mary (pbuh) the daughter of Imran who fortified / guarded her gap / private part and We breathed into it (i.e. gap / private part) of Our rooh / spirit and she was truthful with the words of her Lord and His books and was from the devotees[cite: 261].
She (Queen of Saba) said O' my Lord, surely I have oppressed my soul / self / psyche and I have submitted with Sulaiman (pbuh) for Allah the Lord of the worlds[cite: 261].

O' prophet! When believing women come to you to have a deal with you over that they will not associate anything with Allah and they will not steal and they will not commit adultery and they will not kill their children and they will not come with a slander / a false charge inventing (for that) which is between their hands and legs and they will not disobey you in that which is known / acknowledged / recognized then have a deal with them and seek for them forgiveness from Allah. Surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful[cite: 262].
That is for him (i.e. Aziz / mighty) to know that surely I did not betrayed him with the absent and surely Allah does not guide machination / intrigue of the betrayers[cite: 263].
And I do not acquit / free (from) my soul. Surely the soul definitely orders with badness / ill except what my Lord did mercy. Surely my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful[cite: 263].

He (Yousuf pbuh) said, O' my Lord! The jail is more loveable towards me from what they invite me towards it and if you do not turn away from me their machination / intrigue I will incline (to youthful pleasure) towards them and I will be from the ignorant ones[cite: 263].

O' our Lord, surely we have listened to the caller, calling for belief that, believe with your Lord so we believed. O' our Lord, then forgive for us our guilts / sins and cover about us, our badness / ills and complete us with the righteous[cite: 264].
O' our Lord, and give us what You promised us over Your messengers and You do not disgrace us on the day of judgement. Surely you do not differ the promise[cite: 264].

And women in the city said, the wife of Aziz / mighty wanted to explore her youth about his self. Without doubt he had infatuated (foolish love) her in love. Surely We see her in clear astraying[cite: 265].

So when she heard their planning she sent towards them and she prepared a couch / sofa for them and she gave to everyone from them a knife and she said (to Yousuf pbuh) come out over them. So when they saw him and they greatened him (i.e. To make someone great) and they cut their hands (in regret what they had said earlier about Yousuf pbuh before seeing him). And they said Allah forbid us, this is not a human, this is not except an honorable angel[cite: 265].
question_text: Q1. We have heard that it is mentioned in Quran that Yousuf (pbuh) was a very handsome man. When the women saw him they cut off their hands. Why did they do it & what is the lesson in it? Can you clarify?

english_translation: He (the king of Egypt) said (to the women) what was your concern when you explored Yousuf (pbuh) about his self. They said Allah forbid us we did not know from badness / ill over him. Wife of Aziz / mighty said now the truth is manifest / come to light, I wanted to explore about his self and surely he is from the truthful ones[cite: 267].

And they both (Yousuf pbuh & wife of Aziz / mighty) raced each other to the door and she tore his shirt from the back and they both found her master / husband near the door, she said what is the reward who wanted to explore your family / wife with badness / ill except that he is imprisoned or a painful punishment[cite: 268].
He said she wanted to explore me about myself and a witness bore witness from her family, if his shirt has been torn from the front then she is truthful and he is from the liars[cite: 268].
question_text: Q2. Are four witnesses eye witnesses or witnesses of evidence?

english_translation: And if his shirt has been torn from the back then she lied and he is from the truthful ones[cite: 269].
So when he (master / husband) saw his shirt torn from the back, he said surely it is from your machination / intrigue, surely your machination / intrigue are great[cite: 269].
O' Yousuf (pbuh) avoid about this (incident) and (O' wife) you seek forgiveness for your guilt / sin, surely you were from those who committed mistakes[cite: 269].

Surely Allah is High, Great[cite: 270].
