Except those who repent after that and correct themselves, then surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful[cite: 272].

And those who throw / put a charge on their wives / pairs and do not have witnesses for them except themselves, so the evidence of them alone is the bearing of witness four times with Allah, surely that he is from the truthful ones[cite: 272].
And the (bearing of witness) fifth time that curse of Allah be over him if he is from the liars[cite: 273].
And He (Allah) will avert punishment from her if she witnesses four times by bearing witness with Allah, that surely he is from the liars[cite: 273].
And the (bearing of witness) fifth time that the anger of Allah be over her if he (her husband) is from the truthful ones[cite: 273].

arabic_text: الْخَبِيثَتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَالْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَتِ وَالطَّيِّبَتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَالطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَتِ أُولَئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ لَهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
english_translation: Malicious / bad women are for malicious / bad men & malicious / bad men are for malicious / bad women and good women are for good men and good men are for good women. Those are free from what they say. For them is forgiveness and generous sustenance[cite: 284].

arabic_text: مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَذَرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يَمِيزَ الْخَبِيثَ مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُطْلِعَكُمْ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْتَبِي مِنْ رُسُلِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فَآمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَإِنْ تُؤْمِنُوا وَتَتَّقُوا فَلَكُمْ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
english_translation: Allah will not leave the believers over whatever (condition) you are over it until he separates / distinguishes the malicious / bad from the good and Allah is not that He informs you over the absent but Allah selects from His messengers whom He wills. So believe with Allah and His messengers. And if you believe and take guard then for you is a great reward[cite: 285].

arabic_text: قُلْ لَا يَسْتَوِي الْخَبِيثُ وَالطَّيِّبُ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ كَثْرَةُ الْخَبِيثِ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَا أُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
english_translation: Say the malicious and the good are not equal and if majority of the malicious amaze you. So take guard of Allah O' the people of the core (who knows the spirit / essence) may be you prosper[cite: 286].

arabic_text: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِأَزْوَاجِكَ إِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا
english_translation: O' you who is a prophet! Say to your pairs / wives if you intend the worldly life and its adornment, then come I will give you your commodities and I will release you releasing beautifully / gracefully[cite: 286].

arabic_text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا جَاءَكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ مُهَاجِرَاتٍ فَامْتَحِنُوهُنَّ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَانِهِنَّ فَإِنْ عَلِمْتُمُوهُنَّ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ فَلَا تَرْجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ لَا هُنَّ حِلٌّ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّ وَآتُوهُمْ مَا أَنْفَقُوا وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ إِذَا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَلَا تُمْسِكُوا بِعِصَمِ الْكَوَافِرِ وَسَلُوا مَا أَنْفَقْتُمْ وَلْيَسْأَلُوا مَا أَنْفَقُوا ذَلِكُمْ حُكْمُ اللَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
english_translation: O' you who believe! When migrating believing women come to you then examine them (their belief). Allah knows more with their belief so if you come to know they are believing women then you do not return them to the rejecters. They (believing women) are not lawful (wives) for them and nor they (husbands) are lawful for them (to the migrating believing women). And you give them what they have spent and there is no offence on you that you marry them when you give them their wages. And you do not hold fast to the rejecter women / wives with ties / bond and ask them what you have spent. They should ask what they have spent. That is the governance of Allah. He governs between you and Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise[cite: 287].

arabic_text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا نَكَحْتُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ عِدَّةٍ تَعْتَدُّونَهَا فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا
english_translation: O' you those who believe! When you marry believing women then you divorce them from before you touched them, then it is not for you from the numbering (i.e. waiting period) that you number it over them. So give their commodities and release them releasing beautifully / gracefully[cite: 288].

arabic_text: الرِّجَالُ قَوَّامُونَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ بِمَا فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ وَبِمَا أَنْفَقُوا مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ فَالصَّالِحَاتُ قَانِتَاتٌ حَافِظَاتٌ لِلْغَيْبِ بِمَا حَفِظَ اللَّهُ وَلَاتِي تَخَافُونَ نُشُوزَهُنَّ فَعِظُوهُنَّ وَاهْجُرُوهُنَّ فِي الْمَضَاجِعِ وَاضْرِبُوهُنَّ فَإِنْ أَطَعْنَكُمْ فَلَا تَبْغُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ سَبِيلًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيًّا كَبِيرًا
english_translation: The men are those who take a stand over the women with what Allah has given the bounty to any one of them over the other and with what they spend from their wealth. So women are those who amend / correct and who are devout and they preserve for the absent with what Allah has preserved. And those women whom you fear of their jarring / emotional shock then sermon them, and abandon them in the beds and strike them, so if they obey you then do not seek over them a way. Surely Allah is High, Great[cite: 289].

arabic_text: لِلَّذِينَ يُؤْلُونَ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ تَرَبُّصُ أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ فَإِنْ فَاءُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
english_translation: For those who are failing from their wives waiting (period) is for four months. So if they bestowed / returned then Allah is Forgiving, Merciful[cite: 290].

arabic_text: وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ شِقَاقَ بَيْنِهِمَا فَابْعَثُوا حَكَمًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَحَكَمًا مِنْ أَهْلِهَا إِنْ يُرِيدَا إِصْلَاحًا يُوَفِّقِ اللَّهُ بَيْنَهُمَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا خَبِيرًا
english_translation: And if you fear of disunity between both of them then appoint a governor from his family and a governor from her family, if they both intend to amend / correct Allah will put harmony between them. Surely Allah is Knowledgeable, Acquainted[cite: 292].

arabic_text: وَإِنْ يَتَفَرَّقَا يُغْنِ اللَّهُ كُلًّا مِنْ سَعَتِهِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ وَاسِعًا حَكِيمًا
english_translation: And if both of them differ Allah will make both of them free of need from His spaciousness and Allah is Spacious, Wise[cite: 292].

arabic_text: وَإِنْ عَزَمُوا الطَّلَاقَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
english_translation: And if they are determine of the divorce (vice versa) then surely Allah is Listener, Knowledgeable[cite: 292].

arabic_text: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوا الْعِدَّةَ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنْ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتِينَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُ لَا تَدْرِي لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ أَمْرًا
english_translation: O' you who is the prophet! When you divorced the women then divorce them for their numbering / waiting period and calculate the numbering / waiting period. And take guard of Allah your Lord. Do not expel them from their houses and they do not expel themselves except they come with clear obscenity. And these are the limits / boundaries of Allah. And whosoever transgresses the limits / boundaries of Allah then without doubt he had oppressed his soul / self / psyche. You cannot comprehend that may be Allah will cause an incident / event after that order[cite: 293].

arabic_text: وَالْمُطَلَّقَاتُ يَتَرَبَّصْنَ بِأَنْفُسِهِنَّ ثَلَاثَةَ قُرُوءٍ وَلَا يَحِلُّ لَهُنَّ أَنْ يَكْتُمْنَ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ فِي أَرْحَامِهِنَّ إِنْ كُنَّ يُؤْمِنَّ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَبُعُولَتُهُنَّ أَحَقُّ بِرَدِّهنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ إِنْ أَرَادُوا إِصْلَاحًا وَلَهُنَّ مِثْلُ الَّذِي عَلَيْهنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَلِلرِّجَالِ عَلَيْهِنَّ دَرَجَةٌ وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
english_translation: And the divorced women shall wait with their soul / self / psyche for three readings (of menstruation cycles i.e. their waiting period) And it is not lawful for them that they hide / conceal what Allah has created in their wombs if they believe with Allah and the last day...... And their husbands have more right to take them back in that (waiting period if they intend to do correction. And for them (women) is like / similar of what is over them with acknowledgment / recognition. And for men, have a degree over them. And Allah is Mighty, Wise[cite: 294, 295].

arabic_text: وَاللَّائِي يَئِسْنَ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ مِنْ نِسَائِكُمْ إِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَاللَّائِي لَمْ يَحِضْنَ وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ يُسْرًا
english_translation: And those from your women who are hopeless from the menstruation, if you are in doubt then their numbering (i.e. waiting period) is three months and those who never menstruated and those who carry burdens / pregnant women their period is that they place their burdens / give birth. And whosoever takes guard of Allah, He will make from His order easiness for him[cite: 294].

arabic_text: الطَّلَاقُ مَرَّتَانِ فَإِمْسَاكٌ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ تَسْرِيحٌ بِإِحْسَانٍ وَلَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَأْخُذُوا مِمَّا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ شَيْئًا إِلَّا أَنْ يَخَافَا أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا فِيمَا افْتَدَتْ بِهِ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَعْتَدُوهَا وَمَنْ يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ
english_translation: The divorce is two times / twice. So hold (their wives) with acknowledgment / recognition or release with beautifulness / beautifully. It is not lawful for you that you take back from anything that you gave them except when both of them fear that they cannot establish the limits / boundaries of Allah. So if you fear that both of you cannot establish the limits / boundaries of Allah. Then there is no offence on both of them in what she ransomed / compensated with it. These are the limits / boundaries of Allah, so do not transgress it. And who transgresses the limits / boundaries of Allah then they are those who are oppressors[cite: 295, 304].

arabic_text: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُمْ مِنْ وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَارُوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ وَإِنْ كُنَّ أُولَاتِ حَمْلٍ فَأَنْفِقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّى يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَآتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَأْتَمِرُوا بَيْنَكُمْ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَإِنْ تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُ أُخْرَى
english_translation: Let the women (who are divorced) live / reside wherever you live / reside (for waiting period) from your presence. And you do not harm them so that you tighten over them. And if they are carrying burdens / pregnant so spend on them until they place their burdens / give birth. So if they feed (the child) for you then give them their wages. And confer / consult among you with acknowledgement / recognition. And if you have difficulty then other (women) feed (the child) for him[cite: 296].

arabic_text: وَالْوَالِدَاتُ يُرْضِعْنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُتِمَّ الرَّضَاعَةَ وَعَلَى الْمَوْلُودِ لَهُ رِزْقُهُنَّ وَكِسْوَتُهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ لَا تُكَلِّفُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَا تُضَارَّ وَالِدَةٌ بِوَلَدِهَا وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ لَهُ بِوَلَدِهِ وَعَلَى الْوَارِثِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ فَإِنْ أَرَادَا فِصَالًا عَنْ تَرَاضٍ مِنْهُمَا وَتَشَاوُرٍ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا وَإِنْ أَرَدْتُمْ أَنْ تَسْتَرْضِعُوا أَوْلَادَكُمْ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذَا سَلَّمْتُمْ مَا آتَيْتُمْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
english_translation: And the mothers feed their children completing two surroundings / periods for the one who intends to complete the feeding periods. And on the born (i.e child) for him (i.e father) is their sustenance and their clothing with acknowledgment / recognition. No soul / self / psyche be burdened except its spaciousness. No mother is to be harmed with her child and not the born (i.e. child) for him (to be harmed) with his child. And on the inheritor is similar to that. So if they intended separation / weaning approval from both of them and consult each other, then there is no offence on both of them. And if you intended to seek feeder for your children, then there is no offence on you when you submit / hand over what you gave with acknowledgment. And take guard of Allah and know that surely Allah has insight with what you do[cite: 297].

arabic_text: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ إِحْسَانًا حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا وَحَمْلُهُ وَفِصَالُهُ ثَلَاثُونَ شَهْرًا حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
english_translation: And We gave testimony to man to be nice / beautiful with his parents. His mother carried / pregnant with him dislikingly and she placed / gave birth to him dislikingly. And she carried / pregnancy with him, and his separation / weaning is thirty months. Until he reaches his maturity / strength and he reached forty years. He said, O' my Lord allocate / assign me that I am thankful for Your blessing that You blessed over me and over my parents and that I do correction, You are pleased with it and correct for me in my offspring / descendant. Surely I return / repent towards You and surely I am from the muslims / submitters[cite: 298].

arabic_text: لِيُنْفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِنْ سَعَتِهِ وَمَنْ قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ فَلْيُنْفِقْ مِمَّا آتَاهُ اللَّهُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَا آتَاهَا سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا
english_translation: For the one whosoever is spacious spends from his spaciousness. And whosoever is to be evaluated / measured on his sustenance then he spends whatever Allah gave him. Allah does not give a task to any soul / self / psyche except what He gave to her (soul / self / psyche). Soon Allah will make easiness after difficulty[cite: 299].

arabic_text: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ مِنْكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا الشَّهَادَةَ لِلَّهِ ذَلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا
english_translation: So when they reached their term / period (waiting period) then hold them with acknowledgment / recognition or separate them with acknowledgment / recognition, and take witness of two from you who are equitable (one from his side and one from her side) and establish the evidence for Allah. That is being sermon with it for those who believe with Allah and the last day. And whosoever takes guard of Allah, He (Allah) will make a way out for him[cite: 299].

arabic_text: وَإِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ سَرِّحُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَلَا تُمْسِكُوهُنَّ ضِرَارًا لِتَعْتَدُوا وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُ وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوا آيَاتِ اللَّهِ هُزُوًا وَاذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَا أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَالْحِكْمَةِ يَعِظُكُمْ بِهِ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
english_translation: And when you divorce your women then they reached their terms then hold them with acknowledgment or separate with acknowledgment. And you do not hold to harm them so that you transgress, and whosoever does that then without doubt has oppressed his soul. And do not take the ayaat / signs of Allah jokingly, and remember the blessings of Allah over you and what is revealed over you from the book and the wisdom He sermon you with it. And take guard of Allah and know that surely Allah is knowledgeable with everything[cite: 300].

arabic_text: وَإِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَلَا تَعْضُلُوهُنَّ أَنْ يَنْكِحْنَ أَزْوَاجَهُنَّ إِذَا تَرَاضَوْا بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ذَلِكَ يُوعَظُ بِهِ مَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ ذَلِكُمْ أَزْكَى لَكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
english_translation: When you divorced the women, then they reached their term (waiting period), do not prevent / to become difficult to them that they marry their pairs / husbands, when they are pleased between themselves with acknowledgment / recognition. That is being sermon with it for those who believe with Allah and the last day. That is more justified and more pure for you and Allah knows and you do not know[cite: 301, 302].

arabic_text: وَآتُوا النِّسَاءَ صَدُقَاتِهِنَّ نِحْلَةً فَإِنْ طِبْنَ لَكُمْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ مِنْهُ نَفْسًا فَكُلُوهُ هَنِيئًا مَرِيئًا
english_translation: And give the women their charity as a gift / present. So if they are good for you about anything from it (gift / present) to the soul / self / psyche so eat it wholesome pleasurable / tasty[cite: 302].

arabic_text: وَإِنْ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ وَقَدْ فَرَضْتُمْ لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً فَنِصْفُ مَا فَرَضْتُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ يَعْفُونَ أَوْ يَعْفُوَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ عُقْدَةُ النِّكَاحِ وَأَنْ تَعْفُوا أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَى وَلَا تَنْسَوُا الْفَضْلَ بَيْنَكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
english_translation: And if you divorce them from before you touched them and without doubt you ordained for them the ordained. Then it is half of what you ordained except that they pardon or one who has in whose hands is the marriage knot pardons. And that you pardon it is nearer for taking guard. And do not forget the bounty between you. Surely Allah has the insight with what you do[cite: 303].

arabic_text: لَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنْ طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ مَا لَمْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ أَوْ تَفْرِضُوا لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً وَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ عَلَى الْمُوسِعِ قَدَرُهُ وَعَلَى الْمُقْتِرِ قَدَرُهُ مَتَاعًا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ حَقًّا عَلَى الْمُحْسِنِينَ
english_translation: There is no offence on you if you divorce women you did not touched them or you ordain for them the ordained and give their commodities. Over the spacious according to his evaluation and over the tight fisted according to his evaluation. A commodity with acknowledgment / recognition. Rightfully on those who are good doers[cite: 303].

arabic_text: وَلِلْمُطَلَّقَاتِ مَتَاعٌ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ حَقًّا عَلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ
english_translation: And for divorced women the commodities are with acknowledgment / recognition. Rightfully on those who take guard[cite: 304].

arabic_text: فَإِنْ طَلَّقَهَا فَلَا تَحِلُّ لَهُ مِنْ بَعْدُ حَتَّى تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ فَإِنْ طَلَّقَهَا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا أَنْ يَتَرَاجَعَا إِنْ ظَنَّا أَنْ يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ اللَّهِ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ يُبَيِّنُهَا لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
english_translation: So if he divorced her (his wife) then she is not lawful for him from after until she marries husband / pair other than him. So if he (second husband) divorced her there is no offence on them that they both return to each other if they assume that they both would establish limits / boundaries of Allah. And these are the limits / boundaries of Allah. He clarifies it for the people who know[cite: 305].

arabic_text: وَالَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَاجًا يَتَرَبَّصْنَ بِأَنْفُسِهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيمَا فَعَلْنَ فِي أَنْفُسِهِنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
english_translation: And those who are being completed died (his soul) from you and they leave pairs / wives, they (wives) wait with their souls / selves four months and ten days (waiting period). So when they reach their term / period then there is no offence on you in what they did in their souls / selves / psyches with acknowledgement / recognition. And Allah is acquainted with what you do[cite: 306].

arabic_text: وَالَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَاجًا وَصِيَّةً لِأَزْوَاجِهِمْ مَتَاعًا إِلَى الْحَوْلِ غَيْرَ إِخْرَاجٍ فَإِنْ خَرَجْنَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي مَا فَعَلْنَ فِي أَنْفُسِهِنَّ مِنْ مَعْرُوفٍ وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
english_translation: And those who are being completed / died from you and they leave pairs / wives, a testimony for their pairs / wives commodities towards a surrounding (i.e four months and ten days) without expelling (them). So if they go out there is no offence on you in what they did in their souls / selves / psyches from acknowledgement / recognition. And Allah is Mighty, Wise[cite: 306].

arabic_text: وَابْتَلُوا الْيَتَامَى حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغُوا النِّكَاحَ فَإِنْ آنَسْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ رُشْدًا فَادْفَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوهَا إِسْرَافًا وَبِدَارًا أَنْ يَكْبَرُوا وَمَنْ كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ وَمَنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ فَإِذَا دَفَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فَأَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِمْ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ حَسِيبًا
english_translation: And test the orphans (after the age of puberty i.e. maturity / fully grown up develop in body and mind) until when they reach marriage (after the age of puberty). Then if you are familiar sobriety from them so disburse / i.e. to pay out their wealth to them and you do not eat it excessively and with hurriedness / quickly that they are older / grown up. And whosoever is rich then he should refrain and whosoever is poor then he should eat with acknowledgement / recognition. So when you disburse / pay out their wealth to them then take a witness over them and Allah is sufficient in taking account[cite: 311].
question_text: Q1. Can a man or woman take divorce other then the four conditions which you have mentioned in your lecture. For example if anyone of them is insane?

arabic_text: وَاللَّاتِي يَأْتِينَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مِنْ نِسَائِكُمْ فَاسْتَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةً مِنْكُمْ فَإِنْ شَهِدُوا فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ فِي الْبُيُوتِ حَتَّى يَتَوَفَّاهُنَّ الْمَوْتُ أَوْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلًا
english_translation: And those from your women who comes with obscenity then take four witnesses amongst you on them, then if they bear witness so detain them in the houses until the death is complete on them or Allah will set a way for them[cite: 312].

arabic_text: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا فَاحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوا لِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَنْ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا عَلَى مَا فَعَلُوا وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
english_translation: And those when they commit obscenity or oppressed their souls / selves / psyches, they remember Allah then they seek forgiveness for their guilts / sins. And who will forgive guilts / sins except Allah? And they did not persist over what they did and they know it[cite: 312, 313].
question_text: Q2. If the husband commits extra marital affair, then what should women do? Can she takes divorce?

arabic_text: الزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِي فَاجْلِدُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُمْ بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَْليَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَائِفَةٌ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
english_translation: The fornicatress and the fornicator then lash each one of them hundred stripes and the pity do not take hold of you with them in the judgment of Allah if you believe with Allah and the last day. And a party from the believers bear witness their punishment[cite: 313].
question_text: Q3. If the wife commits extra marital affair then should husband divorce her?

arabic_text: الزَّانِي لَا يَنْكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةً وَالزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنْكِحُهَا إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌ وَحُرِّمَ ذَلِكَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
english_translation: The fornicator does not marry except a fornicatress or a woman who associates (with Allah). And the fornicatress does not marry except a fornicator or a man who associates (with Allah). And that is being unlawful / forbidden over the believers[cite: 314].

arabic_text: وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأُحِلَّ لَكُمْ مَا وَرَاءَ ذَلِكُمْ أَنْ تَبْتَغُوا بِأَمْوَالِكُمْ مُحْصِنِينَ غَيْرَ مُسَافِحِينَ فَمَا اسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ بِهِ مِنْهُنَّ فَآتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيمَا تَرَاضَيْتُمْ بِهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ الْفَرِيضَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
english_translation: And fortified / married from the women (are unlawful in marriage) except what your right possess, Allah has written over you. And lawful / permitted for you what is behind those (relations) that you desire them with your wealth to be of those who fortify / marry them other than those who whore / commit prostitution. Then with it whatever enjoyment you seek from them so give them their ordained wages. And there is no offence on you in what you agreed together with it after the ordained wages. Surely Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise[cite: 315].
question_text: Q4. Is Mutaa / temporary marriage allowed in Islam?

arabic_text: اعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا الْحَيُوةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهُوَ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرُ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرُ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَوْلَادِ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ الْكُفَّارَ نَاتُه ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَهُ مُصْفَرًا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَامًا و في الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانٌ وَمَا الحيوة الدنيا الأَمَتَاعُ الْغُرُورِ
english_translation: Surely know that life of the world is play and amusement and adornment and boasting between yourself and the multiplication in wealth and children is like an exampl of rain, it's aid amazes the farmers / disbelievers, then it grows then you see that it turns yellow then it becomes broken into fragments. And in the hereafter there is severe punishment and a forgiveness and pleasure from Allah. And life of the world is nothing except the commodity of the delusion / enjoyment[cite: 239].

arabic_text: يَأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تُلْهِكُمْ أَمْوَائِكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ عَنْ ذِكر الله وَمَنْ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْخَسِرُونَ
english_translation: O' you who believe! Let not your wealth and your children distract you about the remembrance of Allah. And whosoever does that, then they are those who are losers[cite: 240].

arabic_text: وَمَا أَمْوَالَكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ بِالَّتِي تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِنْدَ نَا زُلْفَى الا مَنْ آمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَأُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَاءُ الضَّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَهُمْ فِي الْغُرُفْتِ آمِنُونَ
english_translation: And neither your wealth and nor your children can bring you in nearness to Us except who believed and did correct deeds. So they are those for whom there is double reward for what they did, and they are secure in the rooms[cite: 240].

arabic_text: وَاسْتَفْزِزُ مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ مِنْهُمْ بِصَوْتِكَ وَاجْلِبُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِخَيْلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكَهُمْ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَوْلَادِ وَعِدُهُمْ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ الشَّيْطَنُ الأَغْرُورًا
english_translation: And you can stir up/excite from them on whom you have ability with your voice and import on them with your thought and your masculine manners and be their partner in wealth and children and promise them. And satan promises them nothing except delusion[cite: 240].

arabic_text: وَكَذَلِكَ زَيَّنَ لِكَثِيرِ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ قَتْلَ أَوْلَادِهِمْ شُرَكَاؤُهُمْ لِيُرْدُوهُمْ وَلِيَلْبِسُوا عَلَيْهِمْ دِينَهُمْ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا فَعَلُوهُ فَذَرُهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ
english_translation: And likewise for many mushriks / associates their associaters (with Allah) have made alluring / adornment the killing of their children to destroy them to clothe their judgement on them. And if Allah had willed they would not have done it so leave them and whatever they are inventing[cite: 241].

arabic_text: مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ امْثَالِهَا وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَى الَّا مِثْلَهَا وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
english_translation: Whosoever comes with goodness, for him is ten times like it, and whosoever comes with badness, then he will not be rewarded except its likeness, and they will not be oppressed[cite: 241].

arabic_text: يَاتُهَا النبي إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنْتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَى ان لا يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَسْرِ قُنَ وَلَا يَزْنِينَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ وَلَا يَأْتِينَ بِبُهْتَانِ يَفْتَرِينَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِنَّ وَأَرْجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعْصِينَكَ فِي مَعْرُوفِ فَبَايِعُهُنَّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُنَّ الله إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
english_translation: O' prophet! When believing women come to you to have a deal with you over that, they will not associate anything with Allah and they will not steal and they will not commit adultery and they will not kill their children and they will not come with a slander / a false charge inventing (for that) which is between their hands and their legs and they will not disobey you in that which is known / acknowledged, then have a deal with them and seek forgiveness for them from Allah. Surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful[cite: 242].

arabic_text: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلَادَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ إِمْلَاقِ نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ إِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْاً كَبِيرًا
english_translation: And you do not kill your children from the fear of poverty. We give sustenance to them and to you. Surely their killing is a big mistake[cite: 242].

arabic_text: يَايُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَادِكُمْ عَدُوَّالَكُمْ فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ وَإِنْ تَعْفُوا وَتَصْفَحُوا وَتَغْفِرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
english_translation: O' you who believe! Surely amongst your pairs / wives and your children are enemies for you, so be cautious of them, and if you pardon and shake hands and forgive them then surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful[cite: 243].

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَاللَّهُ عِنْدَةً أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
english_translation: Surely your wealth and your children are captivation. And near Allah is a great reward[cite: 243].

arabic_text: زيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ الشَّهَوَاتِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ وَالْبَنِينَ وَالْقَنَاطِيرِ الْمُقَنْطَرَةِ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ وَالْخَيْلِ الْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَالأَنْعَامِ وَالْحَرْثِ ذلِكَ مَتَاعُ الحيوة الدُّنْيَا وَاللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ حُسْنُ الْمَابِ
english_translation: Adornment for people is the love of desires from the women and the sons and from the heaped-up heaps from gold and the silver and the marked horses and the cattles and the cultivated land. That is the enjoyment of worldly life, and the beautiful resort is near Allah[cite: 243].

arabic_text: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُمْ بِالْأُنثى ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
english_translation: And when good news is given to one of them with a female, his face is over shadowed in blackness and he is suppressed (with inward grief)[cite: 244].

arabic_text: يَتَوَارَى مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِنْ سُوءِ مَا بُشريه أَيُمْسِكَهُ عَلَى هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُ فِي التَّرَابِ الأَسَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
english_translation: He pretends / keeps secret from the people with badness what good news was given with it. Does he hold on to it in disgrace / shame or he buries it in the dust? What a bad (behavior) with what they govern / judge[cite: 244].

arabic_text: اوَ مَنْ يُنَشُوا فِي الْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي الْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينِ
english_translation: Is then who is being brought up in decoration / luxury and he is in quarrelsome controversy other than clarification[cite: 244].

arabic_text: وَإِذَا الْمَوْدَةُ سُبِلَتْ
english_translation: And when (she) the one buried alive will be questioned[cite: 244].

arabic_text: بِأَيِّ ذَنْبٍ قُتِلَتُ
english_translation: For which sin she was killed[cite: 244].

arabic_text: يبنى أَقِمِ الصَّلوة وَأَمْرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَر وَاصْبِرُ عَلَى مَا أَصَابَكَ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْأَمُورِ
english_translation: O' my son! Establish the salah / prayer and order with what is acknowledged and forbid about the disguise and be patient over what has reached you. Surely that is from the orders of firmness[cite: 245].

arabic_text: وَلَا تُصَعِرُ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا إنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلِّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
english_translation: And do not swell your cheeks with pride for people, and do not walk with merriness on the earth (i.e. like noisy in festivals with dancing and masking etc). Surely Allah does not love any deceiver, boastful[cite: 245].

arabic_text: وَاقْصِدُ فِي مَشْيِكَ وَاغْضُضْ مِنْ صَوْتِكَ إِنَّ انْكَرَ الْأَصْوَاتِ لَصَوْتُ الْحَمِيرِ
english_translation: And have purpose in your walk (i.e. a manner of behavior, conduct or course of life) and lower (yourself) from your voice. Surely the disguised / deniable voices is definitely the voice / braying of a donkey. (i.e. to make loud / harsh / breathy cry and a disagreeable sound)[cite: 245].

arabic_text: وَقَضَى رَبُّكَ الا تَعْبُدُ وَالَّا إِيَّاهُ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا امَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِنْدَكَ الْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَا أَوْ كِلَهُمَا فَلَا تَقُلْ لَهُمَا ولا تنهرهما وَقُلْ لَهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا
english_translation: And your Lord has accomplished that you do not serve anyone except (only) Him and be good with your parents. When anyone of them attains an old age one of them or both of them near you, so you do not say to both of them a word of contempt (dishonor) and you do not deprive / repel both of them and say an honorable saying to both of them[cite: 246].

arabic_text: وَاخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَقُلْ رَبِّ ارحمهما كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
english_translation: And from the mercy lower the wings (i.e. of success in life) in humility / humbleness for both of them and say, O' my Lord be merciful on both of them as they both cherished me when I was little[cite: 246].

arabic_text: وَالَّذِي قَالَ لِوَالِدَيْهِ أَن لَكُمَا اتَعِدْ بَنِي أَنْ أَخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ الْقُرُونُ مِنْ قَبْلِي وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِينِ اللهَ وَيُلَكَ مِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللهِ حَقَّ فَيَقُولُ مَاهُذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيْرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
english_translation: And he who said to his parents word of contempt (dishonor) for both of you, do you promise me that I will be expelled (from belief) and definitely ages have passed from before me and both of them seek aid from Allah, and woe to you, have belief. Surely promise of Allah is true, then he says this is nothing except lines / stories of the earlier people[cite: 247].

arabic_text: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا وَإِنْ جَاهَدُكَ لِتُشْرِكَ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا إلَى مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَانَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
english_translation: And We testified man to do good with his parents and if they strive with you that you associate with Me that you do not have knowledge with it, so you do not obey both of them. Towards Me is your place of return, then I will prophesies / inform you with what you were doing[cite: 247].

arabic_text: وَإِنْ جَاهَدُكَ عَلَى أَنْ تُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا وَصَاحِبُهُمَا في الدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا وَاتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَى ثم إلى مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأَنبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
english_translation: And if they strive with you over that you associate with Me of that you have no knowledge with it, so you do not obey both of them and accompany both of them with what is acknowledged / recognized in this world and follow the way of the one who deputised towards Me. Then your place of return is towards Me, so I will prophesies / inform you with what you were doing[cite: 248].

arabic_text: يأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُم وَاخْشُوا يَوْمًا لا يَجْزِى وَالدَّعَنْ وَلَدِهِ وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ هُوَ جَازِ عَنْ وَالِدِهِ شَيْئًا إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الحَيوة الله نيافة وَلَا يَغْرَنَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ
english_translation: O' mankind! Take guard of your Lord and fear the day when no father can reward about his son and no son can reward about anything to his father. Surely promise of Allah is true and let not life of the world deludes you. And let not the one who deludes (the chief deceiver) deludes you with Allah, deluding[cite: 249].

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْتُ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْأَرْحَامِ وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا وَمَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌ بِأَتِي أَرْضِ تَمُوتُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ
english_translation: Surely Allah has the knowledge of the hour near Him, He sends down rain and He knows what is in the wombs. And no soul / self / psyche can perceive what she will earn tomorrow. And soul psyche can perceive in which land she will die. Surely Allah is Knowledgeable, Acquainted[cite: 249].

arabic_text: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ إِحْسَنًا حَمَلَتْهُ أُمه كرها وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْها وَحَمْلُهُ وَفِصْلَهُ تَلثُونَ شَهْرًا حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَى وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي إلى تبت اليك وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
english_translation: And We gave testimony to man to be nice / beautiful with his parents. His mother carried / pregnant with him dislikingly and she placed / gave birth to him dislikingly. And she carried / pregnancy with him, and his separation / weaning is thirty months. Until he reaches his maturity / strength and he reached forty years. He said O' my Lord, allocate / assign me that I am thankful for Your blessing that You blessed over me and over my parents and that I do correction You are pleased with it and correct for me in my offspring / descendant. Surely I return / repent towards You and surely I am from the muslims / submitters[cite: 250].

arabic_text: وَالْوَالِدَاتُ يُرْضِعْنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ
english_translation: And mothers feed their children for two complete surroundings[cite: 250]...

arabic_text: يَأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لا تَتَّخِذُوا أَبَاءكُمْ وَإِخْوَانَكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ إِنِ اسْتَحَبُّوا الْكُفْرَ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّهُمْ مِنْكُم فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الظَّلِمُونَ
english_translation: O' you who believe! Do not take your fathers / ancestors and your brothers as protectors if they seek to love rejection over belief (i.e. ad-deen / the judgment of Al-Islam / to attain peace). And whosoever from you takes them as protectors then they are the oppressors[cite: 251].

arabic_text: قُلْ إِنْ كَانَ آبَاؤُكُمْ وَابْنَاؤُكُمْ وَإِخْوَانُكُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُكُمْ وَعَشِيرَتكُم وَامْوَالُ اقْتَرَفْتُمُوهَا وَتِجَارَةٌ تَخْشُونَ كَسَادَهَا وَمَسْكِنُ تَرْضَوْنَهَا أَحَبَّ إِلَيْكُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَجَهَادٍ فِي سَبِيلِهِ فَتَرَبَّصُوا حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ اللَّهُ بِأَمْرِهِ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَسِقِينَ
english_translation: Say, if your fathers / ancestors and your sons and your brothers and your pairs / wives and your relatives and the wealth to which you are committed you fear a slump and the business in which and the residences in which you are pleased, you have more love towards them than Allah and His messenger and jihad / to strive in His way then you wait until Allah comes with His order. And Allah does not guide the people who are liberals[cite: 251].

arabic_text: وَنَادَى نُوح رَبَّة فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ابْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِي وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقِّ وَأَنْتَ أَحْكَمُ الْحَكِمِينَ
english_translation: And Nooh (pbuh) called his Lord so he said, O' my Lord, surely my son is from my family and surely Your promise is true and You are the best Governor of the governors[cite: 252].

arabic_text: قَالَ يَنُوحُ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ إِنَّهُ عَمَلَ غَيْرُ صَالح فَلا تَسكُن مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ إِنِّي أَعِظُكَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْجِهِلِينَ
english_translation: He said O' Nooh (pbuh)! Surely he (your son) is not from your family. Surely his deed is not corrected one so do not question Me what you do not have any knowledge with it. Surely I sermon you that you will become from the ignorants[cite: 252].

arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ والا تَغْفِرُ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُنْ مِنَ الْخَسِرِينَ
english_translation: He (Nooh pbuh) said, my Lord surely I seek refuge with You that I question You with that I do not have any knowledge with it. And if You do not forgive me and do not have mercy on me I will become from the lost ones[cite: 252].

arabic_text: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّلِمِينَ الأَتَبَارًا
english_translation: O' my Lord forgive me and my parents and for the one who entered my house as a believer and for the believing men and the believing women. And You do not increase the oppressors except in destruction[cite: 253].

arabic_text: إذْ قَالَ لا بَيهِ يَابَتِ لمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِي عَنْكَ شَيًّا يَابَتِ إِنِّي قَدْ جَاءَنِي مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَالَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَتَّبِعْنِي أَهْدِكَ صِرَاطًا سَوِيًّا
english_translation: When he (Ibraheem pbuh) said to his father, O' my father, why do you serve those who do not listen and do not have insight. And they cannot enrich you about anything. Surely O' my father! Without doubt there has come to me from the knowledge what did not come to you. So follow me, I will guide you on an even way[cite: 253].

arabic_text: يَابَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ الشَّيْطَنَ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَنَ كَانَ الرَّحْمَنِ عَصِيَّا
english_translation: O' my father! Do not serve satan. Surely the satan is disobedient for the most Gracious[cite: 253].

arabic_text: يَابَتِ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يَمْسَكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ الرَّحْمَنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَنِ وَلِيًّا
english_translation: O' my father! Surely I fear the punishment that touches you from the most Gracious so you will become a protector for satan[cite: 254].

arabic_text: قَالَ أَراغب أَنْتَ عَنْ الهَتِي يَا بُرْهِيمُ لَينْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ وَاهْجُرُ نِي مَلِيًّا
english_translation: He (Ibraheem's pbuh father) said, do you detest / dislike about my gods O' Ibraheem (pbuh)? If you do not stop I will definitely stone you and leave me for a long time[cite: 254].

arabic_text: قَالَ سَلم عَلَيْكَ اسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِي حَفِيَّا
english_translation: He (Ibraheem pbuh) said peace be on to you. Soon I will seek forgiveness for you from my Lord. Surely He is affectionate with me[cite: 254].

arabic_text: واغْفِر لابي إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ
english_translation: And forgive my father surely he was from those who were astray[cite: 255].

arabic_text: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلوة وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
english_translation: My Lord, make me one who establishes salah / prayer, and also from my offsprings, our Lord, You accept my call[cite: 255].

arabic_text: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
english_translation: Our Lord, have forgiveness for me and for my parents and for the believers when the day of account is established[cite: 255].

arabic_text: قَالُوا يَا بَانَا اسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا خَطِينَ
english_translation: They said O' our father, seek for us forgiveness for our sins. Surely we are the ones who commit mistake[cite: 256].

arabic_text: قال سوف اسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
english_translation: He (Yaqoob pbuh) said, soon I will seek forgiveness for you from my Lord. Surely He (Allah) is the Forgiving, the Merciful[cite: 256].

arabic_text: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّتِنَا قرَّةَ أَعْيُنِ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
english_translation: And those who say, O' our Lord, grant for us the cooling of eyes from our pairs / wives and our offsprings and make us an imam / leader for those who guard[cite: 256].

arabic_text: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبْرَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ واوصيني بالصلوة والزكوة مَا دُمْتُ حَيَّا
english_translation: And He made me blessed wheresoever I am, and gave me the testament with salah / prayer and zakah / justification as long as I am alive[cite: 258].

arabic_text: وبرا بوالدتي وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِي جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
english_translation: And has made me kind with my mother and never made me forceful, miserable[cite: 258].

arabic_text: يحيى خُذِ الْكِتَبَ بِقُوَّة وَآتَيْنَهُ الْحُكْمَ صَبِيَّا
english_translation: O' Yahya (pbuh), take hold of the Book with power. And We gave him wisdom in youth[cite: 258].

arabic_text: وَحَنَا نَا مِنْ لَدُنَا وَزكوة وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا
english_translation: And pious from Us and justified. And he was guarded[cite: 258].

arabic_text: وبرا بوالديه وَلَمْ يَكُنْ جَبَّارًا عَصِيَّا
english_translation: And kind to his parents, and he was not forceful, rebellious[cite: 258].
question_text: Q1. We have heard from our childhood that the jannah is under the feet of mother. Is it true?

arabic_text: وَضَرَبَ اللهُ مَثَلاً لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بيتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجْنِي مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّلِمِينَ
english_translation: And Allah strikes an example of the wife of pharaoh for those who believe when she said, O' my Lord, build for me a house in the garden in your nearness and save me from pharaoh and his doing, and save me from those who are the oppressors[cite: 259].

arabic_text: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولِ حَسَن وَاثْبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا وَكَفَلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا الْمِحْرَابُ وَجَدَ عِنْدَ هَا رِزْقًا قَالَ يَمَرْيَمُ أَنَّى لَكِ هَذَا قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
english_translation: So her Lord accepted her with a beautiful acceptance and he made her grow a beautiful growth, and Zakariya (pbuh) took responsibility / took charge of her. Whenever Zakariya (pbuh) entered on her in the chamber and found sustenance near her. He said, O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh) how is this for you? She said, it is from the nearness of Allah. Surely Allah gives sustenance whom He wills without any counting / calculation[cite: 260].
question_text: Q2. Is adoption of child allowed in Islam?

arabic_text: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اشْتَريهُ مِنْ مِصْرَ الإِمْرَاتَهُ أَكْرِي مَثْوبِهُ عَسَى أَنْ يَنْفَعَنَا اوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا وَكَذَلِكَ مَكَنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُ مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ وَاللهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَى أَمْرِه ولَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
english_translation: And (Aziz / mighty) who purchased him (Yousuf pbuh) from Egypt said to his wife, make his stay honorable may be he gives us benefit or we take him son. And likewise We gave power to Yousuf (pbuh) in the land. And so that We teach him from the interpretation of the events. And Allah is dominant over His order but majority of people do not know[cite: 261].

arabic_text: وَقَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ قُرَّتُ عَيْنٍ لِي وَلَكَ لا تَقْتُلُوهُ عَسَى أَنْ يَنْفَعَنَا أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
english_translation: And wife of pharaoh said, (this child) is the coolness of eyes for me and for you. You do not kill him. Perhaps he might give us benefit or we take him a son. And they are not conscious[cite: 261].

arabic_text: الْأَحْزَابِ ٣٣ ادْعُوهُمْ لا بَابِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللهِ فَإِن لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوا آبَاءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ ومواليكم وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا أَخْطَاتُمْ بِهِ وَلكِنْ مَا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَكَانَ اللهُ غَفُورً ا رَّحِيمًا
english_translation: Call them by their fathers. That is more just near Allah. So if you do not know their fathers then (they are) your brothers and protectors in the judgement. And there is no sin on you in what you made mistake with it, and but that you have intended in your hearts. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful[cite: 262].

They fight in the way of Allah then they kill (their souls/psyches) and get (their souls/psyche) killed. A true promise over Him in At-Taurah / The Law (i.e. Hukm/Governance of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs) and Al-Injeel / The Good News (i.e. the confirmation of At-Taurah / The Law and the Moeza / Sermon) and in Al-Quran / The Reading (i.e.the confirmation and explanation of Al-Kitab / The Book). And who completes his promise than Allah, then rejoice with your deal that you bargained with Him. And that is the supreme achievement[cite: 407].

And when My servants ask you about Me, so surely I am near. I answer the call of the caller when he called me. Then they should seek answer / response for Me and should believe with Me that they may become sober[cite: 408].

(Ibraheem pbuh and Ismaeel pbuh said), O' our Lord! Appoint in them a messenger from them, who recites Your ayaat / signs over them and who gives them the knowledge of Al-Kitab / The Book and Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom and justify them. Surely your Lord is the Mighty, the Wise[cite: 408].

Without doubt Allah has favoured over the believers when He appointed a Messenger from their souls/selves/psyches he recites over them His ayaat / signs and he justifies them and he gives them the knowledge of Al-Kitab / The Book and Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom. And from before, definitely they were in clear straying[cite: 408].

And Muhammad (pbuh) is not except a Messenger, without doubt the Messengers have passed before him. Then what if he died or killed would you turn over on your heels. And who turns over on his two heels then he can never give loss in anything to Allah. And Allah will soon give reward to those who are thankful[cite: 410].
Muhammad (pbuh) was not the father / ancestor from any of your men, and but he is the Messenger of Allah and Seal of the Prophets. And Allah is Knowledgeable with everything[cite: 410].

And those who believed and who did corrections and believed with what is being revealed on Muhammad (pbuh) and it is the truth from their Lord. He has covered from them their badness and He corrected their condition[cite: 411].

You say, we believe with Allah and what is revealed towards us and what is revealed towards Ibraheem / Abraham (pbuh) and Ismail / Ismael (pbuh) and Ishaq / Isaac (pbuh) and Yaqoob / Jacob (pbuh) and the tribes and what was given to Moosa / Moses (pbuh) and Essa / Jesus (pbuh) and what was given to the prophets from their Lord. We do not differentiate (in the revelation) between anyone from them, and we are muslimoon / submitters for Him[cite: 411].
And without doubt, We gave Moosa / Moses (pbuh) Al-Kitab / The Book, so you do not be in doubt from meeting / receiving it and We made it a guidance for the children of Israel[cite: 412].

And whosoever obeys Allah and the Messenger, then they are with those whom Allah blessed over them from the Prophets and the truthful ones and the witnesses and the corrected ones. And they are good in companionship[cite: 412].
O' Prophet! Why have you made unlawful that Allah has made lawful for you? You seek pleasures of your wives. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful[cite: 412].

Muhammad (pbuh) is the Messenger of Allah and those are with him e.theger over the rejecters, (and)are merciful amongst each other. You see them bowing, prostrating, they seek the bounty and good pleasure from Allah. Their marks / recognition in their faces / personalities is from the effects of prostration. That is their example in At-Taurah/The Law (i.e. Hukm / The Governance of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs) and their example in Al-Injeel / The Good News (i.e. the confirmation of At-Taurah / The Law and the Moeza / Sermon) is like sowing of a seed, its shoot comes out then it strengthens, then it becomes thick, then it becomes straight over its stalk, the sowers get amazed for what He (Allah) makes the rejecters furious with them (the believers). Allah has promised to those who believed and did corrections, for them is forgiveness and great wage[cite: 413].

And when We inflected / turned towards you (Mohammad pbuh) a group from the jinns / the shielded ones, they listen Al-Quran/The Reading. So when they were in its presence, they said be quiet. Then when it was completed they turned as warners towards their people[cite: 414].

They said, O' our people, surely we have listened Kitab / a Book revealed after Moosa / Moses (pbuh) confirming for what is between his two hands, it guides towards the truth and towards the straight way[cite: 414].

And from before it, book of Moosa / Moses (pbuh) is a leader and mercy. And this Kitab / Book is confirming the Arabic language, so that He warns those who oppressed, and a good news for the good doers[cite: 414].

When the truth came to them from Our nearness, they said why is not given similar like what was given to Moosa / Moses (pbuh). And do they not reject with what was given to Moosa / Moses (pbuh) from before. They said these two are magics backing each other. And they said surely we are rejecters of all[cite: 415].
And when We gave Moosa / Moses (pbuh) Al-Kitab / The Book and the criterion that you may be guided[cite: 415].
Do they not consider / ponder Al-Quran / The Reading, if it had been from other than Allah, they would surely have found in it much discrepancies/contradictions[cite: 415].
And He (Allah) will teach him (Essa / Jesus pbuh) Al-Kitab / The Book and Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom and At-Taurah / The Law and Al-Injeel / The Good News[cite: 415].

And over them We have written in it, that the soul is with the soul and the eye is with the eye and the nose is with the nose and the ear is with the ear and the tooth is with the tooth and the wounds are related. So whoever gives charity with it then that is a covering for him. And who does not govern with what Allah has revealed, then they are the oppressors[cite: 416].

A revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

When your Lord said for the angels, surely I am the Creator of a human being from clay.
When I have made him even and breathed into him from My spirit, then fall down prostrating for him.

Ramadhan is the month in which Al-Quran / The Reading has been revealed guidance for mankind and the clarifications from The Guidance and the Criterion. So from you whosoever witnessed that month then he should fast in it. And whosoever is sick or on a journey then he counts in other days. Allah intends easiness with you, and He does not intend difficulty with you. And so you complete the counting, and seek Allah's greatness on that He gave you guidance and so that you may be thankful.

O' mankind! Surely We have created you from a male and a female and We made you shuoob / nations (i.e. aggregate of persons of the same territory and language) and kabail / tribes (i.e aggregate of people united by ties of common descent, ancestry, customs/culture and traditions) so that you recognize each other. Surely the most honourable in the nearness of Allah is the one who take more guard (of Allah). Surely Allah is Knowledgeable, Well Acquainted.
And from His ayaat / signs is the creation of the skies and the earth and difference of your languages and your colours. Surely in that are ayaat / signs for those who know.

And if We have made it a non Arabic Quran / Reading definitely they would have said, why not its ayaat / signs have been detailed. What, non Arabic and Arabic? Say, it (the spirit) is a guidance for those who believe. And those who do not believe, there is deafness in their ears and over them is blindness. They are those who are being called from a distant place.
And without doubt We have made Al-Quran / The Reading easy for remembrance, then is there any that will remember?
(Allah) The most Gracious.
He (Allah) taught Al-Quran / The Reading.
He (Allah) created the man.

Then definitely I will come to them from between their front and from their behind and about their right and about their left, and you will not find the majority of them thankful.

english_translation: And never will the yahood / lenient /Jews or the nasara / helpers / Christians be pleased with you unless you follow their millah / religion. A guidance for mankind from before and He revealed Al-Furqan / The Criterion (i.e. judgement between right and wrong). Surely those who rejected with the ayaat / signs of Allah, for them, is a severe punishment. And Allah is Mighty, the one who takes revenge.
And how can they govern you and At-Taurah / The Law is near them, in it is Hukm / Governance of Allah. Then after that, they turn away. And they are not with the believers.

He has revealed Al-Kitab / The Book over you. From it are muhkamat / governing ayaat / signs. These are mother of Al-Kitab / The Book and others are mutashabehat / resembling (ayaat / signs). So in whose hearts is deviation, then they follow what resembles from it, seeking captivation and its interpretation and no one knows its interpretation except Allah. And those who are stable in knowledge, they say, we believe with it, all is from the nearness of our Lord. And no one remembers except those who possess the core.

Allah has revealed the most beautiful Hadith / the event a book mutashabiha / resembling, repeating itself. Those who fear from their Lord, their skins shiver from it.
