And We have written in it (in At-Taurah / The Law) on them, that the soul is with the soul and an eye is with the eye and a nose is with the nose and an ear is with the ear and a tooth is with the tooth and there is a relation of the wounds (i.e. physical injuries or hurt of the feelings). So who gives charity with it then he has an atonement (i.e. amendment) is for him. And who does not govern with what Allah has revealed, then they are the oppressors.

Surely We have revealed At-Taurah / The Law (i.e. Hukm / The Governance of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs) in it is guidance and light, An-Nabeeyoon / The Prophets who submitted govern with it for those who are hadoo / lenient / Jews and Ar-rabba-neeoon / the lords and Al-ahbar / the scholars (govern with it), with what they were required to become the hafiz (i.e. those who memorize from the book of Allah), and they are witnesses over it. Then fear not mankind and fear Me and do not purchase My ayaat / signs with a little price. And whoever do not govern with what Allah has revealed, then they are the rejecters.

The example of those (i.e. lords and scholars) who have been carrying At-Taurah / The Law (i.e. Governance of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs) then they did not carry it, is like an example of the donkey traveling with load. Bad is the example of the people who belie with the ayaat / signs of Allah. And Allah does not guide the people who are oppressors.

And We rhymed (the following) over their effects with Essa / Jesus (pbuh) the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) confirming from At-Taurah / The Law (i.e. Hukm / The Governance of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs) for what is between his two hands and We gave him Al-Injeel / The Good News in it is guidance and light, and confirming from At-Taurah / The Law (i.e. Hukm / Governance of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs), for what is between his two hands, and a guidance and sermon for those who guard.

And Ahlal-Injeel / people of The Good News (i.e. muttaqeen / those who guard) should govern with what Allah has revealed in it. And whosoever does not govern with what Allah has revealed, then they are the liberals.

Say O' Ahlal-Kitab / people of the Book you are not on anything unless you establish At-Taurah / The Law (i.e. Hukm / Governance of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs) and Al-Injeel / The Good News (i.e. the confirmation of At-Taurah / The Law and the Moeza / Sermon) and what has been revealed towards you from your Lord. And what has been revealed from your Lord towards you, definitely increases amongst the majority from them in tyranny (i.e. unjustly harsh, cruel) and rejection. Then you do not grieve over the people who are the rejecters.

Surely Allah has purchased from the believers their souls / selves / psyches and their wealth, (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit and any amount according to their means) definitely with that for them is the garden. They fight in the way of Allah then they kill (their souls/psyches) and get (their souls / psyche) killed. A true promise on Him in At-Taurah / The Law (i.e. Hukm / Governance of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs) and Al-Injeel / The Good News (i.e. the confirmation of At-Taurah / The Law and the Moeza / Sermon) and in Al-Quran / The Reading (i.e. the confirmation and explanation of Al-Kitab / The Book). And who can fulfill with his promise than Allah. Then rejoice with your deal that you bargained with Him. And that is the supreme achievement.

Muhammad (pbuh) is the Messenger of Allah and those who are with him, (i.e. the believers) are more stronger over the rejecters, (and) are merciful amongst each other. You see them bowing, prostrating, they seek the bounty and good pleasures from Allah. Their marks / recognition in their faces / personalities is from the effects of prostration. That is their example in At-Taurah / The Law (i.e. Hukm / The Governance of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs) and their example in Al-Injeel / The Good News (i.e. the confirmation of At-Taurah / The Law and the Moeza / Sermon) is like sowing of a seed, its shoot comes out then it strengthens, then it becomes thick, then it becomes straight over its stalk, the sowers get amazed for what He (Allah) makes the rejecters furious with them (the believers). Allah has promised to those who believed and did corrections, for them is forgiveness and a mighty wage.

And when Essa / Jesus (pbuh) the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) said O' children of Israel, surely I am a Messenger of Allah towards you, confirming for what is between my two hands from At-Taurah / The Law and giver of a good news with the Messenger, He will come after me, whose name is Ahmed / more praiseworthy. So when he came to them with the clarifications, they said, this is a clear magic.
Say, Rooh-ul-Qudus / the Holy Spirit is revealed with the truth from your Lord to strengthen those who believe and a guidance and good news for the Muslims / Submitters.

O' you who believe! Believe in Allah and His Messenger and His Book which He has revealed over His Messenger and the Book which He revealed from before. And whosoever denies Allah, His angels, His books, His Messengers, and the hereafter, then surely he has gone far astray.
A Rasool / Messenger from Allah he recites purified pages.
In them (pages) are, kutub / books / writings established.

Then woe for those who write the book with their hands, then they say this is from the nearness of Allah, so that they purchase with it little price. Then woe is for them from what their hands wrote, and woe is for them from what they earn.
We have not given them from books which they are taking lessons. And before you, We have not sent towards them, from a warner.

O' Ahlal-Kitab / people of the Book why do you argue in Ibraheem (pbuh) and At-Taurah / The Law (i.e. Hukm / The Governance of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs) and Al-Injeel / The Good News (i.e. the confirmation of At-Taurah / The Law and the Moeza / Sermon) were not revealed except from after him. Then will you not use the intelligence?

And jahedo / you strive in (the way of) Allah as the right of Jihad / striving in (the way of) Him. He has chosen you and He has made no difficulty over you in Ad-Deen / the judgment (i.e. Islam / peace) The Millat / religion of your father / ancestor Ibraheem (pbuh). And He has named you Muslimeen / Submitters from before and in this, so that the Messenger becomes a witness over you and you become witnesses over the people. Then establish salah / prayer and give zakah / justification and hold fast with Allah. He is your Protector then blessed Protector and the blessed Helper.

Surely ad-deen / the judgement in the nearness of Allah is Al-Islam / to attain peace. And those who have been given Al-kitab / The Book, did not differ except to wrong each other after the knowledge came to them. And whosoever rejects with the ayaat / signs of Allah then surely Allah is quick in taking the account.

And when his Lord put Ibraheem (pbuh) to trial with words, then he completed them. He said, I am going to make you an Imam / Leader for the people. He said, and from my offsprings? He said, My promise will not reach the oppressors.
Surely the first house placed for people is indeed that with Bakka, blessing and guidance for the worlds.

In it clear ayaat / signs, is the standing position of Ibraheem (pbuh); and whosoever enters it becomes secure. And for Allah, is pilgrimage of the house over the people who has the capability towards its way, and whosoever rejected, then surely Allah is needless from the worlds.

All food was lawful for the children of Israel, except what Israel made unlawful over himself from before the Taurah / Law gets revealed. Say bring with the Taurah / Law and recite / study it, if you are truthful.
But it is a glorious Quran.
In a memorized / preserved, loh / tablet.

And this Al-Quran / The Reading is not that can be produced from other than Allah, and but it is a confirmation that is between his two hands and an explanation of Al-Kitab / The Book, no doubt in it from the Lord of the worlds.

He (Allah) said O' Moosa / Moses (pbuh), surely I have chosen you on mankind with My Risalaat / messages and with My Kalaam / words, so hold fast to what I give you and become of those who are thankful.

And We wrote for him (i.e Moosa / Moses pbuh) in the Alwah / Tablets, sermon from everything and explanation for everything. So hold fast to it with strength and order your people that they should hold it beautifully. Soon I will show you the circle of the fasiqoon / liberals.
But it is a glorious Quran.
In a preserved loh / tablet.
And the Messenger said, O' my Lord surely, my people hold fast / took this Al-Quran / the Reading, abandoning it.

And they do not evaluated Allah as His true evaluation, when they said Allah has not revealed on any human being from anything. Say, who has revealed Al-Kitab / The Book, that Moosa / Moses (pbuh) came with it? A light and a guidance for mankind. You have made it papers, you show it and you conceal most of it. And He taught you what you do not know, neither you nor your ancestors. Say, Allah (has revealed). Then leave them in their wading sports.
And they said, why does he not bring an ayat / sign from his Lord? And did not come to them clarification of what is in the earlier suhuf / the pages.
Or has he not been prophesized / informed with what is in suhuf / pages of Moosa / Moses (pbuh).
And (suhuf / pages) of Ibraheem (pbuh) who completed.
And when We gave Moosa / Moses (pbuh) Al-Kitab / The Book and The Criterion that you may be guided.

And when his Lord tried Ibraheem (pbuh) with words, then he completed them. He said, surely I am the Maker of you, the Imam / leader for mankind, he said, and from my offsprings? He said, My covenant shall not reach the oppressors.
Surely this is in the earlier suhuf / the pages.
Suhuf / pages of Ibraheem (pbuh) and Moosa (pbuh)
A Rasool / Messenger from Allah, he recites purified suhuf /pages.
In them (i.e. pages) are established Kutub / books / writings.
Surely We have revealed the remembrance and definitely We are the preservers of it.
Nay, surely it is a remembrance.
So whosoever wills remember it.
In the honorable suhuf / pages.
Raised, purified.
With the hands of those who unveiled (the spirit / essence).
Honorable, righteous.
But from them every man intends that he may be given spread out suhuf / pages.
Nay, but they do not fear the hereafter.
Nay, surely it is a remembrance.
So whosoever willed remembers it.
And they cannot remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy for taking the guard and worthy for the forgiveness.
And surely it is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
With it, the trustworthy spirit is revealed.
Over your heart so that you (Muhammad pbuh) to become from the warners.
With clear Arabic language.
And surely it is, definitely in the earlier zubur / pieces.
And your Lord knows more with whosoever is in the skies and the earth. And without doubt, We favored some Prophets over some and We gave Dawood (pbuh) zaboor / a piece.
And without doubt We wrote in Az-Zaboor / the piece (that was given to Dawood pbuh) from after the remembrance that surely my servants who correct will inherit the earth.
Are your rejecters better from those or is there a freedom for you in Az-Zubur / the pieces.
Or they say we are victorious / successful together.
And everything they do it, is in Az-Zubur / the pieces.
And every small and big is recorded.
Surely those who are guarded are in gardens and river.
In the seat of the truth near the Possessor, Powerful.
And surely over you are the preservers.
Honorable writers.
They know what you do.
And to every mankind We have obliged him, his flight in his neck (i.e. legal moral binding). And We will take out a book for him on the day of judgement, that he will find (or meet) it spread open.
Read your book. This day your self / soul / psyche is sufficient over you to take an account.
And We have not sent from before you except men, We inspired towards them, then you ask those who are worthy of remembrance if you do not know.
With clarifications and with Az-Zubur / the pieces. And We revealed towards you the remembrance that you clarify for mankind what is being revealed towards them and so that they may reflect.

Surely, We have revealed At-Taurah / The Law, in it is guidance and light. An-Nabeeyoon / The Prophets who submitted governed with it for those who are hadoo / lenient / Jews and Rabba-neeon / the lords and ahbar / the scholars (governed with it), with what they were made to seek to memorize / preserve from Kitab / Book of Allah and they were witnesses over it. So you do not fear mankind and fear Me, and you do not purchase My ayaat / signs for a little price. And whoever does not govern with what Allah has revealed so they are the kafiroon / rejecters.
That day We shall seal on their mouths and their hands shall speak to Us and their feet shall give witness with what they were earning.

Mankind was one ummah / nation, then Allah appointed Nabeeyeen / Prophets giver of good news and warners and with them, He revealed Al-Kitab / The Book in truth to govern between mankind in what they differed in it. And they did not differ in it except those who were given it (i.e. book) from after what clarification came to them to wrong between each other. Then Allah guides from the truth with His permission to those who believe for what they differ in it. And Allah guides whom He wills towards the straight path.

And the earth shined with the light of its Lord and Al-Kitab / The Book has been placed. And An-Nabeeyeen / The Prophets and Ash-Shuhada / the witnesses have been brought forward and between them (the matter) has been ended with truth, and they will not be oppressed.
And every nafs / self / psyche has been given in full to what he did and He knows best with what they do.

Say, do you see what you call other than Allah, show me what they have created from the earth or for them is a share in the skies? Come to me with a Kitab / Book before this or effects from the knowledge if you are truthful.
And they do not come to you with an example except We came to you with the truth and with the most beautiful tafseer / explanation.
Read, with the name of your Lord Who created.
Created man out of a clot / that clings.
Read! And your Lord is most Honorable.
He Who taught with the pen.
He taught man what he knew not.

question_text: Q.1 Do we not accept the Taurah, the Gospal, the Zaboor, the Psalms mentioned in the Bible?
Q.2 How do you clarify in surah Yaseen 36:65 that the hands speak to Us and the feet give witness?
Q.3 From your lecture I understand that there is only one book containing alwah / suhuf and Zaboor / piece. Is it mentioned anywhere that this one Book was given to all the Prophets?
Q.4 In surah An-Nahl 16:44, the Messengers came to clarify for people, where are those clarifications?
Q5. When you say that suhuf are actually the tablets in your mind and it does not have to be of any specific material, could you give me the reference from where you are drawing this meaning?

english_translation: Allah has revealed the most beautiful Hadith / the event a book mutashabiha / resembling, repeating itself. Those who fear from their Lord, their skins shiver from it. Then their skins and their hearts soften towards the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah. He guides with it whom He wills And Allah leaves astray, so for him there is no guide.
We narrate over you the most beautiful narration / account / history with what We revealed over you, this Quran, and surely you were from before it amongst those who are unaware.

Certainly, in their stories/history is a lesson for those who possess the core. It is not a fabricated hadith / narration, but a confirmation of what is between his two hands and an explanation of everything, and a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe.
These are the ayaat / signs of Allah, We recite them over you with truth. Then with which hadith / narration/ event after Allah and His ayaat / signs do they believe?
Then with which hadith / narration after it (Quran) do they believe?

And did they not look in the kingdom of the skies and the earth and what things Allah has created, and that perhaps their term has come near? Then with which hadith / narration after it do they believe?
Then let them bring a hadith / narration like it, if they are truthful.
Then leave Me and whoever belies with this hadith / narration. We will draw them gradually from where they do not know.

And amongst mankind is he who purchases idle talk (talking without substance) so that he may lead astray from the way of Allah without knowledge, and he takes it as a mockery. Those, for them is a humiliating punishment.
Those who listen to the speech / word, then they follow the best of it. Those are the ones whom Allah has guided and those are the ones who possess the core.

Wherever you will be, death will overtake you and even if you are in towering fortresses. And if some good hits them, they say this is from the nearness of Allah and if some bad hits them, they say this is from you. Say, all is from the nearness of Allah. Then what is for these people that they are not nearly understanding any hadith / event / talk?
Allah, there is no god except Him. He will surely gather you towards the day of resurrection, no doubt in it. And who is more truthful than Allah in hadith / word?
So perhaps you are going to kill your soul / self / psyche with grief behind them, if they do not believe with this hadith / event / message in sorrow.
Has the hadith / event / story of Moosa / Moses (pbuh) come to you?
Has the hadith / event / story of the hosts come to you?
Has the hadith / event / story of the overwhelming come to you?

And when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a hadith / talk / event, then when she informed with it, and Allah made it known to him, he made known part of it and avoided part. Then when he informed her with it, she said, who informed you with this? He said, the Knowing, the Aware informed me.

And when you said to the one whom Allah bestowed favor over him and you bestowed favor over him, keep your wife to yourself and fear Allah, and you were concealing in your soul / self / psyche what Allah is going to expose it, and you were fearing mankind and Allah is more deserving that you should fear Him. Then when Zaid had finished with her (divorced her), We married her to you, so that there may not be any restriction for the believers in the wives of their adopted sons when they have finished with them. And the command of Allah was to be fulfilled.
Surely He Who has ordained Al-Quran / the reading on you, definitely He will restore you towards the place of habit. Say, my Lord knows well who comes with guidance and who is in clear straying.
There is no difficulty on the prophet in whatever Allah has ordained for him. (This is) sunnah / practice of Allah in those who passed away from before. And the order of Allah is a decree determined.
Those who deliver the messages of Allah and fear Him and they do not fear anyone except Allah. And Allah is enough in taking the account.
O' children of Adam! Whenever the Messengers come to you, from you relating My ayaat / signs over you, so whosoever took guard and corrected then there is no fear over them and they will not grieve.

Like this We have sent in you a Messenger from your (self / psyche) who recites Our ayaat / signs over you and he justifies you and gives you the knowledge of The Book and The Wisdom and gives you the knowledge of that you never knew.

A Messenger who recites clear ayaat / signs of Allah over you, so that he takes out those who believed and did corrections from the darkness towards the light. And whoever believes with Allah and he does corrections, He will make him enter into gardens, below it the rivers flow, they will live forever always in it. Without doubt, Allah did (granted) beautiful sustenance for him.
Allah intends to clarify for you and guide you to the sunan / the practices of those from before you and He turns upon you. And Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise.
They do not believe with it and without doubt (this was) the sunnah / the practice of the earlier people who passed away.

Say for those who rejected, if they stop, without doubt, what has gone, He will forgive for them. And if they repeat then without doubt, (this was) the sunnah / the practice of earlier people (that they do not believe with it) has passed away.

And what prevented mankind when the guidance came to them that they believe and they seek forgiveness of their Lord except there come to them the sunnah / practice of the earlier people (that they do not believe with it) or the punishment comes in front of them.
So when they saw Our misery / suffering / anguish / grief they said we have believed with Allah, Him alone and we have rejected with what we associate with Him.

Their belief will never profit them when they saw Our misery / suffering / anguish / grief. Without doubt this is the sunnah / practice of Allah that without doubt has passed away in His servants. And there the rejecters were at loss.
And if those who rejected fought you, definitely they turned their backs, then they will neither find a protector and nor a helper
The sunnah / practice of Allah that without doubt passed away from before. And you will never find a change for the sunnah / practice of Allah.

Seeking greatness in the earth and evil planning. And the evil planning does not surround except with his family. Then what they observe is nothing except the sunnah / practice of the earlier people (that they do not believe with it). Then you will never find for the sunnah / practice of Allah to change and you will never find transformation for the sunnah / practice of Allah.
Without doubt the sunan / practices have passed away from before you. Then travel in the earth, then observe how was the consequence of those who belied.

Surely He Who has ordained Al-Quran / the reading on you definitely He will restore you, (by the Quran) towards the place of habit. Say, my Lord knows well who comes with guidance, and who is in clear astraying.
question_text: Q1. How do we differentiate between the qaul / saying and fael / act of Allah?

english_translation: Seeking greatness in the earth and evil planning. And the evil planning does not surround except with his family. Then what they observe is nothing except the sunnah / practice of the earlier people (that they do not believe with it). Then you will never find for the sunnah / practice of Allah to change and you will never find transformation for the sunnah / practice of Allah.
question_text: Q2. If a person rejects the ayaat /signs, then how does it affect his family?

english_translation: And if those who rejected fought you, definitely they turned their backs, then they will neither find a protector and nor a helper
question_text: Q3. In Al-Fatah 48:22, the ayat / sign is saying, if they fought you, they will turn back. Is this physical fighting here? Please clarify.

english_translation: Surely Allah has purchased from the believers their souls/selves psyches at with that for them is garden. They fight in the way of Allah then they kill (their souls / psyches) and get (their souls / psyches) killed. A true promise over Him in At-Taurah / The Law and Al-Injeel / The Good News and in Al-Quran / The Reading. And who can complete with his promise than Allah, then rejoice with your deal that you bargained with Him. And that is the supreme achievement.

And when it was being said for them, believe with what Allah has revealed. They said we believe with what has been revealed on us and they reject with what is behind it. And that is the truth confirming for what is with them. Say, so why you kill Prophets of Allah from before, if you were believers.

And (when Allah completed the soul /self / psyche of Essa / Jesus pbuh) their saying (is that), surely we have killed the Maseeh Essa / Christ Jesus the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh), Messenger of Allah. And they did not kill him and they did not crucify him and but it was made similar for them (similarity is that they killed Essa / Jesus pbuh). And surely those who differ in it, definitely they are in doubt from it, (there is) not for them from the knowledge with it, except they follow the conjecture. And certainly they did not kill him.

Surely He Who has ordained Al-Quran / the reading on you definitely He will restore you, (by the Quran) towards the place of habit. Say, my Lord knows well who comes with guidance, and who is in clear astraying.
question_text: Q4. In Al-Qasas 28:85, Allah is saying He will restore you to the place of habit, please further explain and clarify this.

english_translation: when Allah took the covenant of the prophets, that whatever I have given you from a book and hikmah / wisdom then came to you a Messenger confirming what is with you, definitely you will believe with him and definitely you will help him. He said, have you accepted, and on that do you take my load on you. They said, we have accepted. He said, so you bear witness, and I am from the witnesses with you.
So they defeated them with the permission of Allah. And Dawood (pbuh) killed Jaloot and Allah gave him the kingdom and Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom....
And when Essa / Jesus (pbuh) came with clarifications, he said, without doubt I have come to you with Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom....

And without doubt We gave Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom to Luqman (pbuh) that you thank for Allah. And whosoever thanks so surely he thanks for his own self and whosoever rejected so surely Allah is Self Sufficient, Praiseworthy.
And when Luqman (pbuh) said for his son, and he sermons him, O' my son! You do not associate with Allah. Surely the association (with Allah) is definitely a great oppression.
O' my son! Establish the prayer and order with what is acknowledged and forbid about the disguise and be patient over what has reached you. Surely that is from the orders of firmness.

And do not swell your cheek with pride for people, and do not walk with merriness in the earth (i.e. like noisy in festivals with dancing and masking etc). Surely Allah does not love any deceiver, boastful.

And have purpose in your walk (i.e. a manner of behavior, conduct or course of life) and lower (yourself) from your voice. Surely the most disguised / deniable voices is definitely the voice / braying of a donkey (i.e. to make loud / harsh / breathy cry and a disagreeable sound).

O' you who believe! Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, and do not speak loudly to him with the saying as some of you speak loudly for some, that your works / deeds will fail and you will not be aware.
Surely those who lower their voices near the Messenger of Allah, they are the people Allah has examined their hearts for (those who take) guard. For them is forgiveness and a great reward.

And your Lord has accomplished that do not serve anyone except only Him and be good with your parents. When anyone of them or both of them attain an old age in your presence, so do not say to both of them a word of contempt (dishonor) and do not repel both of them and say an honorable saying to both of them.
And from the mercy, lower the wings in humility for both of them and say, O' my Lord! Be merciful on both of them as they both nourished me when I was little.

And if they strive with you over that you associate with Me of that you have no knowledge with it, so you do not obey both of them and accompany both of them (what is) acknowledged in this world and follow the way who deputized towards Me. Then your return will be towards Me, then I will inform you with what you were doing.
And you do not kill your children from the fear of poverty. We give sustenance to them and to you. Surely their killing is a big mistake.
And you do not go near the fornication, surely that is an obscenity and a way to badness.

And you do not kill the self / soul / psyche which Allah has forbidden except with the truth. And whosoever has been killed oppressively so without doubt, We made for his protector an authority, so let him not exceed in killing. Surely he is the one who was helped.
And you do not go near the wealth of an orphan except with what is most beautiful until he attains his (age) of maturity. And fulfil the promise. Surely the promise will be questioned.

Make a trial of the orphans until they reach the age of marriage. If then you found sobriety in them, then release their wealth towards them, and do not consume it wastefully and in haste, as they are growing up. If the one (guardian) is rich, let him claim no remunerations. But if he is poor then he can eat with acknowledgment. So when you released their wealth towards them, so take witnesses over them. And Allah is sufficient in taking account.
And when you measure measure completely / full and weigh with straight balance, that is better and the most beautiful interpretation.

And you do not rhyme (i.e to agree with the word of another person's faith) with it for that which you have no knowledge. Surely the listening and the sight and the heart, these will be questioned about him.
The badness of all that is disliked near your Lord.
That is from what has been inspired by your Lord towards you from Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom. And you do not make other god with Allah. So you will be put in hell blameworthy, rejected.

Or do they feel jealous of mankind over what Allah has given them from His bounty. Without doubt We have given the followers of Ibraheem (pbuh) The Book and Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom and We gave them a great kingdom.

He gives Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom to whom He wills, and whosoever is given Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom, so without doubt he has been given abundant betterment. And they cannot remember except those who possess the core (i.e the innermost part of anything or the spirit).

Invite to the way of your Lord with Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom and a beautiful sermon and argue with them with what is most beautiful. Surely your Lord knows more with who goes astray about His way and He knows more with those who are guided.

O' you who believe! If a liberal person came to you with a news, so seek clarification that you may reach people (the news) with ignorance then you begin the day as regretters over what you have done.

(Ibraheem pbuh and Ismael pbuh said) O' our Lord! And appoint in them a Messenger among them who will recite Your ayaat / signs on them and he will teach them the book and Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom and will justify them. Surely You, You are the Mighty, the Wise.

Make a trial of the orphans until they reach the age of marriage. If then you found sobriety in them, then release their wealth towards them, and do not consume it wastefully and in haste, as they are growing up. If the one (guardian) is rich, let him claim no remunerations. But if he is poor then he can eat with acknowledgment. So when you released their wealth towards them, so take witnesses over them. And Allah is sufficient in taking account.
question_text: Q1. In Al-Isra 17:34, it is mentioned that the person who is taking care of the orphans is commanded not to go near the wealth of orphans until they attain the age of maturity except in a beautiful manner. Can you explain how?

english_translation: O' you who believe! If a liberal person came to you with a news, so seek clarification that you may reach people (the news) with ignorance then you begin the day as regretters over what you have done.
question_text: Q2. If we do not practice the do's and dont's from the Quran, but we propagate the ayaat / signs, can we deliver the message?

english_translation: (We sent them) with clarifications and the pieces and We have revealed towards you the remembrance so that you clarify for mankind what has been revealed towards them, and may be they will ponder.
question_text: Q3. In An-Nahl 16:44 the word bayyinah / clarification of the Messenger is referred to as the book of traditions or explanations. What do you say about this?

english_translation: He frowned and turned away,
question_text: Q4. If you do not know the background of the ayaat which are mentioned in hadith, then how will you clarify them?

english_translation: O' you who believe! The requital / compensation in the killing / murdering has been written over you. The free / liberated man is with the free / liberated man, and the servant is with the servant, and the female is with the female. Then something is (to be paid / given) for the one who is pardoned from his brother. Then following is with acknowledgement and the payment towards him with goodness (i.e. to his brother(. That is lightening / reduction and a mercy from your Lord. Then whosoever transgressed then for him is a painful punishment.

english_translation: And they ask you about Ar-Rooh / the spirit. Say, Ar-Rooh / the spirit is from the order of my Lord. And you have not been given from the knowledge except little.
And definitely if it was Our will We would definitely take away what We have inspired towards you. Then for you, you will not find with it an advocate over Us.
Except the mercy from your Lord. Surely His bounty is great over you.
When your Lord said for the angels, surely I am the Creator of a human from clay.
Then when I have made him even and breathed into him from My rooh / spirit, then fall down prostrating for him.
So the angels prostrated, all of them together.
Except iblees / devil / wrapped up in grief, he sought greatness and became from the rejecters.
He (iblees / devil) said, I am better from him. You created me from fire from clay.

And Maryam / Mary the daughter of Imran, who fortified / guarded her gap / private part, then We breathed into it Our rooh / spirit and she was truthful with the words of her Lord and His books and she was from the devout ones.
And remember Maryam / Mary (pbuh) in the Book when she separated from her family to an eastern place.
Then apart from them, (i.e. her family) she took a hijab / veil, then We sent to her Our rooh / spirit. So he was an example of even human for her.
She said, surely I seek refuge with the most Gracious from you, if you are the guarded one.
He said, surely I am a Messenger from your Lord to gift a justified son for you.

And when We changed the place of an ayah / sign with an ayah / sign. And Allah knows more with what is to be revealed, they said, surely you are a forger (fabricator / inventor). But majority of them do not know.
Say, Rooh-ul-Qudus / the holy spirit revealed it with the truth from your Lord to strengthen those who believe and a guidance and good news for the muslims / submitters.
And surely it (Quran / book) is definitely a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
Revealed with it (Quran / book) the ameen / trustworthy Ar-Rooh / the spirit.
Over your heart so that you become from the warners.
With the clear Arabic language (translation / clarification of the Quranic Arabic spirit in the language of the people).

And without doubt We know that they say, surely a human teaches it (i.e. the spirit). Towards him, they profane / dishonour the non Arabic language (translation / clarification of the Quranic Arabic spirit) and this is a clear Arabic language.

And if We had made it a non Arabic Quran / reading definitely they would have said, why not its ayaat / signs have been detailed? What, non Arabic and Arabic? Say, it (the spirit) is a guidance and a healing for those who believe. And for those who believe not, in their ears is deafness and it is a blindness over them and they are those who are being called from a distant place.
And from His ayaat / signs is the creation of the skies and the earth and difference of your languages and your colors. Surely in that are ayaat / signs for those who are knowledgeable.
And if We had revealed it (i.e. the trustworthy spirit) over some non Arabic (languages).
Then he had read it over them, (i.e. the trustworthy spirit) they would not have been the believers with it.

And likewise We have revealed it (i.e. spirit / essence) an Arabic hukm / governance. (i.e. to govern). And surely if you followed their vain desires after has come to you from the knowledge, then for you there will be neither a protector nor a guardian from Allah.

Say who is the enemy for Jibreel? So surely it is (Jibreel) who revealed over your heart with the permission of Allah confirming for what is between his two hands and a guidance and good news for the believers.
Who is the enemy for Allah and His angels and His Messengers and (for) Jibreel and (for) Mikaal, so surely Allah is enemy for the rejecters.
He (Moosa pbuh) said, O' my Lord expand my chest for me.
And make my task easy for me.
And open the knot from my language (i.e. translation / clarification of the Quranic Arabic spirit or the essence).
They understand my saying.

So surely We have made it (the spirit) easy with your language (i.e. translation / clarification of the Quranic Arabic spirit) so that you give good news with it to those who guard and you warn with it fiercely quarrelsome people.

And We have not sent from any Messenger to clarify for them except with the language of his people (i.e. translation / clarification of the Quranic arabic spirit). So Allah astrays whom He wills and guides whom He wills, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
(Ibraheem pbuh said) My Lord grant for me governance and join me with those who correct.
And make for me the language (i.e. translation / clarification of the Quranic arabic spirit) truthful in others.

And without doubt We gave Moosa / Moses (pbuh) the Book and We rhymed with the Messengers from after him (i.e. is to agree with the Book of Moosa pbuh). And We gave Essa / Jesus (pbuh) son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) the clarifications and We strengthened him with rooh-ul-qudus / the holy spirit. Whenever a Messenger came to you with what your selves / souls / psyches did not desire, do you seek greatness? So a division of you belied and a division of you kill.

english_translation: O' mankind! Surely We have created you from a male and female and made you (i.e. of persons of the same territory and language) kabail / tribes (i.e. aggregate of people united by ties of common descent, ancestry, customs/culture and traditions) so that you recognize each other. Surely the most honorable in the nearness of Allah is the one who takes more guard (of Allah). Surely Allah is Knowledgeable, Well Acquainted.
And from His ayaat / signs is the creation of the skies and the earth and difference of your languages and your colors. Surely in that are ayaat / signs for those who know.
Surely We have made it an Arabic Quran / Reading so that you may use your intelligence / mind.
Surely We have revealed it (i.e book) an Arabic Quran / Reading so that you may use your intelligence / mind.
Arabic Quran / Reading without any crookedness, so that they may take guard.
A book / writing its ayaat / signs are being detailed, an Arabic Quran / Reading for those people who know.

And likewise We have revealed it (i.e. spirit / essence) an Arabic hukm / governance (i.e. to govern). And if you followed their vain desires after the knowledge has come to you, (then) for you there will be neither a protector nor a guard from Allah.
And from them are motherly people who do not know Al kitab / the book except longings / wishes and they do nothing except conjecting / assuming.

Then woe to those who write the book with their hands then they say, this is from the nearness of Allah, to purchase with it a little price. Then woe is for them from what their hands wrote, and woe is for them from what they earn.

And surely from them is, definitely, a division who misconstruct / distort their languages with the book (i.e misrepresent in translation the true spirit / meaning) so that you calculate it (spirit) is from the book and it is not from the book. And they say that it is from the nearness of Allah and it is not from the nearness of Allah. And they say a lie on Allah and they certainly know.

And they make for Allah what they dislike and their languages describe the lie, (i.e misrepresent the true spirit / meaning in translation) that surely for them is beautiful. No, certainly who committed crime for them is the fire, and surely they are those who are being excessive (i.e. In lying and misrepresent the true Arabic spirit).

And from those who are hadoo / who became lenient / Jews, misconstruct / distort (misrepresent the true meaning of) the word from its place and they say we listened and we disobeyed. And (say) listen other than the listened and (they say) observe us, twisting with their languages and piercing (to make a way) in the judgement. If only they had said, we listened and we obeyed and listen and (said) look at us that would have been better and more straight for them. And but Allah cursed them with their rejection. Then except few they will not believe.
That is Al-Kitab / the book, no doubt in it a guidance for those who guard.
And when We gave Moosa / Moses (pbuh) Al-Kitab / the Book and the Criterion that you may be guided.
That day their tongues (languages), their hands(their works) and their feet (move about) will give evidence over them with what they were doing.
When We changed the place of an ayat / sign with an ayat / sign and Allah knows more with what He reveals, they said surely you are an inventor. But majority of them do not know.
Say, rooh-ul-qudus / the holy spirit revealed it from your Lord with the truth to strengthen those who believe and a guide and good news for the muslims / submitters.
And surely it is indeed a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
Revealed with it is rooh-ul-amin / the spirit of truth.
Over your heart so you (Muhammad pbuh) become from the warners.
With the clear Arabic language.

And without doubt We know that they say, surely he is a human who teaches it (i.e. the spirit). Towards him, they profane / dishonor the non arabic language (translation / clarification of the Quranic Arabic spirit) and this is a clear Arabic language.

And if We had made it a non Arabic Quran / reading definitely they would have said, why not its ayaat / signs have been detailed? What, non Arabic and Arabic? Say, it (the spirit) is a guidance and a healing for those who believe. And for those who believe not, in their ears is deafness and it is a blindness over them and they are those who are being called from a distant place.

And We have not sent from any Messenger to clarify for them except with the language of his people (i.e. translation / clarification of the Quranic Arabic spirit). So Allah astrays whom He wills and guides whom He wills, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
He (Moosa pbuh) said, O' my Lord, expand my chest for me.
And make my task easy for me.
And open the knot from my language. (i.e. translation / clarification of the Quranic Arabic spirit).
They understand my saying.
(Ibraheem pbuh said) My Lord grant for me governance and join me with those who correct (themselves).
And make for me the language (i.e. translation / clarification of the Quranic Arabic spirit) truthful in others.

So surely We have made it (the spirit) easy with your language (i.e. translation / clarification of the Quranic Arabic spirit) so that you give good news with it to those who guard and you warn with it to fiercely quarrelsome people.

And from before it, book of Moosa / Moses (pbuh) is a leader and mercy. And this kitab / book is confirming the Arabic language, so that He warns those who oppressed and a good news for the good doers.

And likewise We inspired towards you an Arabic Quran / Reading so that you warn the mother of the cities and its surroundings and you warn about the day of gathering, no doubt in it. A division will be in the garden and a division in the blazing flame / fire.
Do they not consider / ponder Al-Quran / the Reading, if it had been from other than Allah, they would surely have found in it much discrepancies / contradictions.

english_translation: So Adam learnt words from his Lord then He (Allah) returned over him. Surely He is the Returning, the Merciful.
We said all of you get down altogether from it (garden). So whenever a guidance comes to you from Me, so whosoever follows My guidance so no fear over them and they will not grieve.

And We said, O' Adam! You and your pair stay in the garden and both of you eat from it which is ample from wherever both of you will. And you both do not go near this tree then you both will be from the oppressors.

Then satan made both of them slip about it then he made both of them out from what they were in it. And We said, you (all) get down, some of you are enemies for some. And for you in the earth is a place of stay and commodity towards a time.
Guide us to the straight path.
That is Al-Kitab / The Book no doubt in it, a guidance for those who guard.

And this Al-Quran / The Reading is not that can be produced / invented from other than Allah, and but it is a confirmation that is between his two hands and a detail of Al-Kitab/the book, no doubt in it from the Lord of the worlds.
And that was Our reasoning that We gave to Ibrahim (pbuh) (to use) over his people. We raise the grades of whom We will. Surely your Lord is Wise, Knowledgeable.

And We granted Ishaaq (pbuh) and Yaqoob (pbuh) for him. We guided all and from before We guided Nooh (pbuh) and from his offsprings (We guided) Dawood (pbuh) and Sulaiman (pbuh) and Ayub (pbuh) and Yusuf (pbuh) and Moosa (pbuh) and Haroon (pbuh). And likewise We reward those who do good.
And Zakariya (pbuh) and Yahya (pbuh) and Essa (pbuh) and Ilyas (pbuh). All were from those who correct (themselves).
And Ismail (pbuh) and Yasa'a (pbuh) and Younus (pbuh) and Lut (pbuh). And all, We favored over the worlds.
And from their fathers / ancestors and their offsprings and their brothers and We selected them and We guided them towards the straight path.
That is the guidance of Allah He guides with it whom He wills from His servants. And if they associated about them, definitely it would have failed them, whatever they were doing.

They are those to whom We gave Al-Kitab / The Book and Al-Hukm / The Governance and an-nubuwah / The Prophecy. So if they reject with it these, so without doubt We will advocate with it to people who will not be the rejecters with it.
They are those whom Allah guided, so imitate / follow their guidance. Say, I do not question / ask you of any reward over it, it is not except the remembrance for the worlds.
points_notes_eng: Imitate the guidance which the Prophets received.

english_translation: Surely this Al-Quran / The Reading it guides for which is more straight and gives good news to the believers, those who do correct deeds. Surely for them is a great reward.
(Allah) The most Gracious!
He taught Al-Quran / The Reading.
He created the man.
He taught him the clarification.
Do not move your tongue with it (i.e. Quran) so that you make haste with it.
Surely on Us is its collection / accumulation and its reading.
So when We read it, then follow its reading.
Then surely on Us is its clarification.
Surely, on Us is definitely the guidance.

It is He Who has sent His Messenger with guidance and with the judgment of truth (that is al-Islam / to attain peace). So that he makes it obvious (i.e judgment of truth) on His every judgment and even if those who associate (with Him) dislike it.

It is He Who has sent His Messenger with guidance and with the judgment of truth (that is al-Islam / to attain peace). So that he makes it obvious (i.e judgment of truth) on His every judgment. And Allah is the sufficient Witness.

english_translation: It is not for a human that Allah speaks to him except (by) inspiration or from behind a veil or He sends a Messenger, then he inspires with His permission whatever He wills. Surely He is most High, Wise.

And likewise from Our order We have inspired rooh / spirit towards you (i.e. human). You did not have the perception what is the book and neither the belief, but We have made it (rooh / spirit) a light, We guide to whom We will from Our servants with it (rooh / spirit). And surely you (human) definitely guide towards the straight path.
And what stopped the mankind to believe when the guidance came to them except that they said has Allah appointed a human messenger?
Say if angels were walking in the earth quietly / calmly, definitely We would have sent down over them from the sky an angel messenger.

And how can you reject and the ayaat / signs of Allah are recited over you and His Messenger is in you. And whosoever holds with Allah, then without doubt he has been guided towards the straight path.

Soon the fools from the people will say, what has reverted them about their qiblah / direction of belief that they were over it? Say, for Allah is the east and the west. He guides whom He wills towards a straight path.
The first house placed for people is that with Bakka, blessing and guidance for all worlds.

In it are clear ayaat / signs, is the standing position of Ibraheem (pbuh), whosoever enters it, becomes secure and for Allah is hajj / pilgrimage of the house over the people towards its way and whosoever has the capability whosoever rejected, then surely Allah is not needful from the worlds.

O' you who believe! Do not take your fathers / ancestors and your brothers as protectors if they seek to love the rejection over belief. And whosoever from you takes them as protectors then they are the oppressors.

Say, if your fathers / ancestors and your sons and your brothers and your pairs / wives and your relatives and the wealth to which you are committed and the business in which you fear a slump and the residences in which you are pleased, are more loveable towards you than Allah and His Messenger and jihad / to strive in His way, then you wait until Allah comes with His order. And Allah does not guide the people who are liberals.
Surely you cannot guide whom you loved. And but Allah guides whom He wills And He (Allah) knows more with the guided ones.
And whosoever is dim-sighted about the remembrance of the most Gracious, We barter / exchange for him a shaitaan / satan, so he will be connecter for him.
And they (shaitaan / satan) will definitely oppose them about the way and they will calculate surely that they are the guided ones.

Say, do we call other than Allah that will not benefit us and would not harm us and we turn on our heels after when Allah guided us, as the one, whom the satans made him desirous in the earth confused. For him are companions (i.e. a company of friends) they call him, come to us towards the guidance. Say, surely guidance of Allah is the guidance. And we have been ordered that we submit for the Lord of the worlds.
And when it was said to them, believe as what the people believed. They said, do we believe as what the foolish believed. Surely are they not the fools? And but they do not know.
And when they met those who believed, they said we have believed. And when they are alone towards their satans, they said, surely we are with you, surely we are mockers.
Allah is mocking with them. And He (Allah) expands them in their tyranny (unjustly harsh), they are wandering.
They are those who purchased the astraying with the guidance, so their business did not profit them and they did not become the guided ones.

Surely those who conceal what We have revealed from the clarifications and the guidance from after we have clarified it for the people in The Book. They are the ones whom Allah curses and those who curse, curse them.
Except those who repented and corrected and clarified. So they are those on whom I (Allah) will return. And I am the Returning / accept repentance, the Merciful.
Surely those who reject and died and were rejecters, they are the ones on whom is the curse of Allah and of angels and of mankind, all together.
And from the mankind who argues in Allah without knowledge, and do not have guidance and do not have enlightened book.
Bending his side in order to astray about the way of Allah. For him is disgrace in the world and We make him taste the punishment of burning on the day of judgement.
That is with what your hands sent ahead and surely Allah is not an oppressor for the servants.

Say, Is there anyone from your partners who guides towards the truth? Say Allah guides for the truth. Then is He Who guides towards the truth more truthful to be followed or is he, who does not have guidance except that he has to be guided? So what is for you, how you govern / judge?
Say, surely my Lord has guided me towards an upright / straight path, an established judgement, the millah / religion of true Ibraheem (pbuh) and he was not from the associators.
Say, surely my prayer and my solitude and my life and my death are for Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
There is no associate for Him and I am ordered with it and I am the first of the muslims / submitters.

And We will remove what is in their chests from hatred / bitterness, the rivers flow from beneath them and they said the praise is for Allah who guided us for this. And we would not have been guided, if that Allah had not guided us. Without doubt Messengers of our Lord came with the truth. And they were called, that is the garden you were made to inherit it with what you were doing.
They both said, O' our Lord, we have oppressed our souls and if You will not forgive us and have mercy on us, definitely we will be from the losers.
O' our Lord! Do not deviate our hearts after when You guided us and grant for us mercy from Your nearness. Surely You are the one who grants.

You will not find people who believe with Allah and the last day (that) they love those who transgress and even if they were their fathers / ancestors or their sons or their brothers or their relatives. Those are on whom Allah wrote the belief in their hearts and strengthened them with the rooh / spirit from Him. And He will enter them in the gardens, the rivers flows from beneath them, living forever in it. Allah is pleased about them and they are pleased about Him. They are the party of Allah. Is it not that the party of Allah, they are the successful ones?

Or for you, is there any book, from it you take lessons?
Surely in it is a betterment for you.

And with this Ibraheem (pbuh) and Yaqoob (pbuh) left the testament for his sons, O' my sons surely Allah has choosen for you Ad-deen / the judgement, then do not die except in a condition that you are Muslims / submitters.
question_text: Q2. In Al-Baqara 2:132,133 Ibraheem (pbuh) and Yaqoob (pbuh) took the testament from their sons. So can we also educate and take this testament with our children by following the footsteps of these Messengers?

english_translation: Were you witnesses when death came to Yaqoob (pbuh), when he said to his sons, what will you serve after me? They said, we will serve your Ilah / God and llah / God of your ancestor Ibraheem (pbuh) and Ismail (pbuh) and Ishaaq (pbuh), one God and we are Muslims / submitters for Him.
Again and again those who reject wish that they were Muslims / submitters?
question_text: Q3. Can you further clarify Al-Hijr 15:2 that how again and again rejecters are wishing to be Muslims / submitters?

english_translation: Say, we have believed with Allah and what has been revealed on us and what has been revealed on Ibraheem (pbuh) and Ismail (pbuh) and Ishaaq (pbuh) and Yaqoob (pbuh) and tribes and what has been given to Moosa (pbuh), Essa (pbuh) and the Prophets, from their Lord. We do not make distinction between anyone from them and wear Him
question_text: Q4. In Aal-e-Imran 3:84 it is said that we cannot make difference between any prophets. But the concept in the society is that Muhammad (pbuh) is superior than any other prophets?

english_translation: Those are the messengers We gave superiority to some of them over some. From them are those to whom Allah spoke and rafa / raised some of them in degrees.....
And surely you are on a great moral character.

Were you witnesses when death came to Yaqoob (pbuh), when he said to his sons, what will you serve after me? They said, we will serve your Ilah / God and llah / God of your ancestors Ibraheem (pbuh) and Ismail (pbuh) and Ishaaq (pbuh), one God and we are Muslims / submitters for Him.
question_text: Q5. In Al-Baqara 2:133 why Allah is emphasizing in the beginning of this ayat / sign that were you all witnesses when death came to Yaqoob / Jacob (pbuh)?

english_translation: Or you say, surely Ibraheem (pbuh) and Ismaeel (pbuh) and Is'haq (pbuh) and Yaqoob (pbuh) and the tribes are hood / lenient / jews or nasara / helpers / christians. Say, do you know more or Allah? And who is more unjust than the one who concealed the evidence he has from Allah? And Allah is not unaware about what you do.
So do they seek judgement other than Allah. And whosoever is in the skies and the earth have voluntarily / willingly or dislikingly / unwillingly submitted to Him, and they return towards Him.
question_text: Q6. According to Aal e Imran 3:83 please further clarify how everyone is submitting to Allah willingly and unwillingly / dislikingly?

english_translation: And when Allah took a covenant with those who were given Al-Kitab / the book that definitely you will clarify it for mankind and you will not hide it. So they threw it away behind their backs and purchased with it a little price. So they made a bad bargain / purchase.
And We have made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember. Is there anyone that will receive admonition?
Do they not ponder over the Qur'an? If it had been from other than Allah, surely they would have found many contradictions in it.

And this Al-Quran / the reading is not that can be produced from other than Allah, and but it is a confirmation that is between his two hands and an explanation of Al-Kitab / the book, no doubt in it from the Lord of the worlds.
And that was Our reasoning that We gave to Ibraheem (pbuh) (to use) over his people. We raise the grades of whom We will. Surely your Lord is Wise, Knowledgeable.

And We granted Ishaaq (pbuh) and Yaqoob (pbuh) for him. We guided all and from before We guided Nooh (pbuh) and from his offsprings (We guided) Dawood (pbuh) and Sulaiman (pbuh) and Ayub (pbuh) and Yusuf (pbuh) and Moosa (pbuh) and Haroon (pbuh). And likewise We reward those who do good.
And Zakariya (pbuh) and Yahya (pbuh) and Essa (pbuh) and Ilyas (pbuh). All were from those who correct (themselves).
And Ismail (pbuh) and Yasa'a (pbuh) and Younus (pbuh) and Lut (pbuh). And all, We favored over the worlds.
And from their fathers / ancestors and their offspring and their brethren and We selected them and We guided them towards the straight path.

They are those to whom We gave Al-Kitab / The Book and Al-Hukm / The Governance. So if they reject these with it, so without doubt We will advocate with it to people who will not be the rejecters with it.
And remember Idrees (pbuh) in Al-Kitab / the book. Surely he was a true Prophet.

And We have revealed The Book towards you with the truth, that is confirming from The Book, that is between his two hands, and watcher / guardian over it, so govern between them with what Allah has revealed and do not follow their desires that has come to you from the truth. For every (nation) We made from them a way and method. And if Allah had willed, definitely He would have made you, a single nation but so that He tries you in what He gives you then seek the betterment. Towards Allah you totally will return, then He prophesies you with what you are differing in it.
That is Al-Kitab / The Book, no doubt in it, a guidance for those who guard.
Without doubt, We have revealed towards you a Book, your remembrance is in it. Then do you not understand?
O' self / soul / psyche! (mentioned once in The Book).
O' Mankind! (mentioned 16 times in The Book).
O' you who possess the core! (those who know the essence / spirit of ayaat / signs). (mentioned 4 times in The Book).
O' those who believe! (mentioned 88 times in The Book).
O' you who believe! Fasting has been written over you, like what has been written over those before you, that you may take guard.
O' Children of Adam! (mentioned 4 times in The Book).
O' Children of Israel! (mentioned 5 times in The Book).
O' people of the book! (mentioned 6 times in The Book).

You are a better nation that has been taken out for mankind, you order with what is acknowledged and you forbid about the disguised and you believe with Allah. If the People of The Book had believed, definitely it would have been better for them. Among them are the believers and majority of them are liberals.
Not all of them are alike from Ahlal-Kitab / People of The Book, a nation that stands, recites the ayaat / signs of Allah, in portions of the night and they prostrate.
They believe with Allah and the last day and they order with what is acknowledged and they forbid about the disguised and they hasten in good works. And they are from those who correct.

O' People of The Book! Without doubt Our Messenger has come to you, he clarifies for you most of it from what you were hiding from the book and he overlooks / pardons mostly about (it). Without doubt a light and a clear Book has come to you from Allah.
And how can you reject and the ayaat / signs of Allah are recited over you and His Messenger is in you. And whosoever holds with Allah then without doubt he has been guided towards the straight path.
And those who were given the book did not differ except after the clarification came to them.

Say, O' People of The Book! Do you take revenge from us except that we have believed with Allah and what has been revealed towards us and what has been revealed from before. And surely majority of you are liberals.

Say, O' People of The Book! Do not exceed in your judgment other than the truth and do not follow the desires of the people who without doubt have gone astray from before and they have strayed the majority and they have strayed about the right / even way.
Have you not seen those who were given a portion from The Book, they purchase the straying and they intend that you go astray from the way.

Have you not seen those who were given a portion from the book, they believe with jibt / worthless things and taghoot / unjustly harsh and they say for those who reject that they are more guided in the way from those who believed.

Have you not seen those who were given a portion from the book, they are being invited towards Book of Allah so that it governs between them. Then a division from them turn away and they are those who avoid.
Say, O' People of The Book! Why you reject with ayaat / signs of Allah and Allah is a Witness over that what you do.
Say, O' People of The Book! Why do you oppose those who believe about the way of Allah, you seek a deviation in it and you are witnesses. And Allah is not unaware about what you do.
O' People of The Book! Why you reject with the ayaat / signs of Allah and you witness it.
O' People of The Book! Why you cover the truth with falsehood and you hide the truth and you know it.
The truth is from your Lord, then you do not be from the doubtful ones.

The majority Ahlal-Kitab / the People of The Book intend they may turn you back to rejection after your belief, it is the jealousy from the nearness of their selves / souls / psyches after the truth has become clear for them. So forgive and shake hands until Allah comes with His order. Surely Allah has power over everything.
O' you who believe! If you follow a division from those who are given The Book, they will turn you back as rejecters after your belief.

Say, O' People of The Book! Come towards a word that is equal between us, and between you that we serve none except Allah, and we do not associate anything with Him and some of us will not take some as lords from other than Allah. Then if they turn back then say, you bear witness that surely we are Muslims / submitters.
Those who reject from Ahlal-kitab / People of The Book and (from) those who associate, will not disconnect until there comes to them bayyinah / the clarification.
A Rasool / Messenger from Allah, he recites purified pages.
In them (pages) are established kutub / books / writings.
And We have not given them from books / writings from which they take lessons. And We have not sent towards them a warner before you.

Say, did you see what you call other than Allah, show me what they have created from the earth, or for them Is a share in the skies? Come to me with a kitab / book before this or effects from the knowledge if you are truthful.

And the earth shined with the light of its Lord and Al-Kitab / The Book has been placed. And nabeeyeen / prophets and shuhada / witnesses have been brought forward and with truth (the matter) has been ended between them, and they will not be oppressed.
And every nafs / psyche / self has been given in full as to what he did and He knows best with what they do.

What, has not the time arrived for those who believe, that their hearts humble for the remembrance of Allah and what is revealed from the truth. And they should not become like those who are given Al-Kitab / the Book from before, so long passed over them, then their hearts became hard. And majority from them are fasiqoon / liberals.

(Ibraheem pbuh and Ismaeel pbuh) said, O' our Lord! And appoint in them a Messenger from them, who recites Your ayaat / signs over them and who gives them the knowledge of Al-Kitab / The Book and Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom and justify them. Surely your Lord is the Mighty, the Wise.
My Lord, make me one who establishes salah / prayer, and also from my offsprings, our Lord, You accept my call.
Our Lord, have forgiveness for me and for my parents and for the believers when the day of account is established.

And the yahood / lenient / Jews say that nasara / helpers / Christians are not on anything. And the nasara / helpers / Christians say that the yahood / lenient / jews are not on anything. And both of them are reciting Al-Kitab / The Book.
question_text: Q1. We have been hearing that the Jews and the Christians are the People of The Book. What you have to say about this?

question_text: Q2. The Jews and the Christians claim that Muhammad (pbuh) has forged the Quran from the Bible. What clarification do you give for this?
