question_text: Q3. From your lecture we have come to know that The Book was present from before. Then what was the purpose of sending Muhammad (pbuh).?

english_translation: And when Allah took a covenant with those who were given Al-Kitab / The Book that definitely you will clarify it for the mankind and you will not hide it. So they threw it away behind their backs and purchased with it a little price. So they made a bad bargain / purchase.

And you do not marry women who associate (with Allah) until they believe. And a believing slave women is better than a woman who associates (with Allah) and even if she amazed you. And you do not let your (women) marry who associate (with Allah) until they believe and a believing servant is better than one who associates (with Allah) even if he amazed you. They invite towards the fire and Allah invites towards the garden, and forgiveness with His permission, and He clarifies His ayaat / signs for the mankind so that they may remember.
question_text: Q4. Can you marry the so called People of The book?

english_translation: Without doubt, We have revealed towards you a book, you are mentioned in it, so do not you understand?
O' self / soul / psyche! (mentioned once in the book).
O' Mankind! (mentioned 16 times in the book).
O' you who possess the core! (those who know the essence / spirit of ayaat / signs). (mentioned 4 times in the book).
O' people of the book! (mentioned 6 times in the book).
O' those who believe! (mentioned 88 times in the book).
O' Children of Adam! (mentioned 4 times in the book).
O' Children of Israel! (mentioned 5 times in the book).
Only You we serve and we seek only Your cooperation.
Guide us to the straight path
Path of those you have blessed over them other than You were angered over them and they are not the strayed ones.
O' Bani-Israeel / children of Israeel! Remember My blessing that I have blessed over you and surely I have favored you over the worlds.

And without doubt, We gave Bani-Israeel / children of Israeel Al-Kitab / The Book and Al-Hukm / The Governance and An-Nubuwah / The Prophecy and We gave them sustenance from the good and We have favored them over the worlds.
That is Al-Kitab / The Book, no doubt in it a guidance for those who guard.
And We gave Moosa (pbuh) Al-Kitab / The Book and We made it a guidance for Bani-Israeel / children of Israel that you do not take an advocate other than Me.
(Children of Israel) are the offsprings whom We carried with Nooh (pbuh). Surely he was a thankful servant.

When We took a covenant with Bani-Israeel / children of Israeel that you will not serve except Allah and be good with your parents and your relatives and the orphans and the needy and say good to mankind and establish salah / prayer and give zakat / justification. Then you turned away except few from you, and you are those who avoid.
And when We took a covenant that you do not shed your blood and do not expel your souls / selves from your circles then you confirmed and you are witnessing.

Then here you are killing and you are expelling a group from you from their circles backing them with sin and enmity. And if they come to you as captives, you ransom them and their expulsion is forbidden over you. So do you believe with a portion of Al-Kitab / The Book and you reject with a portion. So the reward for those who does that from you is not except disgrace in this worldly life and on the day of judgement they will be returned towards the severe punishment and Allah is not unaware about what you are doing.

Without doubt We took covenant with Bani-Israeel / children of Israeel and We sent Our Messengers towards them. Whenever comes to them a Messenger with what their souls do not desire they belied a group and they kill a group.

And when Moosa (pbuh) said to his people, O' my people, why do you hurt me? And without doubt you know that I am the Messenger of Allah to you. So when they deviated, Allah deviated their hearts. And Allah does not guide the people who are fasiqeen / liberals.

And when Essa Jesus (pbuh) said O' children of Israeel, surely I am a Messenger of Allah to you, confirming what is between my two hands from At-taurah / The Law and giver of a good news with the Messenger who will come after me whose name will be Ahmed / more praiseworthy. So when he came to them with clarifications, they said, this is a clear magic.

Say, did you see, if it is from the nearness of Allah and you rejected with it and a witness from Bani Israeel / children of Israeel who witnessed over his likeness, so he believed and you sought greatness. Surely Allah does not guide the people who are oppressors.

So who is on clarity from his Lord and a witness (Muhammad pbuh) recites it from it. And from before it is a book of Moosa (pbuh) a leader and mercy. They believe with it and whoever rejects with it from the groups so fire is his promised place. So you (Muhammad pbuh) do not be in doubt from it, surely it is the truth from your Lord but the majority of mankind do not believe.
Muhammad (pbuh) was not the father / ancestor from any of your men but he is the Messenger of Allah and seal of the Prophets. And Allah is Knowledgeable with everything.
And those who believed and who did corrections and believed with what is revealed on Muhammad (pbuh) and it is the truth from their Lord. He will cover about their badness and correct their state.
And surely it is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
He revealed the spirit of truth with it.
Over your heart so you (Muhammad pbuh) become from the warners.
With the clear Arabic language.
And surely it is in the earlier pieces.
And is it not for them an ayat / sign that the uluma / the knowledgeable of Bani-Israeel / children of Israeel know it.

So with their breaking of their covenant, We cursed them and We made their hearts hard. They distorted the word from its place and they forgot a portion of what they were reminded with it. And you will never cease to find mistrust from them except few from them so pardon and shake hands with them. Surely Allah loves those who are good doers.
O' Bani-Israeel / children of Israeel remember the blessings that I have blessed over you and complete with my promise, I will complete with your promise, and only Me, you be terrified.

And believe with what I have revealed confirming for what is with you and you do not become the first of rejecters with it. And you do not purchase My ayaat / signs for a little price and only Me you be guarded.
And do not cover the truth with falsehood and do not hide the truth and you know it.
And establish salah / prayer and give zakat / justification and bow with those who bow down.
Do you order people with righteousness and forget your souls / selves / psyches and you recite Al-Kitab / The Book then do you not use intelligence?
Surely this Al-Quran / The Reading relates over Bani-Israeel / children of Israeel most of which they are differing in it.
And surely it is indeed a guidance and a mercy for the believers.

O' you who believe! Become helpers of Allah as Essa (pbuh) son of Maryam (pbuh) said for the companions, who are my helpers towards Allah? The companions said we are helpers of Allah. So a group from the Bani-Israeel / children of Israeel believed and a group rejected. So We strengthened those who believed over their enemy so they began the day as strong backers.

Allah does not give a task What she earns is for her and what she has earned is on her. O' our Lord, do not catch us if we forgot or we made a mistake. O' our Lord, and do not load a burden on us like you burdened on those from before us. O' our Lord, and do not burden us with that we do not have the strength with it. And pardon us and forgive us and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us over the people who are the rejecters.

And We took the children of Israeel across the sea, so Pharaoh and his forces followed them in wrong and in enmity, until he realized of drowning, he said, I have believed that there is no god except Him whom the Children of Israel have believed with Him and I am from the muslims / submitters.
question_text: Q1. Is there any ayah / sign of Quran which indicates that children of Israeel are muslims?

english_translation: And the yahood / lenient / Jews say, that hand of Allah is cuffed / tied up. Their hands are cuffed / tied up and they are cursed with what they have said, but both His hands are outspread, He spends how He wills. And what is revealed to you from your Lord definitely increases the majority amongst them in tyranny (i.e. unjustly harsh, cruel) and rejection. And We have put enmity and hatred amongst them towards the day of judgement. Whenever they (yahood / lenient / Jews) ignite the fire for war, Allah extinguishes it and they make an effort in the earth to cause corruption. And Allah does not love the mufsideen / corrupt.
question_text: Q2. From your lecture we come to know that present day muslims are the children of Israeel and the present day Jews are not the children of Israeel. What does Quran say about the Jews?

english_translation: Say O' hadoo / those who became lenient / Jews! If you claim that you are aulia / protectors of Allah besides other people then wish for the death if you are truthful.
And they will never wish for it (death) with what their hands sent forward. And Allah is Knowledgeable with the oppressors.

And whosoever obeys Allah and the Messenger so they are with those whom Allah blessed over them, from the Prophets and the truthful ones and the witnesses and the corrected ones. And that is a beautiful companionship.

They are those among the Prophets on whom Allah has blessed from the offspring of Adam and from those whom We carried with Nooh (pbuh) and from the offspring of Ibraheem (pbuh) and Israel and from those whom We guided and We selected, when the ayaat / signs of the Gracious are recited on them they fall down prostrating, weeping.
question_text: Q3. In the Quran children of Israeel have been blessed by Allah. Is there any ayah / sign which says that all the Prophets are blessed by Allah?

english_translation: All food was lawful for children of Israeel except what Israeel has forbidden on his soul / self / psyche from before the Taurah / Law is revealed. Say come with The Taurah / The Law then recite it if you were truthful.
(Children of Israeel) are the offspring whom We carried with Nooh (pbuh). Surely he was a thankful servant.
question_text: Q4. According to you if the present day children of Israeel are muslims we know what is lawful and unlawful food for us. Then could you clarify this verse of Aal-e-Imran 3:93 that why Israeel made lawful food unlawful?

english_translation: Then We inspired towards him (Nooh pbuh) that you manufacture a ship within Our eyes and with Our inspiration, so when Our order came and the oven (of the earth) boiled then insert in it two from every pairs and your family except on whom the saying has preceded from them. And you do not address Me in those who oppressed. Surely they are drowned ones.
And how can they govern you and At-Taurah / The Law is near them, in it is hukm / Governance of Allah. Then after that, they turn away and they are not with the believers.

Allah is Wali / Protector of those who believe. He takes them out from the darkness towards light and those who reject their aulia / protectors is taghoot (i.e. unjustly harsh, cruelty). They take them out from the light towards the darkness. They are the companions of fire, they will be in it forever.

Is he who was dead, so We make him alive and We made noor / light for him, he walks in people with it is like whose example is in the darkness from which he can never come out? Likewise what they were doing has been made adornment for the rejecters.
Surely your Wali / Protector is Allah, and His messenger and those who believe, they are those who establish salah / prayer and give zakah / justification and they are those who bow down.
And whosoever makes Allah and His Messenger and those who believe as a Wali / Protector, then surely, they are party of Allah, those who overcome.

And the believer men and the believer women are aulia / protectors of one another. They order with the acknowledged / recognized and forbid about the disguised and they establish salah / prayer, and give zakah / justification and obey Allah and His messenger. They are those Allah will have His mercy on them soon. Surely Allah is Mighty, Wise.

Is not deen / the judgement exclusively for Allah? And those who take aulia / protectors other than Allah (say) we do not serve them except that they may bring us close towards the nearness of Allah. Surely Allah will govern between them in what they differ in it. Surely Allah does not guide the one who is a liar, rejecter.

The example of those who take aulia / protectors other than Allah is like the example of the spider who takes a house. And surely the weakest of houses is definitely the house of the spider, if they know.

And they serve other than Allah who neither harm them nor profit them and they say these are our intercessors near Allah. Say do you inform Allah with what He knows not what is in the skies and nor in the earth. Glory to Him and He is high above about what they associate (with Him).
Say for Allah is the intercession all together. For Him is the kingdom of the skies and the earth. Then you will be returned towards Him.
And the rejecters say for those who believe, follow our way and we will bear your faults. And they are not bearers of their faults from anything. Surely they are definite liars.
And definitely they will bear their burdens, and burdens with their own burdens. And on the day of judgement they definitely will be questioned about what they invented.

Allah does not give a task to a soul except to her capacity. What she earned is for her and what she has earned is on her. Our Lord, do not catch us if we forgot or we made a mistake. Our Lord and do not load a burden on us like You burdened it on those from before us. Our Lord, and do not burden us with that we do not have the strength with it. And pardon us and forgive us and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us over the people who are the rejecters.
And you do not call other than Allah who can neither benefit you nor harm you. So if you did this then surely you will be from the oppressors.

And if Allah touches you with harm then there is no one who can remove it except Him. And if He intends for you with betterment then there is no one who can withhold His favor. He reaches with it to whomsoever He wills from His servants. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
O' you who believe! Take guard of Allah and seek the means towards Him and strive in His way so that you may prosper.
Say, so call on those whom you claim other than Him (Allah), so they have no power to remove harm from you and nor to change them.

They are, whom they call, they are seeking the means towards their Lord that who are the most close ones and they hope of His mercy and fear His punishment. Surely the punishment of your Lord is something to be cautious of.
And those whom they call other than Allah they have not created anything and they have been created.
(They are) dead without life and they are not conscious / aware when they will be appointed.
And the alive and nor the dead are equal. Surely Allah can make to listen whom He wills. And you cannot make them listen who are in the graves.
Do the rejecters calculate that they can take My servants as aulia / protectors other than Me? Surely We have prepared the hell for the rejecters as a revelation.
Say, Shall We give you the prophecy of the works of the lost ones.
Those whose efforts went astray in worldly life and they calculate that surely they were making good.
They are those who rejected with the ayaat / signs of their Lord and the meeting with Him, so their works went in vain, then We will not establish any weight for them on the day of judgement.
The hell is their reward with what they rejected and they took My ayaat / signs and My messengers as joke / jest.
The day He will gather them and those whom they serve other than Allah so He will say, did you lead My servants astray or they themselves strayed the way?

They will say, glory to You it was not desirable for us that we take from aulia/protectors other than You. And but You gave them and their ancestors commodities until they forgot the remembrance, and they were the people in ruin.
Then without doubt they belied you with what you are saying. So (now) you do not have the ability to avert and nor any help. And whosoever oppresses from you We will make him taste a big punishment.
faces will be turned in the fire they will say, Oh! Alas on us! We should have obeyed Allah and we should have obeyed the Messenger.
And they said, O' our Lord, surely we obeyed our sadat / chiefs and our big ones so they misled us from the way.
Our Lord give them double from the punishment and curse them, a big curse.

Surely those who said, our Lord is Allah then they remained steadfast, the angels descend on them (saying) you do not fear and you do not grieve and have the good news of the garden that you were promised.
We are your Aulia / protectors in this worldly life and in the last, and for you is what your souls desire in it and for you is what you call in it.
A revelation from Forgiving, Merciful.

And what is for you that you do not fight in the way of Allah and those who are weak from the men and the women and children, those who say O' our Lord, take us out from this city whose people are oppressors. And make for us a protector from Your nearness and make for us a helper from nearness.

O' you who believe! Do not take yahood / who are lenient / jews and nasara / helpers / christians as protectors. Some of them are protectors of some. And whosoever makes protectors from them then surely they are from them. Surely Allah does not guide the people who are the oppressors.
question_text: Q1.Does Allah mention any group of people by name as aulia / protector other than Allah?

english_translation: Allah there is no god except Him. The Living, The Ever Established. No slumber / drowsiness can seize Him, and nor sleep. Whatever the skies and whatever in the earth is for Him. Who is there that can intercede in His presence except with His permission? He knows what is in front of them and what is behind them. And they shall not encompass of His knowledge except with what He willed. His throne extends over the skies and the earth and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving both of them, and He is the High, the Supreme.

And take guard of the day when no soul /self / psyche can reward about soul /self / psyche in anything and no shafaat / intercession is to be accepted from her and no equitableness is to be taken from her and they will not be helped.
question_text: Q2.How can a person do shafaat / intercede with the permission of Allah? Clarify this.

english_translation: And when Allah said O' Essa / Jesus (pbuh) the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) did you say to mankind that you take me and my mother as two gods other than Allah? He said, glory to You, never could I say with what I had no right. If I had said it, so definitely You would have known it. You know what is in my soul / self / psyche and I do not know what is in Your soul / self / psyche. Surely You, You are more knowledgeable of the absents.

Say, for Allah is the shafaat / intercession all together. The kingdom of the skies and the earth is for Him. Then you will be returned towards Him.

Allah there is no god except Him the Living, the Ever Established, no slumber / drowsiness can seize Him, and nor sleep. Whatever is in the skies and whatever is in the earth is for Him. Who is there that can shafaat / intercede near Him except with His permission. He knows what is in front of them and what is behind them. And they shall not encompass anything from His knowledge except with what He wills. His throne extends over the skies and the earth and the guarding / preserving both of them does not fatigue Him, and He is the High, the Supreme.
That day shafaat / intercession will not benefit (for anyone) except whom the most Gracious permitted for him and He is pleased for him in saying.
They do not possess the shafaat / intercession except who took a covenant near (the most Gracious).
And those whom they call from other than Him, do not possess the shafaat / intercession except who witnessed with the truth and they know.
He knows what is between their hands / in front of them and what is behind them, and they cannot do shafaat / intercede except to whom He is pleased and they are from His fear worried / concerned.

Do they wait / watch except its interpretation. The day its interpretation comes, those who forgot it from before will say, without doubt messengers of our Lord came with the truth. So, are there for us from shufa'a / intercessors then they shafaat / intercede for us or we be returned then we will do other than what we were doing. Without doubt they have lost their souls / selves / psyches and astrayed from them what they were fabricating.
And when it is being said to them, come (to Messenger) a Messenger of Allah he will seek forgiveness for you, they twisted / turned their heads and you saw them opposing and they were arrogant.

And We did not send from any messenger except to be obeyed with the permission of Allah. And if that they, when they had oppressed their souls / selves / psyches, would have come to you, so they should have sought forgiveness of Allah, and the Messenger would have sought forgiveness for them, definitely they would have found Allah, Returning, Merciful.

O' you who believe! Spend from what We provided you from before the day will come when there will be no trading in it, and no friendship and no shafaat / intercession (be accepted). And the rejecters are oppressors.

They serve besides Allah that neither harms them nor profits them and they say, these are our shafaeen / intercessors in the nearness of Allah. Say, do you prophecise / inform Allah with what He knows not, and what is in the skies and not in the earth. Glory to Him and He is High above to what they associate (with Allah).
Or they took shufaa / intercessors from other than Allah. Say, even if they do not possess a thing and they do not have intellect / mind.

And without doubt you will come to Us individually as We have created you first time and you left that We have bestowed you behind your backs. And we do not see with you shufaa intercessors those whom you claim that they were partners amongst you. Without doubt they are cut off between you and astrayed from you what you were claiming.

And when Allah took a covenant with those who were given Al-Kitab / the book that definitely you will clarify it for mankind and you will not hide it. So they threw it away behind their backs and purchased with it a little price. So they made a bad bargain / purchase.
Do I take from other than Him gods, if the most Gracious intends me with harm so their shafaat / intercession will not be sufficient for me in anything and nor they will rescue me.

And take guard of the day when no soul / self / psyche can reward about soul / self / psyche in anything and no shafaat / intercession is to be accepted from her and no equitableness is to be taken from her and they will not be helped.
And Nooh (pbuh) called his Lord so he said, O' my Lord, surely my son is from my family and surely Your promise is true and You are the best governor of the governors.

He said O' Nooh (pbuh) surely he (your son) is not from your family. Surely his deed is not corrected one, so do not question Me what you do not have any knowledge with it. Surely I sermon you that you will become from the ignorants.

He (Nooh pbuh) said, my Lord surely I seek refuge with You that I question You with that I do not have any knowledge with it. And if You do not forgive me and do not have mercy on me I will be from the lost ones.

Allah strikes an example for those who reject, the wife of Nooh / Noah (pbuh) and the wife of Lut / Lot (pbuh). Both (wives) were under two servants from Our servants, who are two correct doers. Then they (both wives) betrayed both of them, so they could not enrich in anything from Allah. And it was said, both of you enter the fire with those who enter.
When he (Ibraheem pbuh) said to his father, O' my father! Why do you serve who does not listen and does not have insight. And they cannot enrich you about anything.
Surely O' my father! Without doubt there has come to me from the knowledge what did not come to you. So follow me, I will guide you on an even way.
O' my father! Do not serve satan. Surely the satan is disobedient for the most Gracious.
He (Ibraheem's pbuh father) said do you detest / dislike about my gods O' Ibraheem (pbuh). Definitely if you do not stop (from it) I will definitely stone you and leave me for a long time.
He (Ibraheem pbuh) said peace be on to you. Soon I will seek forgiveness for you from my Lord. Surely He is affectionate with me.
And forgive for my father surely he is from the astrayed ones.

And when Allah said O' Essa / Jesus (pbuh) the son of Maryam/Mary (pbuh) did you say to mankind that you take me and my mother as two gods other than Allah? He said, glory to You, never could I say with what I had no right. If I had said such a thing, so definitely You would have known it. You know what is in my soul / self / psyche and I do not know what is in Your soul / self / psyche. Surely You are knowledgeable of all that is absent.

I never said to them except what You ordered me with it, that you serve Allah, my Lord and your Lord. And I was a witness over them while I lived among them. When You tawaffaitani / completed me (my soul / self / psyche) You were the Watcher over them. And You are a Witness over all things.
If You punish them then surely they are Your servants, and if You forgive them then surely You are the Mighty, Wise.

Allah will say, this is the day on which the truthful will profit from their truth. For them are gardens with rivers flowing beneath, they will live in it forever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. That is the great success.
Say, spend (sadqa / charity) willingly / voluntarily or unwillingly / dislikingly it will never be accepted from you. Surely you are people who are fasiqeen / liberals.

They were not prevented that their expenditures get accepted from them except that they rejected Allah and His messenger and they do not come to salah / prayer except they are lazy and they do not spend (sadqa / charity) except unwillingly / dislikingly.

You seek forgiveness for them or you do not seek forgiveness for them. If you seek forgiveness for them seventy times Allah will never forgive them. That is because they rejected Allah and His messenger. And Allah will not guide people who are fasiqeen / liberals.
That day, the kingdom of truth will be for the Merciful and that day will become very difficult over the rejecters.
And the messenger will say, O' my Lord, surely my people took this Al-Quran / The Reading abandoned / left it (not took guidance).
And how many from angel in the skies, their shafaat / intercession is not sufficient in anything except from after that Allah gives permission to whom He wills and to whom He is pleased.
Surely those who say our Lord is Allah then they are steadfast the angels descend on them (saying) you do not fear and you do not grieve and have the good news of the garden that you are promised.
We are your aulia / protectors in the life of the world and in the hereafter. And in it for you what your souls desire, and in it for you what you were promised.
A reception from Forgiver, Merciful.

And you will see the angels those who are at the border from the surrounding of the throne, they are glorifying with the praise of their Lord and will be completed between them with the truth and will be said, the praise is for Allah the Lord of the worlds.

Those who carry the throne and who surround it they glorify with the praise of their Lord and believe with Him and seek forgiveness for those who believe. Our Lord You spread out / widened the mercy and knowledge over everything. So forgive for those who repented and followed Your way and guard them (from) punishment of blazing fire.

Our Lord, and enter them in the gardens of permanent residence that you promised them. And whosoever corrected from their fathers / ancestors and their pairs / wives and their descendants / offsprings. Surely You are the Mighty, the Wise.
And guard them from the ills / weaknesses. And whosoever guarded from ills / weaknesses, so without doubt, that day You will have His mercy. And that it is the great success.

O' our Lord, surely we have listened to the caller, calling for belief that believe with your Lord so we believed. O' our Lord, then forgive for us our guilts / sins and cover about us, our badness / ills and complete our lives with the righteous.
O' our Lord and give us what You promised us over Your messengers and You do not disgrace us on the day of judgement. Surely you do not differ from the promise.

So their Lord answered them surely I do not waste doers work from you from male or female. Some of you are from some. So those who migrated and were driven out from their circles and got hurt in My way and they fought and they were killed definitely I will cover their ills / weaknesses and I will definitely enter them in gardens from where rivers flow beneath it. Reward from the nearness of Allah. And the beautiful reward is near Allah.

Whosoever intercedes beautiful shafaat / intercession for him will be a portion from it. And whosoever intercedes bad shafaat / intercession for him will be a guardian from it and over Allah is the support of everything.

He (iblees) said, do You see this is the one You have honored over me. Definitely If You will give me respite towards the day of judgement I will definitely make his descendant have worldly experience except a few.
He (Allah) said, go away whosoever follows you from them, surely hell is your reward, an abundant reward.

question_text: Q1. Can you clarify how can shafaat / intercession for a bad / evil person happens / occurs?

english_translation: And you can stir up or excite with your voice whosoever is obedient from them and import on them with your thought and your masculine manners and be their partner in wealth and children and promise them. And shaitaan / satan promises them nothing except delusion.
Surely My servants over them, you will never have any authority. And your Lord is sufficient advocate.
Say O' my servants! Those who exceeded over their souls / selves / psyches you do not despair from the mercy of Allah. Surely Allah forgives guilts together. Surely He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
And deputize towards your Lord and submit for Him from before the punishment comes to you then you will not be helped.
And follow the best of what has been revealed towards you from your Lord, from before that the punishment comes to you suddenly and you are of those who are not conscious.

question_text: Q2. According to Az - Zumar 39:53, Allah will forgive all our sins as He is Ghafoor / Forgiving and Raheem / Merciful, Can you please clarify?

english_translation: And others have confessed with their sins, they have mixed correct acts and other bad (acts), it may be that Allah will return over them. Surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

Take sadqa / the charity (i.e. any amount according to the means) from their wealth so that you purify and justify them with it and pray over them. Surely your prayer is a satisfaction for them and Allah is Listener, Knowledgeable.

Do they not know that Allah is He who accepts the repentance from His servants and he takes the sadaqat / the charities (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit and any amount according to the means from their wealth), and that Allah is He, who is the Returning, the Merciful.

question_text: Q3. If someone has done something wrong, how can the Messenger intercede in this world and in the hereafter?

english_translation: And say do (the works), so soon Allah and His Messenger and the believers will see your work / deed. And soon you will be returned towards Knowledgeable of the absent and the evident, so He prophecise / inform you with what you were doing.

O' you who believe! When you consult the Messenger then advance sadqa / the charity that is between two hands of your consultation (i.e. any amount according to your means). That is better and purer for you. So if you do not find then surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

Do you feel pity of that you advance sadaqat / the charities that is between two hands. (i.e. any amount according to the means) of your consultation. So when you did not do it and Allah returned over you then establish salah / prayer and give zakah / justification and obey Allah and His Messenger and Allah is Acquainted with what you do.
And from them are those who took a covenant with Allah that if He gives from His bounty then definitely we will give sadqa / charity and we will be of those who correct themselves.
But when He gave them from His bounty they became stingy with it and turned away and they are those who avoid.
So He put hypocrisy in their hearts towards the day they meet him, with what they broke the promise with Allah and with what they were lying.

question_text: Q4. You said that those who don't spend in the way of Allah, Allah will not forgive even if messenger asks seventy times. Is it not mentioned in At-Tauba 9:80?

english_translation: Did they not know that surely Allah knows their secret and their consultation, and surely Allah is more Knowledgeable of the absents.

Those who wink (i.e. to ignore deliberately as to avoid the necessity of taking action) at those who are volunteers from the believers in sadaqat / charities (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit and any amount according to the means from their wealth) and at those who do not find except their strive, then they ridicule from them Allah ridicules from them and painful punishment is for them.

You seek forgiveness for them or you do not seek forgiveness for them. If you seek forgiveness for them seventy times Allah will never forgive them. That is because they rejected Allah and His messenger. And Allah will not guide people who are fasiqeen / liberals.
Surely first house placed for people is that with Bakka, blessing and guidance for the worlds.
The example of those who take aulia / protectors besides Allah is like an example of the spider who takes a house. And surely the weakest of houses is the house of spider, if they know.

Allah has made the Kabah the sacred / forbidden house an establishment for people and the sacred / forbidden month and the gift / offering and the necklaces / girds. That you should know that Allah has knowledge of what is in the skies and in the earth and that Allah is Knowledgeable with all things.

Surely, Safa and Marwah are from the consciousness / awareness of Allah, so whosoever perform Hajj / pilgrimage or Umrah of the house, it is no offence on him, that he goes around with them and whosoever voluntarily does betterment so surely Allah is Thankful, Knowledgeable.
And likewise, We show Ibraheem (pbuh) the kingdom of the skies and the earth, so that he would be of those having sure belief.
Then when the night shielded over him, he saw a planet, he said, this is my Lord when it set, he said, I do not love those who set.
Then when he saw the moon rising, he said, this is my Lord. Then when it set, he said, if my Lord had not guided me, surely I had been from the people who go astray.
Then when he saw the sun rising, he said this is my Lord this is greater. Then when it set, he said, O' my people! Surely I am indeed free from what you associate (with Allah).
Surely I have set my face truly for the One Who originated the skies and the earth, and I am not from those who associate (with Allah).

Without doubt, We have seen the movements / turnings of your face in the sky, so definitely We will revert you to a qiblah (direction of belief) so that you will be pleased with it, so revert your face to the intersection / portion / half of Al-Masjid-e-Haraam / The Forbidden Mosque and from wherever you are, so revert your faces to the intersection / portion / half of it. And surely those who are given the book definitely knows that it is the truth from their Lord. And Allah is not unaware about what they do.
And without doubt We related Messengers over you and Messengers We did not relate over you. And Allah talked to Moosa / Moses (pbuh) as to be the right of talking.
And when We pointed out the place of the house for Ibraheem (pbuh) that you do not associate anything with Me and purify My house for those who make rounds, and who stand and bow, prostrate.
And when Ibraheem (pbuh) and Ismaeel (pbuh) raised the foundations from the house, O' our Lord! Accept from us. Surely You are the Listener, the Knowledgeable.

O' our Lord! Surely I have settled from my offsprings within a valley other than it is without cultivation near Your sacred / forbidden house, O' our Lord, so that they establish salah / prayer. Then make the hearts of the people desirable towards them and give them sustenance from the fruits so that they may be thankful.

In it are clear ayaat / signs the standing position of Ibraheem (pbuh). Whoever enters it attains security. And for Allah is haj / pilgrimage of the house on the people those who can afford the journey to it. And if anyone rejects, so surely Allah is not needful from the worlds.

And when We made the house a place of reward and safety for people, and you take from the standing position of Ibraheem (pbuh) And we covenanted / took a covenant towards Ibraheem (pbuh) and Ismaeel (pbuh) that they should purify My house for those who make rounds and use as aitekaaf / retreat and those who bow, prostrate.

And from wherever you come out, (i.e. from any faith) so revert yourself to the intersection / portion of the sacred mosque (direction of belief) and wherever you are, so revert yourselves to its intersection / portion that there would be no dispute over you from the people, except who oppress from them, so fear them not but fear Me and that I may complete My favor on you and that you may be guided.

And We inspired to Moosa / Moses (pbuh) and his brother that you both point out houses for your people with Egypt and make your houses a qiblah / direction of belief (an intersection / half of the sacred mosque) and establish salah / prayer and give good news to the believers.

Say my Lord has ordered with justice and you establish your faces (in salah / prayer) near every mosque and call Him, exclusively keeping / making deen / judgement for Him. As He originated you, (so) you will return.

And what is for them, that Allah should not punish them and that they oppose about the sacred mosque and they are not its protectors. It's protectors are none except the guarded ones, but majority of them do not know.
Their salah / prayer near the house is nothing except whistling and clapping So you taste the punishment with what you reject.
Only You we serve and only Your cooperation we seek.
Guide us to the straight path

Soon the fools from the people will say, what has reverted them about their qiblah / direction of belief that they were over it? Say for Allah is the east and the west. He guides whom He wills to an upright / straight path.

Likewise, We made you a balanced / moderate nation, so that you be witnesses over people and the Messenger be a witness over you. And We did not made the qiblah / direction of belief you were over it except so that We know who will follow the Messenger from him who turns over his heels. And it is definitely not big over those whom Allah guides. And Allah is not (such) that He will waste your belief. Surely Allah is definitely Compassionate, Merciful with the people.

And definitely if you were to bring to those who are given the Book with every ayaat / signs they will not follow your qiblah / direction of belief. And you will not be with the follower of their qiblah / direction of belief and some of them will not be with the follower of the qibla / direction of belief of some. And if you were to follow their desires from after the knowledge has come to you, surely you would be from the oppressors.
Those whom We gave the book recognize it as recognize their sons definitely they conceal the truth and they know.
The truth is from your Lord then you do not be from the doubtful ones.
Surely, I am ordered that I serve the Lord of this city, who has made it sacred / forbidden, and for Him are all things. And I am ordered that I become from those who are muslims / submitters.
And that is I recite the Quran then whosoever takes guidance, then surely he takes guidance for his own self / soul / psyche. and whosoever goes astray then say, surely I am from the warners.
And say praise is for Allah, Who will soon show you His ayaat / signs so that you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware about what you do.
When Ibraheem (pbuh) said My Lord! Make this city secure and make me and my sons strangers that we serve the idols.
My Lord! They have indeed led astray the majority from people, so he whosoever follows me then surely he is from me, and whosoever disobeys me then surely You are indeed Forgiving, Merciful.
O' my Lord forgive me and my parents and those who entered my house as a believer and for the believing men and the believing women. And do not increase the oppressors except in destruction / ruin.

question_text: Q1. From today's lecture it has been clarified that House of Allah and Qiblah are related from the period of Ibraheem (pbuh). Then what was the Qiblah of Nooh (pbuh) and his followers as he came before Ibraheem (pbuh)?
Q2. What is the status of Baitu-ul-Muqaddas which is in Jerusalem? Clarify this.

english_translation: Glory to Him (Allah) who made his servant travel (Ar-rooh / the spirit) by night from Al-Masjid-e-Haraam / the forbidden mosque to Al-Aqsa / the remotest mosque (distant in time, solitary / inconsiderable and isolated) whose surroundings We have blessed so that We show him from Our ayaat / signs. Surely He is the Listener, the One with an insight.

And those (hypocrites) who have taken a mosque to harm and to reject (i.e. Islam / peace) and to make divisions between the believers and as an ambush (i.e. hidden place for sudden attack), for those (yahood / lenient / jews) who have been waging war from before against Allah and His messenger. And definitely they swear that we intend nothing except goodness. And Allah witnesses that surely they are definite liars.

question_text: Q3. In Bani Israel 17:1, Allah has mentioned about masjid-e-Aqsa which is also the first Qiblah, please clarify this.

english_translation: You never ever stand in it. Definitely that mosque (i.e. masjid-e-haram / forbidden mosque) whose basis from the first day is on guard, has more right that you stand in it. In it are men who love that they purify themselves. And Allah loves the purified ones.
The first house placed for the people is that with Bakka, blessings and guidance for the worlds.

Allah has made the Kabah the sacred / forbidden house an establishment for people and the sacred / forbidden month and the gift / offering and the necklaces / girds. That you should know that Allah has knowledge of what is in the skies and in the earth and that Allah is Knowledgeable with all things.

In it are clear ayaat / signs, the standing position of Ibraheem (pbuh). Whoever enters it attains security. And for Allah is hajj / pilgrimage of the house on the people those who can afford the journey to it. And if anyone rejects, so surely Allah is not needful from the worlds.

And when We made the house a place of reward and safety for people, and you take from the standing position of Ibraheem (pbuh) the salah / prayer performed. And we covenanted / took a covenant with Ibraheem (pbuh) and Ismaeel (pbuh) that they should purify My house for those who go around and those who intent upon and those who bow, prostrate.

Without doubt, We have seen the movements / turnings of your face in the sky, so definitely We will revert you to a qiblah (direction of belief) so that you will be pleased with it, so revert your face to the intersection / portion / half of Al-Masjid-e-Haraam / the forbidden mosque and from wherever you are, so revert your faces to the intersection/portion/half of it. And surely those who are given the book definitely knows that it is the truth from their Lord. And Allah is not unaware about what they do.
And likewise, We have showed Ibraheem (pbuh) the kingdom of the skies and the earth, so that he would be of those having sure belief.

Soon the fools from the people will say what has reverted them about their qiblah / direction of belief that they were over it? Say for Allah is the east and the west. He guides whom He wills to an upright / straight path.

Likewise, We made you a balanced / moderate nation, so that you become witnesses over people and the messenger be a witness over you. And We did not made the qiblah / direction of belief you were over it except so that We know who will follow the messenger from him who turn over his heels. And it is definitely not big over those whom Allah guides. And Allah is not (such) that He will waste your belief. Surely Allah is definitely Compassionate, Merciful with people.

And from wherever you come out, (i.e. from any faith) so revert yourself to the intersection / portion of the sacred mosque (direction of belief) and wherever you are, so revert yourselves to its intersection / portion that there would be no dispute over you from the people, except who are oppressors from them. So fear them not but fear Me and that I may complete My favours on you and that you may be guided.

And definitely if you were to bring to those who are given the book with all the ayaat / signs they will not follow your qiblah / direction of belief. And you will not be with the follower of their qiblah / direction of belief and some of them will not be with the follower of the qibla / direction of belief of some. And if you were to follow their desires from after the knowledge has come to you, surely you would be from the oppressors.

Surely those who have rejected and stop / oppose about the way of Allah and (stop / oppose) Al-Masjid-e-Haraam / the forbidden mosque which We made it for the mankind equal, the devoted in it and the nomad / visitor. And whosoever intends with profanity with oppression in it We will make him taste from the painful punishment.

And what is for them, that Allah should not punish them and that they are in opposition about the sacred mosque and they are not its protectors. The protectors are none except the guarded ones, but majority of them do not know.
Their salah / prayer near the house is nothing except whistling and clapping. So you taste the punishment with what you were rejecting.
And surely the mosques are for Allah. So you do not call anyone with Allah.
O' sons of Adam! Take your adornment near every mosque. And eat and drink and you do not exceed. Surely He (Allah) does not love those who exceed.

Say my Lord has ordered with justice and you establish your faces (in salah / prayer) near every mosque and call Him as exclusive ones, for Him is the judgement. As He originated you, (so) you will return.

Surely the mosques of Allah are visited by the one who believes with Allah and the last day and who establishes salah / prayer and who gives zakah / justification and who fear none except Allah. So it may be that they will be among those who are guided.

...And you do not accompany them when you are devoted in the mosques. These are the boundaries of Allah so you do not go near them. Likewise Allah clarifies His ayaat / signs for people so that they may take guard.

And We inspired to Moosa / Moses (pbuh) and his brother that you both point out houses for your people with Egypt and make your houses a qiblah / direction of belief (an intersection / half of the sacred mosque) and establish salah / prayer and give good news to the believers.

And likewise We appointed them so that they question between themselves. From them the speaker said, How long you have stayed, they said, we have stayed a day or part of a day. They said your Lord knows more with what (number) you stayed. Then appoint one of you with this your leaf / paper money towards Al-Madina. So he should view which is more justified food. Then he will come with sustenance to you from it (city). And he should be courteous / well mannered. And definitely he should not make anyone aware / conscious with you.

And likewise We cause to stumble / to discover over them, (the companions of the cave) that they know that surely the promise of Allah is true, and surely the hour (there is) no doubt in it. When they dispute in their order between them. So they said, construct a building over them. Their Lord was more Knowledgeable with them. Those who subdue over their order said, we will definitely (construct) hold on to a mosque over them.

Soon they will say they were three, their dog is fourth and they will say they were five, their dog is sixth, guessing with absent. And they will say they were seven, their dog is eighth. Say, my Lord is more Knowledgeable with their number. No one knows them except a few. So you do not dispute in them except an obvious dispute. And you do not seek legal advice in them from anyone of them.

And you will see the sun when rose visit the right side about their cave and when (it) sets the left side nibbling them (i.e. to bite in the small bits) and they were in the interval of time from it. These are from the ayaat / signs of Allah. Whomsoever Allah guides so he is guided. And whosoever He (Allah) astrays then he will never find the one who is sober protector for him.

And you will calculate / think them awake and they are lying in recumbent position (a part that incline / bend on anything) We turn them to the right side and the left side and then dog who outstretches his two arms with threshold (the point at which a stimulus is of sufficient intensity to begin to produce an effect). Definitely if you are cognized / to perceive / become conscious over them you will turn away from them fleeing / running away and definitely you will be filled with horror / alarmed from them.

And Allah has created every animal from water, so from them there are that walk on their bellies, and from them who walk on two legs, and from them who walk on four. Allah creates what He wills. Surely Allah has power over everything.

And there came a man, striving from Aqsa / remotest of Al-Madina (distant in time, solitary / inconsiderable and isolated). He said, O' Moosa / Moses (pbuh)! Surely the nobles / assembly are ordering with you that they kill you so go away / get away. Surely I am from the advisers for you.
And there came a man striving, from Aqsa / remotest of Al-Madina (distant in time, solitary / inconsiderable and isolated). He said, O' my people! Follow the messengers.

Glory to Him (Allah) who travelled with His servant (Ar-rooh / the spirit) by night from Al-Masjid-e-Haraam / the forbidden mosque to Al-Aqsa / the remotest mosque (distant in time, solitary / inconsiderable and isolated) whose surroundings We have blessed so that We show him from Our ayaat / signs. Surely He is the Listener, the One with an insight.
And We completed towards the children of Israel in Al-kitab / the book that definitely you will do corruption twice in the earth. And definitely you will be higher, of great highness.
So when their first promise came We appointed over them our servants, the miserable ones, strong ones. So they explore the flaw / defect of the circles. And it was the promise done.
Then We restored for you second time over them and We expanded you with wealth and with sons and We made you company of majority.

If you did good, you did good for your souls / selves / psyches. And if you did bad / hurt then (you did bad) for her. So when the other promise came so that they hurt your faces and then they entered in the mosque like what they entered it first time. And then they destroyed that they are higher in destruction.

And those (hypocrites) who hold on to a mosque to harm and to reject (i.e. Islam / peace) and to make divisions between the believers and as an ambush (i.e. hidden place for sudden attack), for those (yahood / lenient / jews) who have been waging war from before against Allah and His messenger. And definitely they take oath we intended not but the best. And Allah witnesses that surely they are definite liars.

You never ever stand in it. Definitely that mosque (i.e. Masjid-e-Haram / forbidden mosque) whose basis from the first day is on guard, it has more right that you stand in it. In it are men who love that they purify themselves. And Allah loves those who are purified ones.

Is then, whosoever has the basis of his structure / building on guard from Allah and good pleasure is better or whosoever has the basis of his structure / building over the edge / verge of steep cliff falling down, then it falls down with him in the hell fire. And Allah does not guide the people who are the oppressors.
Their structure / building that they construct / build (on this mosque) will not vanish who have doubt in their hearts except that their hearts are cut off and Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise.

And who is more oppressive than the one who prevented from the mosques of Allah that His name should be remembered in them. And move about / strive in their ruin / decay. For them was that they were not to enter them except afraid / frightened. For them is disgrace in the world. And for them is great punishment in the hereafter.

It is not for the mushriks / associates that they visit the mosques of Allah, they are witnesses with rejection over their souls / selves / psyches. They are those whose works have failed / useless, and they will be in the fire forever.

Surely the number of the months in the nearness of Allah are twelve months in the book of Allah the day He created the skies and the earth, from those four are sacred / holy / forbidden (Ramazan, Shawwal, Zeeqad, Zilhij). That is the judgement established...

The sacred / holy / forbidden month is with the sacred / holy / forbidden month and the sanctities (of the months & its dont's) have relations. So whosoever aggresses on you so you aggress on him with the example of what he aggresses on you. And take guard of Allah and know that Allah is with those who guard themselves.
Ramazan is that month in which Al-Qur'an / the reading has been revealed as a guidance for mankind, and the clarifications from the guidance and from the criterion........
They question you about fighting in the sacred / holy / forbidden month (of Ramazan). Say fighting in it is great (offense).......
O' you who believe! Do not kill the hunt / prey (i.e to chase or search, catching, trapping the prey for the purpose of killing) and you are in sanctities / pilgrimage garb.....

The months of hajj / pilgrimage are known (Shawwal, Zeeqad, Zilhij) so whosoever impose hajj / pilgrimage (on himself) in them so he should not commit obscenity and do not take liberties (of the do's and dont's) and should not debate in the hajj / pilgrimage. And what you do from betterment Allah knows it. And take provision, so surely the best of the provision is to take guard,

O' you who believe! Surely the mushriks / those who associate are impure, so they do not come near the masjid-e-haram / sacred mosque after this their year. And if you feared poverty so soon Allah will enrich you from His bounty if He wants. Surely Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise.
And when the angels said O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh)! Surely Allah has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of all worlds.
O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh)! Be devout for your Lord and prostrate and bow down with those who bow down.
And when We pointed out the place of the house to Ibraheem (pbuh) that you do not associate anything with Me and purify My house for those who go around, and who stand and bow, prostrate.

O' our Lord surely I have settled from my offsprings within the valley which is without cultivation near Your sacred house, O' our Lord, so that they establish salah / prayer. So make the hearts of the people desirable towards them and give them sustenance from the fruits so that they may be thankful.

Those who have been expelled from their circles without truth except that is they said our Lord is Allah, and if Allah did not repelled some of the mankind with some He would definitely demolished silos (for grain storage) places of deals (market places) and prayers and mosques in them the name of Allah is being mentioned / remembered mostly and Allah will definitely help those who help Him. Surely Allah is definitely Powerful, Mighty.

Surely the hypocrites (think that they) are deceiving Allah and He deceives them and when they stand towards the salah / prayer they stand without earnestness, they are showing to the people, and they do not remember Allah except a little.
They are distracted in mind in the midst of it, being for neither of one group and nor for another. And to whom Allah leaves astray, then you will never find a way for him.
And do not ever pray on anyone from those who died and do not stand over their grave. Surely they are those who rejected with Allah and His messenger and they do not die except they are liberals.
Muhammad (pbuh) was not the father / ancestor from any of your men but he is the messenger of Allah and seal of the prophets. And Allah is Knowledgeable with everything.
Whosoever follows the messenger so without doubt he follows Allah / God and who turns back, then We have not sent you as a preserver over them.

Surely those who reject with Allah and His messengers and they want that they differentiate between Allah and His messengers, and they say we believe with some and we reject with some. And they want that they take a way in between.
They are those who are the rejecters in truth. And We have prepared humiliating punishment for the rejecters.
And those who believe with Allah and His messengers and they never differentiate between any one from them, soon they will be given their reward / wages. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

Muhammad (pbuh) is the messenger of Allah and those who are with him (i.e. the believers) are more stronger over the rejecters and are merciful amongst each other. You see them bowing, prostrating, seeking the bounty and good pleasures from Allah. They have marks/recognition from the effects of prostration in their faces / personalities. That is their example in At-Taurah / the law (i.e. Hukm / the governance of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs) and their example in Al-Injeel / the good news (i.e. the confirmation of At-Taurah / the law and the moeza / sermon) is like sowing of a seed, its shoot comes out then it strengthens, then it becomes thick, then it becomes straight over its stalk, the sowers are amazed for what He (Allah) makes the rejecters furious with them (the believers). Allah has promised to those who believe and do corrections for them is forgiveness and mighty wage.

It is not for a human that Allah speaks to him, except by inspiration or from behind a hijab / veil or He sends a messenger, then he inspires with His permission whatever He wills. Surely He is High, Wise.

english_translation: And when his Lord put Ibraheem (pbuh) to trial with words, then he completed them. He said, surely I am the Maker of you the imam / leader for mankind. He said, and from my offsprings? He said, My covenant will not reach the oppressors.

And We made them (prophets) A-immah / the leaders that they guide with Our order and We inspire towards them to do good deeds and establish salah / prayer and give zakah / justification and that they become servants for Us.
The first house placed for the people is that with a place of blessing and guidance for all worlds.

Without doubt, We have seen the movements / turnings of your face in the sky, so We will revert you to a qiblah (direction of belief) so that you will be pleased with it, so revert your face to the intersection / portion / half of the sacred mosque and from wherever you are, revert your faces to the intersection / portion / half of it........
And when We pointed out the place of the house to Ibraheem (pbuh) that you do not associate anything with Me and purify My house for those who go around, and who stand and bow, prostrate.

O' our Lord! Surely I have settled from my offsprings within the valley which is without cultivation near your sacred house, O' our Lord! So that they establish salah / prayer. So make the hearts of the people desirable towards them and give them sustenance from the fruits so that they may be thankful.

In it are clear ayaat / signs, the standing position of Ibraheem (pbuh). Whoever enters it attains security. And for Allah is pilgrimage of the house on the people those who can afford the journey to it. And if anyone rejects, so surely Allah is not needful from the worlds.

And when We made the house a place of reward and safety for people, and you take from the standing place / position of Ibraheem pbuh performed. And we covenanted / took a covenant with Ibraheem (pbuh) and Ismaeel (pbuh) that they should purify My house for those who go around and those who intent upon and those who bow, prostrate.

And We inspired to Moosa / Moses (pbuh) and his brother that you point out houses for your people in Egypt and make your houses a qiblah (an intersection of the sacred mosque) and establish salah / prayer. And give good news to the believers.

Say, my Lord has ordered with justice and that you establish your faces (in salah / prayer) near every mosque and call Him making the judgement exclusively for Him. As He originated you, so you will come back.

Surely the mosques of Allah are visited by the one who believes with Allah and the last day and who establish salah / prayer and who gives zakah / justification and who fear none except Allah. So it may be that they will be among those who are guided.

It is not for the mushriks / associates that they visit the mosques of Allah, they are witnesses with rejection over their souls / selves / psyches. They are those whose works have failed / useless, and they will be in the fire forever.

And what is for them, that Allah should not punish them and that they are in opposition about the sacred mosque and they are not its protectors. The protectors are none except the guarded ones, but majority of them do not know.
Their salah / prayer near the house is nothing except whistling and clapping. So you taste the punishment with what you were rejecting.

And from wherever you come out, (i.e. from any faith) so revert yourself to the intersection / portion of the sacred mosque (direction of belief) and wherever you are, so revert yourselves to its intersection / portion that there would be no dispute over you for the people, except who are oppressors from them. So fear them not but fear Me and that I may complete My favors on you and that you may be guided.

So when you complete the (shortened) salah / prayer then remember Allah in standing and sitting and on your sides. So when you are in tranquility then establish salah / prayer. Surely salah / prayer timings are written over the believers.

And establish salah / prayer in the two extremities the day(day time, zuhar, asr) and from the nearness of the night (night time, maghrib, esha, fajr). Surely the goodness takes away the badness. That is the remembrance for those who remember.

So you be patient over what they say and glorify with the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun (night time, maghrib, isha, fajr) and before its setting (day time, zuhar, asr) and from the parts of the night, (continuous night time, fajr, zuhar, asr, maghrib, isha) so glorify and the extremities of the day (continuous day time fajr, zuhar, asr, maghrib, isha) so that you will be pleased.

Establish salah / prayer by the sun's decline (zuhar, asr salah / prayer) to the darkening of the night (maghrib, esha salah / prayer) and the reading of the dawn, (fajr salah / prayer). Surely the reading of the dawn is witnessed.

And from the night then tahajjud i.e. be vigilant with it, an additional for you, so it may be that your Lord will appoint you to a standing position of praise (In the house of Allah i.e. Muqam-e-Ibraheem / the standing position of Ibraheem pbuh).

O' you who believe! When you stand for salah / prayer wash your faces and your hands to the elbows, and rub your heads and wash your feet to the ankles. And if you are in a state of stranger (physically & psychologically) so purify yourselves. And if you are ill or on a journey or one of you come from offices of nature or you have been in contact with women then you do not find water, so take for yourselves good highland, then rub your faces and your hands from it. Allah does not intend to put on you from any difficulty but He intends for you to purify and to complete His favor on you, so that you may be thankful.

O' you who believe! Do not come near salah / prayer when you are intoxicated, until you know what you are saying. And nor in a state of stranger (physically & psychologically) except you are a crosser of the way until you wash yourselves. And if you are ill or on a journey or one of you come from offices of nature or you have been in contact with women so you do not find water, then take for yourselves good high land then rub your faces and your hands, surely Allah is Pardoning, Forgiving.
Surely I am Allah, there is no god except Me, so serve Me and establish salah / prayer for My remembrance.

Recite what is inspired to you from the book and establish salah / prayer. Surely salah / prayer stops you from obscenity and from disguising. And definitely the remembrance of Allah is greater and Allah knows what you invent.

And remember your Lord in your soul / self / psyche humbly and fearfully other than to be loud from the saying (i.e. recitation ayaat / signs of Al-Quran) in the mornings and evenings (zuhar and asr salah / prayer). And you do not be from those who are unaware.

Say call Allah or call most Gracious, whichsoever you call, so the most beautiful names are for Him. And you should not be loud with your salah / prayer and nor be silent / inaudible with it and that you seek a way in between.
Be preserver over the salawat / prayers and the salah / prayer is a better medium (i.e. to be in communication with Allah). And you stand for Allah devoutly.
So if you are in fear then (pray) on foot or riding. So when you are in security then remember Allah (in salah / prayer) like what He taught you, what you did not know.

Have you not seen that whosoever is in the skies and in the earth and the birds in the rows praising for Allah. Everyone knows his salah / prayer and his glorification / floating. And Allah knows with what they do.
And seek Allah's help with patience and with salah / prayer. Surely it is a great (thing) except on those who are humble.
Those who assume that surely they will meet their Lord and that they will return towards Him.
Those who are continuous over their salah / prayer.

Those were on whom Allah has blessed from the prophets, from the offsprings of Adam and from those whom We carried with Nooh (pbuh) and from the offsprings of Ibraheem (pbuh) and Israel and from those whom We guided and We chose. When the ayaat / signs of the most Gracious were recited on them they fall down prostrating, weeping.
And when they were reminded with the ayaat / signs of their Lord they do not fall down over them deaf and blind.
From after them, then succeeded successors who wasted the salah / prayer and follow the desires. So soon they shall encounter wrong.

Surely the hypocrites (think that they) are deceiving Allah and He deceives them and when they stand towards salah / prayer they stand without earnestness, they are showing to the people, and they do not remember Allah except a little.
They are distracted in mind in the midst of it, being for neither of one group and nor for another. And to whom Allah leaves astray, then you will never find a way for him.
So woe for the musalleen / those who pray.
They are those who are inattentive about their salah / prayer.
They are those who are showing (to the people).
What deported you in saqar / hell?
They will say, we were not from musalleen / those who pray.
So he did not verify it and he did not salla / pray.
And those who say, O' our Lord! Grant for us the cooling of eyes from our pairs and our offsprings and make us an imam / leader for those who guard.
My Lord, make me one who establish salah / prayer and from my offsprings and my Lord, you accept my call.
O' our Lord! Have forgiveness for me and for my parents and for the believers when the day of account is established.
And do not ever pray on anyone from those who died and do not stand over their grave. Surely they are those who rejected with Allah and His messenger and they do not die except they are liberals.

But when they see a business or some amusement they disperse towards it and leave you standing. Say, whatever Allah has is better from the amusement and from the business. And Allah is the best of the sustainers.
When you strike on the earth, there is no blame on you if you shorten your prayers, if you fear the rejecters captivate you. Surely the rejecters are clear enemy for you.
