english_translation: (Sadaqat / charities) For those who are poor, restricted in the way of Allah they do not have the capacity. to strike in the earth, the ignorant calculate them rich from their modestly, you will recognize them with their marks. They do not question mankind insistently / persistently. And whatever you spend from betterment then surely Allah is knowledgeable with it
And other people have confessed with their sins, they have mixed correct acts and other bad acts, it may be that Allah will return over them. Surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
question_text: Q5. How the prayer of the messenger is a satisfaction over us today. Clarify this?

english_translation: Take sadqa / the charity (i.e. any amount according to the means) from their wealth so that you purify and justify them with it and pray over them. Surely your prayer is a satisfaction for them and Allah is Listener, Knowledgeable.
Do not go near the fornication /adultery, surely that is an obscenity and a way to badness.
Surely Allah and His angels pray over the prophet. O' you who believe! Pray over him and submit by submitting.
question_text: Q6. At-tahiyyat and darood are not mentioned in Al-Quran. Why do we recite them in the salah / prayers?

english_translation: He (that is Allah) and His angels who pray over you. So that He takes you out from the darkness towards light. And He is Merciful with the believers.

It is He who has made the sun shining and the moon to be a light / reflection and He has evaluated its lunar mansion (i.e. each of 28 divisions of the ecliptic occupied by the moon on successive days) for you to know the number of years and the calculation. Allah has not created that except with the truth. He has explained the ayaat / signs in detail for the people who know[cite: 542].

Surely the number of the months in the nearness of Allah are twelve months in the book of Allah the day He created the skies and the earth, from those, four are sacred / holy / forbidden. (Ramazan, Shawwal, Zulqad, Zilhij) That is the judgement established. So you do not oppress yourselves / souls / psyches in them (by fighting) and you fight the mushriks / associates entirely like that they fight you entirely (in other than sacred months). And know that Allah is with those who guard themselves[cite: 543].

The sacred / holy / forbidden month is with the sacred / holy / forbidden month and the sanctities (of the months & its dont's) have relations. So whosoever aggresses on you so you aggress on him with the example of what he aggresses on you. And take guard of Allah and know that Allah is with those who guard themselves[cite: 544].

Ramazan is that month in which Al-Quran is revealed as a guide for mankind, and for the clarification from the guidance and from the criterion, so amongst you whosoever witnesses that month then he should fast in it.......[cite: 544]

The months of hajj / pilgrimage are known (Shawwal, Zulqadah, Zilhij) so whosoever impose hajj / pilgrimage (on himself) in them so he should not commit obscenity and do not take liberties (of the do's and dont's) and should not debate in the hajj / pilgrimage. And what you do from betterment Allah knows it. And take provision, so surely the best of the provision is to take guard and take guard from Me O' you who possess the core! (those who know the essence / spirit of ayaat / signs)[cite: 545].

Then make a trip in the earth (for hajj / pilgrimage those who have the means) in four months (Ramazan, Shawwal, Zulqad, Zilhij) and know that you cannot disable the will of Allah and that Allah will disgrace those who reject[cite: 545].
O' you who believe! Fasting is written over you, like what was written over those before you, that you may take guard[cite: 545].

It is lawful for you to be indecent / to have obscene talks to your women in the night of fast, they are a covering for you and you are covering for them. Allah knows that you betrayed yourselves, so He returns over you and pardoned you about it. So now accompany them and seek what Allah has written for you, and eat and drink until from dawn the white thread clarifies for you from the black thread, then complete the fast towards the night, and you do not accompany them when you are devoted in the mosques. These are the boundaries of Allah so you do not go near them. Likewise Allah clarifies His ayaat / signs for people so that they may take guard[cite: 546].

Your Lord knows that you stand forth a little from two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or a third of it, and a party of those with you. And Allah appoints night and day in due measure. He knows that you are unable to keep its count, so He returns over you, then read from the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knows that there may be among you who are sick, others striking in the land, seeking bounty from Allah. And others are fighting in the way of Allah. Then read from it as much as may be easy for you. And establish salah / prayer and give zakah / justification and give loan to Allah a beautiful loan. And whatever from good you send for your souls you will find it near Allah. That is better and greater in reward. And seek the forgiveness of Allah. Surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful[cite: 547].

They question you about fighting in the sacred / holy / forbidden month (of Ramazan). Say fighting in it is big (offence) and to oppose from the way of Allah and from the sacred mosque and to reject with it and to expel its people from it is greater (offence) in the nearness of Allah and captivation / fascination is a greater (offence) than killing (physically). And if they have the capability they will not cease to fight you until you turn from your judgment (i.e. to establish Islam / to attain peace). And amongst you whosoever turns away from his judgement then he dies and he is a rejecter, so they are those whose works have failed in this world and in the hereafter and they are the companions of fire, they will dwell in it[cite: 548].
Surely your wealth and your children are a captivation. And near Allah is a great reward[cite: 549].

And they ask you about the crescent / the new moon. (i.e. each of 28 divisions of the ecliptic occupied by the moon on successive days) Say they are the timings for mankind and timings of hajj / pilgrimage....... (i.e. Starting and ending of the hajj)[cite: 549].

So when the sacred / holy / forbidden months are ended (Ramazan, Shawwal, Zulqadah, Zilhij) then fight / kill (the self / soul / psyche of) the associates wherever you find them and catch them and confine them and sit on every place of ambush for them. So if they repent and establish salah / prayer and give zakah / justification so leave the way for them. Surely Allah is all Forgiving, Merciful[cite: 550].

Surely the postponement of it (sacred / holy / forbidden month) is an increase in the rejection, those who reject are astray with it. They make it (i.e. sacred / holy / forbidden month) un-sacred / un-holy / lawful in a year and make it (i.e. sacred / holy / forbidden month) sacred / holy / forbidden in a year. So that they adjust the numbers to what Allah has made sacred / holy / forbidden. So they make it un-sacred / lawful to what Allah has made sacred / holy / forbidden. Their bad works are adornment for them. And Allah does not guide the people who are rejecters[cite: 550].

It is lawful for you to be indecent / to have obscene talks to your women in the night of fast, they are a covering for you and you are covering for them. Allah knows that you betrayed yourselves, so He returns over you and pardoned you about it. So now accompany them and seek what Allah has written for you, and eat and drink until from dawn the white thread clarifies for you from the black thread, then complete the fast towards the night, and you do not accompany them when you are devoted in the mosques. These are the boundaries of Allah so you do not go near them. Likewise Allah clarifies His ayaat / signs for people so that they may take guard[cite: 552].
question_text: Q1. Can women sit in Aitekaaf in the month of Ramazan?

english_translation: Allah will not catch you with nonsensical / ungrammatical talk in your right. And He will catch you with what you fastened / tied the knot in your right and the atonement / amendment / correction is feeding of the ten needy persons from an average of what you feed to your family or garb them (ie, a distinctive of a uniform kind) or liberate / free a slave. Then whosoever does not find (this) then fast for three days. That is an atonement / amendment / correction of your right when you take an oath. And preserve your right. Likewise Allah clarifies His ayaat / signs for you so that you may be thankful[cite: 553].
question_text: Q2. What is the kaffara or atonement if we fight or quarrel in the sacred month of Ramazan?

english_translation: Surely We have revealed it in the night of evaluation[cite: 554].
question_text: Q3. What is lailat-ul-qadar (last ten nights)? Can you clarify from the Quran?

english_translation: And what you can perceive that what is the night of evaluation[cite: 554].
Night of evaluation is better from thousand months[cite: 554].
The angels and Ar-rooh / the spirit is sent down in it with the permission of their Lord, from every order[cite: 554].
Peace, until the rise of fajr / dawn[cite: 554].
Haa meem[cite: 555].
By the clear book[cite: 555].
Surely We have revealed it in the blessed night and surely We are warners[cite: 555].
In that (night) every order of wisdom is separated[cite: 555].
Order is from the nearness of Us. Surely We are the senders[cite: 555].
By the fajr / dawn[cite: 556].
By ten nights[cite: 556].
By even and odd[cite: 556].
By the night when it passes away[cite: 556].
O' you who believe! Fasting is written over you, like what was written over those before you, that you may take guard[cite: 572].

Days counted / numbered. So whosoever from you is sick or over a journey then counted / numbered from the other days. And over those who are enclosed / encircled then ransom / redemption is to feed the needy persons. So whosoever voluntarily does betterment then it is better for him and that you fast, it is better for you if you know[cite: 573].

Ramazan is that month in which Al-Quran / the reading has been revealed as a guide for mankind, and the clarification from the guidance and from the criterion, so from you whosoever witnessed that month then he should fast in it. Those who are sick or on a journey then counting / numbering is from the other days. Allah intends easiness for you, and He does not intend any difficulty for you, that you may complete the counting, and so that you greaten Allah over what He guided you, and that you may be thankful[cite: 571, 572].

It is lawful for you to be indecent / to have obscene talks to your women in the night of fast, they are a covering for you and you are covering for them. Allah knows that you betrayed yourselves, so He returns over you and pardoned you about it. So now accompany them and seek what Allah has written for you, and eat and drink until from dawn the white thread clarifies for you from the black thread, then complete the fast towards the night, and you do not accompany them when you are devoted in the mosques. These are the boundaries of Allah so you do not go near them. Likewise Allah clarifies His ayaat / signs for people so that they may take guard[cite: 574].

And complete hajj / pilgrimage and umrah / visit for Allah. If you are being restricted so seek what is easy from the gift (i.e. from the cattle) and you do not shave your heads until your gift has reached its place of slaughter. So whosoever is sick from you or with him there is a hurt from his head then you ransom / redemption from fasting or charity or reclusion / solitude. Then when you are secure so who enjoyed with umrah / visit towards hajj / pilgrimage so seek what is easy from the gift (i.e. from the cattle) then whosoever do not find then fasting for three days in hajj / pilgrimage and seven when you return. That is complete ten. That is to whom his family is not present at the sacred mosque. And take guard of Allah and know that surely Allah is strong / severe in pursuit[cite: 574, 575].

And it is not for a believer that he kills a believer except by mistake. And whosoever kills a believer by mistake then he should liberate / free a believing slave, and pay flawlessly / uncontested blood money towards his family, except that they give charity (by forgiving). Then if he is from the people who are your enemy and he was a believer. Then he should liberate / free a believing slave. And if he is from the people where with between you and between them there is a covenant. Then pay flawlessly / uncontested blood money towards his family. And he should liberate / free a believing slave. Then whosoever does not find (this) then two months of fasting consecutively / continuously. A way of returning / repentance from Allah. And Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise[cite: 576].

Allah will not catch you with nonsensical / ungrammatical talk in your right. It is He (Allah) Who appointed in ummiyoon / motherly people a messenger from them. He recites over them. His ayaat / signs and justify them and he gives them knowledge of Al-Kitab / the book and Al-hikmah / the wisdom. And they definitely were from before in clear straying.[cite: 687]
And others from them who have not joined with them. And He is the Mighty, the Wise.[cite: 687]

Like this We have sent in you a messenger from your (self / psyche) who recites Our ayaat / signs over you and he justifies you and gives you the knowledge of Al-Kitab / the book and Al-hikmah / the wisdom and gives you the knowledge of that you never knew.[cite: 688]

Without doubt Allah has favoured over the believers when He appointed a messenger from their souls / selves / psyches, he recites over them His ayaat / signs and he justifies them and he gives the knowledge of Al-Kitab / the book and Al-hikmah / the wisdom. And from before definitely they were in clear straying.[cite: 688]

And what your Lord cities unless He appoints a messenger in Umm / mother of those cities, he recites over them Our ayaat / signs, and We are not Destroyer of Qura / cities except their people are oppressors.[cite: 689]
And how many from Qarya / city We destroyed who were arrogant on its livelihood. So that is their residences not resided from after them except little. And We are the inheritors.[cite: 689]
And mention Maryam / Mary (pbuh) in the book when she separated from her family to an eastern place.[cite: 690]

When the angels said, O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh), surely Allah gives you the good news with a word from Him, his name will be Al-Maseeh Essa / Christ Jesus (pbuh), the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh), held in honour in this world and in the hereafter and from those who are the close ones.[cite: 690]
Then apart from them she took a hijab / veil, then We sent to her Our rooh / spirit / essence. So he was an even example of a human for her.[cite: 690]
She said, I seek refuge from you with the most Gracious if you are guarded.[cite: 692]
He said, surely I am a messenger from your Lord to grant you the justified son.[cite: 692]
She said, how can he be a son for me, when no human has touched me, and I am not wrong.[cite: 692]
He said likewise your Lord said it is easy over Me. And from Us (i.e.Allah) We will make him (i.e. Essa / Jesus pbuh) a sign and mercy for mankind. And the order was completed.[cite: 692]
So she conceived him and she separated with him to a remote place. (i.e. distant place in time)[cite: 692]

When the angels said, O' Maryam / Mary (pbuh), surely Allah gives you the good news with a word from Him, his name will be Al-Maseeh Essa / Christ Jesus pbuh, the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh), held in honour in this world and in the hereafter and from those who are the close ones.[cite: 692]
And he will speak to the people in the cradle and in maturity. And he will be from those who correct themselves.[cite: 692]

She said, my Lord how he will become a son for me when no man has touched me? He said, even so Allah creates what He wills. When the order is complete, then surely He said for him, "be" and he becomes.[cite: 692]
And He (Allah) will teach him (Essa / Jesus pbuh) Al-Kitab / The Book and Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom and At-Taurah / The Law and Al-Injeel / The Good News.[cite: 692]
He said, surely I am the servant of Allah. He has given me Al-Kitab / The Book and made me a prophet.[cite: 693]

Those are the messengers We gave superiority to some of them over some. From them are those to whom Allah spoke and rafa / raised some of them in degrees. And We gave Essa / Jesus (pbuh) son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) the clarifications and We strengthened him with the holy spirit. And if Allah wants they do not fight from after them from after the clarifications came to them but they differed, so from them are who believe and from them are who reject. And if Allah wants they do not fight. And Allah does what He wants.[cite: 693]
So the pains drove her towards the trunk of a palm tree, she said Oh! I wish I had died before this and I was lost, forgotten.[cite: 694]
Then from beneath her he (i.e. spirit / essence) called her, that you do not grieve, without doubt your Lord has made living / subsistence beneath / under you.[cite: 694]
And shake towards you with the trunk of a palm tree, the fresh ripe dates will fall on you.[cite: 694]

So eat (fresh ripe dates) and drink (from the spring) and cool your eyes, then if you see anyone from a human, so say, surely I have dedicated a fast for the most Gracious so I will not speak to any man this day.[cite: 694]
And He (Allah) will teach him (Essa / Jesus pbuh) Al-Kitab / The Book and Al-Hikmah / The Wisdom and At-Taurah / The Law and Al-Injeel / The Good News.[cite: 695]

Those who follow the messenger, motherly prophet whom they find written near them in At-taurah / the law and in Al-Injeel / the good news. He (Essa / Jesus pbuh) orders them with the acknowledged and forbids them about the disguised and he (Essa / Jesus pbuh) makes good things lawful for them and he (Essa / Jesus pbuh) makes bad things unlawful on them and he removes about them their load and handcuffs that were over them. So those who believe with it and (follow) his penal laws and help him and follow the light that is sent down / revealed with him. They are those who are successful ones.[cite: 695]

And (I Essa / Jesus pbuh) is the verifier that is between my two hands / in front from At-taurah / the law and I make lawful for you some that is forbidden over you and I come to you with an ayah / sign from your Lord. So take guard of Allah and obey me.[cite: 696]
So with the oppression from those who are hadoo / lenient / jews We made unlawful over them good things that were lawful for them and with their stopping to many about the way of Allah.[cite: 696]

And over those who are hadoo / lenient / jews We made unlawful every (animal) with nails. And from the cow and goat We made unlawful over them their fat except what they carry on their backs or intestines or mixed with bones. That is the reward We gave wrong with their, surely We truthful ones.[cite: 697]

All food was lawful for children of Israel except what Israel has forbidden on his soul / self / psyche from before the revelation of At-taurah / the law. Say come with At-taurah / the law then recite it if you are truthful.[cite: 697]
And over those who are hadoo / jews We made unlawful that We related over you from before. And We did not oppress them but they were oppressing their souls / selves / psyches.[cite: 698]

Say, O' mankind! Surely I am a messenger of Allah to all of you together, for Him is the kingdom of the skies and the earth There is no God except Him, He gives life and death. So believe with Allah and His messenger, the motherly prophet who believes with Allah and His words and follow him, may be you get guidance.[cite: 698]

And when Allah said O' Essa / Jesus (pbuh) the son of Maryam / Mary (pbuh) did you say to mankind that you take me and my mother as gods other than Allah? He said, glory to You, never could I say with what I had no right. If I have said such a thing, so definitely You would have known it. You know what is in my soul / self / psyche and I do not know what is in Your soul / self / psyche. Surely You are knower of all that is absent.[cite: 699]
The first house being placed for people is that with Bakka, of blessing and guidance for all worlds.[cite: 700]

Glory to Him (Allah) who traveled with His servant (Ar Rooh / The Spirit) by night from Al-Masjid-e-Haraam / The Forbidden Mosque to Al-Aqsa / the remotest mosque (distant in time, solitary / inconsiderable and isolated) whose surroundings We have blessed so that We show him from Our ayaat / signs. Surely He is the Listener, the One with an insight.[cite: 700]
why not revealed over a great man from the two cities (i.e Mecca and Madina).[cite: 700]
And you were not with the western side when We completed the order towards Moosa (pbuh) and you were not from the witnesses.[cite: 701]

But We initiated centuries, then long ages passed over them. And you were not dweller / resident in family of Madyan, you recite Our ayaat / signs over them. But We were senders (of messengers).[cite: 701]

And you were not with the side of At-tur / the condition / stage (of the mountain) when We called but it is a mercy from your Lord that you warn people to whom no one had come from warner from before you that they may receive / have remembrance.[cite: 701]

And those who do not know said why not Allah speaks to us. Likewise those who are from before them said example of their saying. Their hearts are similar. Without doubt We clarify the ayaat / signs for people who are certain.[cite: 703]
points_notes_eng: Q1. Your lecture clarifies that Allah only speaks to one bashar / human and through that one human Allah conveys His message to all mankind. Why not Allah speaks to all of us directly?[cite: 703]

english_translation: And when ayah / sign came to them they said we will not believe unless we receive like what messengers of Allah was given. Allah knows more where He (Allah) makes / places His message. Soon will reach them who do crime littleness / humiliation near Allah and severe punishment with what they were planning.[cite: 704]

Allah will not leave the believers on that you were over it unless He (Allah) nes the bad from the good. And it is not on Allah that He (Allah) informs you over the absent, but Allah selects from messengers whom He (Allah) wills. So believe with Allah and His messengers. And if you believe and you take guard, so for you is great reward.[cite: 705]
And they said why not an angel is sent down over him. And if We have sent down an angel definitely the order would be completed then they will not be given respite.[cite: 706]
points_notes_eng: Q2. We know from before that Jibreel is an angel and he revealed the Quran on Muhammad (pbuh)?[cite: 706]

english_translation: And if We (Allah) make him an angel definitely We (Allah) made him a man and definitely We (Allah) made them wear over them what they are wearing.[cite: 706]
Say if angels were walking in the earth quietly / calmly definitely We would have send down over them from the sky an angel messenger.[cite: 707]
And what stopped the mankind to believe when the guidance came to them except that they said has Allah appointed a human messenger?[cite: 707]
And when they see you they do not take you except jestly / mockingly. Is this the one whom Allah appointed a messenger.[cite: 707]
When We (Allah) sent two towards them so they belied both of them, so We (Allah) supported with third, so they said surely we have been sent towards you.[cite: 708]
They said you were not except human like us, and the most Gracious (Allah) not revealed / sent down from anything. You are not except that you are lying.[cite: 708]
They said our Lord knows surely we have been sent towards you.[cite: 708]
Allah it is not on us except to convey clearly.[cite: 708]

Say surely I am a bashar / human like you. It has been inspired towards me that surely your God is one God. Then steadfast towards Him and seek His forgiveness. And woe for those who associate (with Allah).[cite: 709]

O' you who believe! Believe in Allah and His messenger and His Book which He has revealed over His messenger and the Book which He sent before. Anyone who denies Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, and the hereafter, he has gone far astray.[cite: 710]
points_notes_eng: Q3. In Nisa 4:136 the word Kitab / book is mentioned 2 times and the word Kutub / books is mentioned 1 time. Your lecture clarifies that the book is one. Then what are the books in plural mentioned in this ayat. Clarify this?[cite: 710]

english_translation: A rasool / messenger from Allah he recites purified pages.[cite: 711]
In them (pages) are kutub / books / writings established.[cite: 711]

And when Our bayyinah / clear ayaat / signs are recited over them they said, this is not, except a man who intends to oppose you about what your ancestors served. And they said, this is not, except a falsehood invented. And those who reject say for the truth when it comes to them, it is not except a clear magic.[cite: 711]
And We have not given them kutub / books / writings from which they are taking lessons. And before you We have not sent towards them from a warner.[cite: 711]

The messenger believed with what is revealed / sent down towards him from his Lord and the believers. Everyone believed with Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers. We do not make distinction between anyone from His messengers. And they said we listened and we obeyed, our Lord (we seek) your forgiveness and towards you is the returning place.[cite: 712]

And Maryam / Mary (pbuh) the daughter of Imran who fortified / guarded her gap / private part and We breathed into it (i.e. gap / private part) of Our rooh / spirit and she was truthful with the words of her Lord and His books and she was from the devout ones.[cite: 712]
Without doubt, We have revealed to you a book, your remembrance is in it. Then do you not use intelligence.[cite: 713]
points_notes_eng: Q4. When this book is from the beginning then the prophets must have knowledge about their events from before? Clarify this?[cite: 713]

english_translation: Did not the prophecy comes to you who are from before you, people of Nooh (pbuh) and Aad and Samood. And those from after them. No one knows them except Allah. Come to them their messengers with clarifications. So they put their hands in their mouth and they said surely we reject with what you were sent with it and surely we are in suspicion from that you are inviting us towards it doubting.[cite: 713]
And without doubt Our words preceded for Our servants who are the messengers.[cite: 714]
Those are from prophecies of the absent We inspired towards you. You did not know it, you and not your people from before this. So be patient. Surely the end is for those who guard.[cite: 714]

Did you not see that surely Allah sent down water from the sky. Then we taken out fruits with it of different colors. And from the mountains, its tracts white and red of different colors and dark black.[cite: 582]
Did hadith / event of Moosa / Moses (pbuh) come to you?[cite: 592]
When his Lord called him within the holy valley of fold.[cite: 592]

And when Moosa/Moses (pbuh) arrived for Our appointed time, and his Lord spoke to him. He said, O' my Lord show me, that I may look towards You. He said, you can never see Me, but look towards the mountain if it remains in its place, so you may see Me. Then his Lord threw light for the mountain He crumbled it and Moosa / Moses (pbuh) fell down stunned, then he excelled. He said, glory to You and I return towards You and I am first of the believers.[cite: 592]

And when We shook the mountain above them as if it was a Canopy / overhanging projection and they assumed that it was about to fall with them. Take with strength what We have given you and remember what is in it, may be you take guard.[cite: 593]
And when We took the covenant from you and We raised above you Tur / stage / condition. Take with strength what We have given you and remember what is in it, may be you take guard.[cite: 594]
And without doubt He created you in stages.[cite: 594]

If We have revealed this Al-Quran on a mountain definitely you will see it humble, faulty / rift / burst open from the fear of Allah. And those are the examples We strike with it for the people so that they may reflect.[cite: 595]

Allah is the light / reflection of the skies and the earth. The example of His light / reflection is like a niche in it is a lamp, the lamp is in the glass container. The glass container is as it were a pearly planet, (it) is being lit from a blessed tree, an olive neither of the east and nor of the west, its oil is about to lit, and even fire did not touch it. Light over light, Allah / God guides to His light whom He wills, and Allah / God strikes the examples for the people. And Allah / God is Knowledgeable with all things.[cite: 595]
And / by the figs and the olives.[cite: 596]
And / by Tur / stage / condition sineen / supported mountain rocks.[cite: 596]
And / by this city of security.[cite: 596]

And when Ibraheem (pbuh) said, my Lord, make this city of security and provide sustenance to its family from the fruits, whosoever believe from them in Allah and the last day. He said and whosoever reject then I will give him little commodity then I will force him towards a punishment of the fire. And how bad (is) the destination.[cite: 597]
When Ibraheem (pbuh) said, my Lord, make this city secure and make me and my sons strangers that we serve idols.[cite: 597]

My Lord, they have indeed led astray the majority from the people, he whosoever follows me then surely he is from me and whosoever disobeys me then surely You are indeed Forgiving, Merciful.[cite: 597]

And jahedo / you strive in Allah as the right of His jihad / strive. He has chosen you and He has made no difficulty over you in Ad-deen / the judgement (i.e. Islam / to attain peace). The millat / religion of your ancestor Ibraheem (pbuh). He has named you muslimeen / submitters from before and in this so that the messenger be a witness over you and you be a witness over mankind. Then establish salah / prayer and hold fast with Allah. He is your Protector so He is the blessed Protector and the blessed Helper.[cite: 598]

O' our Lord surely I have settled from my offsprings within the valley other than that it is without cultivation near Your sacred / forbidden house, O' Our Lord, so that they establish salah / prayer. Then make the hearts of the people desirable towards them and give them sustenance from the fruits so that they may be thankful.[cite: 599]

Surely, Safa and Marwah are from the consciousness / awareness of Allah, so whosoever perform haj / pilgrimage or umrah of the house, it is no offence on him, that he goes around with them and whosoever voluntarily does betterment so surely Allah is Thankful, Knowledgeable.[cite: 599]

Surely, I am being ordered that I serve the Lord of this city, who has made it sacred / forbidden, and for Him are all things. And I am being ordered that I become from those who are muslims/submitters.[cite: 600]

And that is to recite the Quran, then whosoever takes guidance, then surely he takes guidance for his own self / soul / psyche. And whosoever goes astray then say, surely I am from the warners.[cite: 600]
And say praise is for Allah, Who will soon show you His ayaat / signs so that you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware about what you do.[cite: 600]
And firoun / pharaoh called in his people, he said O' my people! Is not the kingdom of Egypt for me? And the streams that flow underneath me. So do you not have sight?[cite: 602]
points_notes_eng: Q1. In a movie titled ten commandments where Moosa / Moses (pbuh) was shown that he was in Egypt. Does the Quran confirm this?[cite: 602]

english_translation: Surely pharaoh became high in the earth and he made its family sects. He weakened a group from them, he slaughter / sacrifice their sons and he kept alive / shamed their women." Surely he was from the corrupted ones.[cite: 602]

And We inspired to mother of Moosa / Moses (pbuh) that to feed him, so if you feared on (for) him, so throw him in the sea and you do not fear, and you do not be grieved, surely We will return him to you, and make him from the messengers.[cite: 603]

So follower of firoun / pharaoh found and picked him (Moosa / Moses pbuh) up, so that he becomes for them an enemy and sadness / grief. Surely firoun / pharaoh and haman and both of their forces were those who commited mistakes.[cite: 603]

And wife of firoun / pharaoh said, (this child) is the coolness of eyes for me and for you. You do not kill him. Perhaps he might be beneficial for us or we take him a son. And they are not conscious.[cite: 603]

So We returned him to his mother in order that her eye delights / satisfies and she did not be saddened / grieved, and to know that Allah's promise (is) truth, but most of them do not know.[cite: 604]
And when he (Moosa / Moses pbuh) attained maturity and was even We gave him governance and knowledge. And likewise We reward for those who do good.[cite: 604]
And when Moosa / Moses (pbuh) said to his youth / servant, I will not leave / depart until I will reach the meeting place of both oceans / seas, or I pass / complete a period of time.[cite: 604]
points_notes_eng: Q2. Does the Quran clarifies journey of Moosa / Moses (pbuh) from Egypt into the present Saudi Arabia?[cite: 604]

english_translation: So when they both reached (a) place of meeting (point of joint) between both of them (the two seas / oceans / rivers), they forgot their large fish / whale, so it took / received its path in the sea / ocean / river sneaking away (it escaped into the body of water).[cite: 605]
He said, that is what we were seeking after. So they both returned on their tracks / marks relating[cite: 605]
So both of them found a servant from Our servants We gave him Mercy from Our nearness and We taught him from Our knowledge.[cite: 605]
He said, this is a separation between me and between you, I will inform you with interpretation on what you were not able (to have) patience on it.[cite: 605]

And as for the wall, so it was (belonging) for two boys, two orphans in Al-Medina and under it was a treasure for both of them, and their father was correct / righteous, so your Lord wanted / willed that they both reach their maturity / strength, and they both take out their treasure, mercy from your Lord, I did not do it from my order. That (is) interpretation (of) what you were not able (to have) patience on it.[cite: 606]

And when (Moosa / Moses pbuh) entered Al-Medina at a time when its people were inattentive then he found two men fighting in it. One was from his sect and the other one from his enemy. So the one from his sect seek his aid over the one from his enemy. Then Moosa / Moses (pbuh) struck him with a fist. So he ended (his life) over him. He said, this is from the work of shaitaan / satan. Surely he is a clear enemy, the one who misleads.[cite: 607]

So his morning was inned observing / guarding, so then who sought victory / aid from him yesterday / past, he cries out / screams for his help, Moses / Moosa (pbuh) said to him, surely you are a clear misleading one.[cite: 607]

And a man came from the remotest part of Medina walking quickly / hastening he said, O' Moosa / Moses (pbuh) surely the chiefs ordering each other with (about) you, to kill you, so get out, that I am for you from the advisors / councillors.[cite: 608]

And when he arrived to the watering / drinking place of Madyan he found at it nation from the people who were watering / drinking. And apart from them he found two women keeping off. He said, what is your matter / concern? They said we do not water / drink until the shepherds drive off / proceed and our father is big, old (man).[cite: 608]
points_notes_eng: Q3. Is there any evidence in the Quran that how and why Moosa / Moses (pbuh) came to Mecca?[cite: 609]

english_translation: So he watered / gave drink for both of them then he turned away towards a shade then he said, my Lord surely I am needy from whatever betterment You revealed on me.[cite: 609]

Then one of them came to him (i.e. Moosa / Moses pbuh). She walks over shyness she said, surely my father invites you that he rewards you a wage of what you watered / gave drink for us. So when he came to him and he related / narrated over him the relationship / narration, he said you do not fear you have been saved from the people who are the oppressors.[cite: 610]
One of them said, O' my father! Seek reward from him surely you seek reward who is the strong, the trustworthy.[cite: 610]

He said surely I intend to marry one of my these two daughters with you on that you will give me reward of eight hajj / pilgrimages. So if you complete ten then it is on you. And I do not intend to make hardship on you. If Allah wills soon you will find me from those who correct themselves.[cite: 610]
He (Moosa / Moses pbuh) said, that is between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I will complete, so there will be no enmity on me. And Allah is an advocate over what we say.[cite: 611]

And We took a promise with Moosa / Moses (pbuh) of thirty nights and We completed with ten then completed the place of time of his Lord forty nights, and Moosa / Moses (pbuh) said for his brother Haroon (pbuh) you succeed me in my people and correct and you do not follow the way of those who are the corrupted ones.[cite: 612]

Ramadhan is that month in which Al-Quran / the reading has been revealed, a guide for mankind, and the clarification from the guidance and from the criterion, so from you whosoever witnessed that month then he should fast in it. And whoever is sick or on a journey then he counts in other days. Allah intends easiness with you, and He does not intend difficulty with you. And so you complete the counting, and seek Allah's greatness on that He gave you guidance and so that you may be thankful.[cite: 612]

And complete hajj / pilgrimage and umrah / visit for Allah. If you are being restricted so seek what is easy from the gift (i.e. from the cattle) and you do not shave your heads until your gift has reached its place of slaughter. So whosoever is sick from you or with him there is a hurt from his head then you ransom / redemption from fasting or charity or reclusion / solitude. Then when you are secure so who enjoyed with umrah / visit towards hajj / pilgrimage so seek what is easy from the gift (i.e. from the cattle) then whosoever do not find then fasting for three days in hajj / pilgrimage and seven when you return. That is complete ten. That is to whom his family is not present at the sacred mosque. And take guard of Allah and know that surely Allah is strong in pursuit.[cite: 613]

Surely Ad-deen / the judgment in the nearness of Allah is Al-Islam / to attain peace and those who were given Al-Kitab / the book did not differ except to wrong each other after the knowledge came to them. And whosoever rejects with the ayaat / signs of Allah then surely Allah is quick in taking the account.[cite: 627]
O' you who believe! Take guard of Allah and seek the means towards Him and strive in His way so that you may prosper.[cite: 627]
And those jahadoo / who strive in Us definitely We will guide them to Our ways and surely Allah is with those who do good.[cite: 628]
And whosoever jahada / strive (in Allah) so surely yujahido / he strives for his own soul / self /psyche. Surely Allah is free of any need from the worlds.[cite: 628]
So you do not obey the rejecters and jihad / strive against them with this (i.e. do's and don'ts of Al-Qur'an) that is the great jihad / strive.[cite: 628]

And those who reject (i.e. Ad-deen / the judgement of Al-Islam / to attain peace) are protectors of one another, unless you do this (i.e. protect each other) there would be captivation and a great corruption in the earth.[cite: 628]
Or do you calculate that you will enter garden and whereas Allah knows jahadoo / those who strive from you and He knows who have patience.[cite: 629]

And jahedo / you strive in Allah as the right of His jihad / strive. He has chosen you and He has made no difficulty over you in Ad-deen / the judgement (i.e. Islam / to attain peace). The millat / religion of your ancestor Ibraheem (pbuh). He has named you muslimeen / submitters from before and in this so that the messenger be a witness over you and you be a witness over mankind. Then establish salah / prayer and give zakah / justification and hold fast with Allah. He is your Protector so He is the blessed Protector and the blessed Helper.[cite: 629]

O' you who believe! Do not take your fathers / ancestors and your brothers as protectors if they seek to love rejection over belief (i.e. ad-deen / the judgment of Al-Islam / to attain peace). And whosoever from you take them as protectors then they are the oppressors.[cite: 630]

Say, if your fathers / ancestors and your sons and your brothers and your pairs / wives and your relatives and the wealth to which you are committed and the business in which you fear a slump and the residences in which you are pleased. You have more love towards them than Allah and His messenger and jihad / to strive in His way then you wait until Allah comes with His order. And Allah does not guide the people who are liberals.[cite: 630]

Surely those who believe and who migrate (in belief) and jahadoo / they strive with their wealth (i.e to give the 1/5th of the ghanim / profit) and with their psyches / souls / selves in the way of Allah and those who give shelter and help them, they are protectors of one another. And those who believe and do not migrate (in belief) it is not (a duty) for you to protect them from anything until they migrate (in belief). And if they seek your help in the judgement (i.e. of Al-Islam / to attain peace) then (duty) over you is that you help them except over the people there is a covenant (i.e. of not helping in the judgement) between you and them. And Allah is the One Who has insight with what you do.[cite: 631]

It is He Who has sent His messenger with guidance and with the judgement of truth (that is Al-Islam / to attain peace). so that he makes it obvious on His every deen / judgement and even if those who associate (with Him) dislike it.[cite: 632]
And whosoever seeks a deen / judgement other than Islam / to attain peace then it will never be accepted from him and he will be from the lost ones in the hereafter.[cite: 632]
The dye / colour of Allah (i.e. Ad-deen / the judgement of Al-Islam / to attain peace) and who can be more good than Allah to dye / color and we are servants for Him.[cite: 633]
Say, do you reason with us (in) concerning Allah and that He is our Lord and your Lord and our works are for us and your works are for you and we are sincere for Him.[cite: 633]

Surely Allah has purchased from the believers their souls / selves / psyches and their wealth, with that garden is for them. They fight in the way of Allah then they kill (their souls / psyches) and get (their souls / psyches) killed. A promise on Him in truth in At-Taurah / the law and Al-Injeel / the good news and in Al-Quran / the reading. And who can fulfill with his promise than Allah, then rejoice with your deal that you bargained with Him. And that is the supreme achievement.[cite: 634]
points_notes_eng: Q1. Can you quote any ayah / sign from the Quran to establish the spiritual killing?[cite: 634]

english_translation: And remember Moosa (pbuh) said to his people, O' my people! As for the boy / son, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would grieve them by unjust harshness and rejection.[cite: 670]
So we intended that their Lord would give them in exchange a better one from him as a justification and nearer in mercy.[cite: 670]

As for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys / sons in the city, there was beneath it a buried treasure for them. Their father was a righteous man. So your Lord intended that they both should attain the age of full strength and take out their treasure, a mercy from your Lord. I have not done it from my order. That is the interpretation over which you do not have the capacity to have patience.[cite: 670]

O' you who believe! Surely the majority from ahbar / the scholars and rohban / the terrorists definitely eat the wealth of the people with falsehood and they oppose from the way of Allah. And they are those who hoard gold and silver (i.e. a supply of food, money etc that is carefully guarded for future use) and they do not spend it in the way of Allah, then give them the good news with the painful punishment.[cite: 577]

And when it is said to them to spend with what Allah has given the sustenance to you, those (i.e. ahbar / the scholars and rohban / the terrorists( who reject say to those who believe, Shall we feed to the one whom if Allah willed, He would have fed. You are not, except in clear straying.[cite: 578]

Without doubt Allah has heard the saying of those (i.e. ahbar / the scholars and rohban / the terrorists) who say surely Allah is poor and we are rich. Soon We will write down what they have said and their killing (i.e. personality) of the prophets without truth. And We will say, taste the punishment of burning.[cite: 578]

And they took Ar-Riba / the increase (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit) and without doubt And they ate the money of the people (of the categories) with falsehood and for the rejecters from them We have prepared a painful punishment.[cite: 579]
O' you who believe! Take guard of Allah and leave off what remains from Ar-Riba / the increase (i.e.1/5th of the ghanim / profit), if you are believers.[cite: 579]

Then if you do not, (leave off, what remains from ar-riba / the increase i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit), so take a notice of war from Allah and His messenger. And if you turn back, so the heads of your wealth are for you (i.e.4/5th of the ghanim / profit). You do not oppress and you will not be oppressed.[cite: 580]

They are those who say you do not spend (i.e. 1/5th of the ghanim / profit) over those (believers) who are near the messenger of Allah until they break up. And for Allah are the treasures of the skies and the earth but the hypocrites do not understand.[cite: 580]

And the yahood / lenient / jews say, that hand of Allah is cuffed / tied up. Their hands are cuffed / tied and they are cursed with what they have said, but both His hands are outspread He spends how He wills. And what is revealed to you from your Lord definitely increases the majority amongst them in tyranny (i.e. unjustly harsh, cruel) and rejection. And We have put enmity and hatred amongst them towards the day of judgement. Whenever they (yahood / lenient /jews) ignite the fire for war, Allah extinguishes it and they make an effort in the earth to cause corruption. And Allah does not love those who are corrupt.[cite: 581]

And those (hypocrites) who hold on to a mosque to harm and to reject (i.e. Islam / to attain peace) and to make divisions between the believers and as an ambush (i.e. hidden place for sudden attack), for those (yahood / lenient / jews) who have been waging war from before against Allah and His messenger. And definitely they take oath we intended not but the best. And Allah witnesses that surely they are definite liars.[cite: 582]

You never ever stand in it. Definitely that mosque (i.e. Masjid-e-Haram / forbidden mosque) whose basis from the first day is on guard, it has more right that you stand in it. In it are men who love that they purify themselves. And Allah loves those who are purified ones.[cite: 582]
The first house placed for the people is that with Bakka a place of blessing and guidance for all worlds.[cite: 583]

And when We made the house a place of reward and safety for people, and you take from the standing place / position of (pbuh). And we covenanted / took a covenant with Ibraheem (pbuh) and Ismaeel (pbuh) that they should purify My house for those who go around and those who intent upon and those who bow, prostrate.[cite: 583]

Surely the reward of those who wage war against Allah and His messenger and they move around in the earth to cause corruption is that they will be killed, or they will be crucified, or their hands and feet will be cut off from the opposite sides or they will be exiled from the land. For them that is a disgrace in this world and in the hereafter is a great punishment for them.[cite: 584]

Except those who repented / turned from before you (i.e. believers) evaluate / gain power over them (by guiding them that how Allah has accepted their repentance). Then surely know that Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.[cite: 584]

And Moosa / Moses (pbuh) said, O' our Lord, surely You gave firoun / pharaoh and his chiefs / councils the adornment and wealth in this worldly life, O' our Lord so that they mislead about Your way. O' our Lord obliterate them on their wealth and make them rigid on their hearts, so they will not believe until they see the painful punishment.[cite: 585]
And without doubt Allah helped you with the full moon (completed victory) and you were humiliated, (to lower the self respect). So take guard of Allah that you may be thankful.[cite: 587]
points_notes_eng: Q1.What you have to say about the war of badr as mentioned in Aal-e-Imran 3:123?[cite: 587]

english_translation: When you said for the believers is it not sufficient that your Lord sends down three thousand angels to expand you.[cite: 587]
Nay if you have patience and take guard and they will come to you boiled over from this, your lord will expand you with five thousand from the marked angels.[cite: 587]
And Allah did not made it except good news for you and to give satisfaction to your hearts with it. And there is no help except from the nearness of Allah who is the Mighty, the Wise[cite: 587]

So When you meet those who reject, then strike the necks, until you are thick to them then tie (them) firmly. Then after that either He favors or either takes ransom until the war lays down its burdens. And if Allah wills He would have been victorious from them he some of you with some. And those who were being killed in the way of Allah then he will never astray their deeds / actions.[cite: 588]
points_notes_eng: Q2.Can you explain Surah Muhammad 47:4?[cite: 588]

english_translation: Soon He will guide them and He will correct their condition.[cite: 588]

So when the sacred / holy / forbidden months are ended (Ramazan, Shawwal, Zeeqad, Zilhij) then fight / kill (the self / soul / psyche of) the associates wherever you find them and catch them and confine them and sit on every place of ambush for them. So if they repent and establish salah / prayer and give zakah / justification so leave the way for them. Surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.[cite: 589]
points_notes_eng: Q3.Can you explain the killing mentioned in At-Tauba 9:5?[cite: 589]

english_translation: And if anyone from those who associates (with Allah) seek your neighborhood, until he listens words of Allah, then you deliver him to his place of security / safety. That is because they are the people who do not know.[cite: 589]

The months of hajj / pilgrimage are known (Shawwal, Zulqad, Zilhij) so whosoever impose hajj / pilgrimage (on himself) in them so he should not commit obscenity and do not take liberties (of the do's and dont's) and should not debate And what you do from betterment Allah knows it. And take provision, so surely the best of the provision is to take guard and take guard from Me O' you who possess the core (those who know the essence / spirit of ayaat / signs).[cite: 590]

Surely Allah has purchased from the believers their souls / selves / psyches and their wealth, with that garden is for them. They fight in the way of Allah then they kill (their souls / psyches) and get (their souls / psyches) killed. A promise on Him in truth in At-Taurah / the law and Al-Injeel / the good news and in Al-Quran / the reading. And who can fulfill with his promise than Allah, then rejoice with your deal that you bargained with Him. And that is the supreme achievement.[cite: 591]

And for them you prepare (i.e. in establishing the judgment of Allah that is Al-Islam / to attain peace) to what you have the capability from strength and from the bindings of the horses (i.e. to check your impulse and to remain calm) you terrorize with it to the enemies of Allah and your enemies and others besides them. You do not know them Allah knows them. And whatsoever you spend from anything in the way of Allah, you will be repaid in full and you will not be oppressed.[cite: 592]
points_notes_eng: Q4. Can you explain ayat / sign Al-Anfal 8:60?[cite: 592]

english_translation: And if they lower the wings for Islam / to attain peace so you also lower the wings for it and you trust on Allah. Surely He is the Listener, the Knowledgeable.[cite: 592]

Glory to Him (Allah) who traveled with His servant (Ar-rooh / the spirit) by night from Al-Masjid-e-Haraam / the forbidden Mosque to Al-Aqsa / the remotest mosque (distant in time, solitary / inconsiderable and isolated) whose surroundings We have blessed so that We show him from Our ayaat / signs. Surely He is the Listener, the One with an insight.[cite: 593]
points_notes_eng: Q5.In At-Tauba 9:107 you referred Masjid-e-Zarrar in Jerusalem where war is taking place. Then what is the status of Masjid-e-Aqsa mentioned in Al-Isra 17:1. Can you explain?[cite: 593]

english_translation: The first house being placed for people is that with Bakka, of blessing and guidance for all worlds.[cite: 593]

It is He who has revealed Al-kitab / the book over you. From it are muhkamat / governing ayaat / signs. These are the mother of Al-Kitab / the book and others are mutashabehat / resembling (ayaat / signs). So in whose hearts is deviation then they follow that resembles from it seeking its captivation and its interpretation and no one knows its interpretation except Allah. And those who are stable in knowledge they say, we believe with it all is from the nearness of our Lord. And no one remembers except those who possess the core. (i.e. innermost part of anything).[cite: 608]
And how can they govern you and At-taurah / the law is near them, in it is hukm / governance of Allah. Then after that they turn away. And they are not with the believers.[cite: 608]

Surely We have revealed At-taurah / the law (i.e. hukm / the governance of Allah containing all the governing ayaat / signs) in it is guidance and light, -nabeeyoon / the prophets who submitted govern with it for those who are hadoo / lenient / jews and Ar-rabba-neeoon / the lords and Al-ahbar / the scholars (govern with it), with what they were required to become the hafiz (i.e. those who memorize from the book of Allah), and they are witnesses over it. Then fear not mankind and fear Me and do not purchase My ayaat / signs with a little price. And who do not govern with what Allah has revealed, then they are the rejecters.[cite: 609]

And We have written in it (i.e. At-taurah / the law) on them, that is the soul is with the soul and an eye is with the eye and a nose is with the nose and an ear is with the ear and a tooth is with the tooth and there is a relation of the wounds (i.e. physical injuries or hurt of the feelings). So who gives charity with it then he has an atonement (i.e. amendment) is for him. And who does not govern with what Allah has revealed then they are the oppressors.[cite: 610]
And to those when the wrong reaches them they help themselves.[cite: 611]

And the reward of hurtness / badness is a hurtness / badness the likeness of it. Then whosoever pardoned / overlooked and corrected so his reward is on Allah. Surely He does not love the oppressors.[cite: 611]
And definitely whosoever help himself after he has been oppressed. Then they are those on whom there is nothing (wrong) from the way.[cite: 611]
Surely the (wrong) way is over those who oppress mankind and without truth they do wrong in the earth. They are those for whom is the painful punishment.[cite: 611]
And whosoever had patience and forgave, surely that is from the orders of determination. (In pardoning, correcting, forgiving and helping themselves with patience).[cite: 611]

And the goodness and the hurtness / badness are not even. Repel (badness) with what is good, then between you and between the one with whom you have enmity, surely he will be like the one who is a close protector.[cite: 612]
And none will receive it (i.e. goodness) except those who have patience. And none will receive it except who is a great fortunate one.[cite: 612]

Whosoever comes with the goodness then for him are ten (good nesses) like it. And whosoever comes wit the badness then he will not be rewarded except the likeness of it, and they will not be oppressed.[cite: 612]
And when We took a covenant that you do not shed your blood and do not expel your souls / selves from your circles then you affirmed and you are witnessing.[cite: 613]

And you do not kill the self / soul / psyche which Allah has forbidden except with the truth. And whosoever has been killed (physically) oppressively so without doubt We made for his protector an authority, so let him not exceed in killing. Surely he is being helped.[cite: 613]
The truth is from your Lord, then you do not be from the doubtful ones.[cite: 613]

O' you who believe! The requital / compensation in the killing / murdering has been written over you. That the free / liberated man is with the free / liberated man, and the slave is with the slave, and the female is with the female. Then something is (to be paid / given) for the one who is pardoned from his brother. Then he should follow with acknowledgment and let the payment to him be with goodness (ie to his brother( That is lightening / reduction and a mercy from your Lord. After that whosoever transgresses then for him is the painful punishment.[cite: 616]

And it is not for a believer that he kills a believer except by mistake then he should liberate / free a believing slave, and pay flawlessly / uncontested blood money towards his family, except that they give charity (by forgiving). Then if he is from the people who are your enemy and he was a believer. Then he should liberate / free a believing slave. And if he is from the people wherewith between you and between them there is a covenant. Then pay flawlessly / uncontested blood money towards his family. And he should liberate / free a believing slave. Then whosoever does not find (this) then two months of fasting consecutively / continuously. A way of returning / repentance from Allah. And Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise.[cite: 617]

And whosoever kills a believer intentionally / purposely, then his reward is hell, he will remain in it forever and the wrath / anger and curse of Allah is on him and He has prepared a great punishment for him.[cite: 618]
And for you there is a life in the requital / compensation O' the men of understanding! So that you may take guard. (i.e. those who understand the innermost part / essence of anything).[cite: 618]

And recite the prophecy in truth over them of the two sons of Adam (pbuh). When they both gave sacrifice to be close (to Allah) then it was accepted from one of them and was not accepted from the other. He said I will definitely kill you. He said surely Allah accepts (the sacrifice) from those who take guard.[cite: 621]
Definitely if you stretch out your hand towards me to kill me, I am not the one to stretch out my hand towards you to kill you. Surely I fear Allah the Lord of the worlds.[cite: 621]
Surely I intend that you reside with my sin (in killing me) and with your sin. So you will be from the companions of fire. And that is the reward of the oppressors.[cite: 622]
So his soul led him to volunteer in killing his brother then he killed him. So his morning was from the lost ones.[cite: 622]

Then Allah appointed a crow who discusses in the earth (by crowing i.e. utter characteristics of a cry) so that he can show him how to put behind the hurtness / badness of his brother, he said, woe to me, that I was incapable to be the likeness of this crow so that I would have put behind the hurtness / badness of my brother. Then his morning was from those who were regretful / remorseful.[cite: 622]

From that time We have written over the children of Israel that surely whosoever kills that soul / self / psyche (who has sacrificed and attained the closeness of Allah) is without a soul / self / psyche (i.e. innocent) or is without causing corruption on the earth then surely it is like the one who has killed mankind altogether. And whosoever (has sacrificed and attained the closeness of Allah) gives life to her (i.e. soul / self / psyche) then surely it is like the one who gives life to mankind altogether. And without doubt there has come to them Our messengers with clarifications. Then after that surely majority from them are those who exceed (in killing) in the earth.[cite: 623]
And when he (Moosa pbuh) attained maturity to his full strength, We gave him governance and knowledge. And likewise We reward those who are good doers.[cite: 623]

And when he (Moosa pbuh) entered Al-Madina / the city at a time when its people were inattentive then he found two men fighting in it. One was from his sect i.e. believer) and the other one from his enemy (non believer). So the one from his sect seek his aid over the one from his enemy. Then Moosa (pbuh) struck him with a fist. So he ended (his life) over him. He said, this is from the work of shaitaan / satan. Surely he is a clear enemy, the one who misleads.[cite: 624]
He said, My Lord surely I have oppressed my soul / self / psyche so have forgiveness for me. Then He forgave him. Surely He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.[cite: 624]
And I do not acquit / free from my soul / self / psyche. definitely orders with hurtness / badness except on whom my Lord had mercy. Surely my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.[cite: 624]

And the one of the whale (i.e. Yunus pbuh) when he went away in anger, so he assume that We will not evaluate / be powerful on him. Then he called in the darkness that there is no one except You, glory to You. Surely I was from the oppressors.[cite: 625]

O' my Lord, forgive for me and for my parents and for those who entered in my house as a believer and for the believing men and the believing women. And you do not increase the oppressors except in destruction.[cite: 625]
And from them are who say O' our Lord, give us in the world good and in the hereafter good and save us from the punishment of fire.[cite: 625]

It is He who has revealed Al-Kitab / the book over you. From it are muhkamat / governing ayaat / signs. These are the mother of Al-Kitab / the book and others are mutashabehat / resembling (ayaat / signs)..[cite: 627]
points_notes_eng: Q1. You mentioned in your lecture that taurah is the law which is the mother of the book containing mohkamat / governing ayaat / signs. What about the mutashabihat / resembling ayaat / signs? Can you clarify from the Quran?[cite: 627]

english_translation: Allah has revealed the most beautiful hadith / the event a book mutashabiha / resembling, repeating itself. Those who fear from their Lord their skins shiver from it. Then their skin and their hearts soften towards the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah. He guides whom He wills with it. And to whom Allah leaves astray so for him there is no one who can guide.[cite: 627]
points_notes_eng: Q1. You mentioned in your lecture that taurah is the law which is the mother of the book containing mohkamat / governing ayaat / signs. What about the mutashabihat / resembling ayaat / signs? Can you clarify from the Quran?[cite: 627]

english_translation: Ramazan is that month in which Al-Quran / the reading has been revealed as a guide for mankind, and the clarification from the guidance and from the criterion, so from you whosoever witnessed that month then he should fast in it. Those who are sick or on a journey then counting / numbering is from the other days. Allah intends easiness for you, and He does not intend any difficulty for you, that you may complete the counting, and so that he greaten Allah over what He guided you, and that you may be thankful.[cite: 628]

And those from your women who comes with obscenity then take four witnesses from you on them, then if they bear witness so detain / hold them in the houses until the death is complete on them or Allah makes a way (of guidance) for them.[cite: 629]
points_notes_eng: Q2. We have heard that the punishment of an adulterer, adulteress and homosexuals is stoning to death. What the Quran says about them?[cite: 629]

english_translation: And from you if two men comes, (with obscenity) hurt both of them. So if they both repent and correct so avoid (to hurt) both of them. Surely Allah is Returning, Merciful.[cite: 629]
points_notes_eng: Q2. We have heard that the punishment of an adulterer, adulteress and homosexuals is stoning to death. What the Quran says about them?[cite: 629]

english_translation: And you do not go near the fornication, surely that s an obscenity and a way to badness.[cite: 630]

Then lash the fornicatress and the fornicator each one from them (with) hundreds stripes, and the pity do not take hold of you with them in the judgement of Allah if you believe with Allah and the last day. And a party from the believers should witness their punishment.[cite: 630]

The fornicator does not marry except a fornicatress or a woman who associates (with Allah). And the fornicatress does not marry except a fornicator or a man who associates (with Allah). And that is being unlawful / forbidden over the believers.[cite: 631]

They take an oath with Allah that they said nothing and without doubt they said a word of rejection / blaspheme and they rejected after they accepted Islam / to attain peace. And they were interested with what they can never attained to. And they did not revenge except that Allah and His messenger enriched them from His bounty. So if they repent, it will be better for them. And if they turn away Allah will punish them in this world and in the hereafter with a painful punishment. And on the earth there will be no one from the protector and helper for them.[cite: 634]
points_notes_eng: Q3. What the Quran says about the death penalty of the believer who blasphemes and becomes a rejecter?[cite: 634]

english_translation: And from them are those who hurt the prophet and they say He is (all) ears. Say his ears are for your betterment. He believes with Allah and for he believes the believers and a mercy for those who believe from them. And those who hurt the messenger of Allah for them is painful punishment.[cite: 636]
points_notes_eng: Q4. What the Quran says about the death penalty to the one who blaspheme, hurt or kills the prophets of Allah?[cite: 636]

english_translation: Or they say with him is madness. But he came to them with the truth and majority of them have a disliking for the truth.[cite: 636]
And when those who rejected planned for you that they bind / fix you or they kill you or they expel you out. And they plan and Allah plans. And Allah is the best of the planners.[cite: 637]

Surely those who reject with ayaat / signs of Allah and they kill the prophets without truth. And they kill those from the people who order with justice. Then give good news to them with the painful punishment.[cite: 637]
With the blessing of your Lord you are not with those who are mad.[cite: 638]
And have patience over what they say and leave / migrate from them leaving / migrating beautifully.[cite: 638]

Say, He has power to appoint over you a punishment from above you or below your feet or clothe you into sects and makes you to taste the misery of one another. See how We inflect the ayaat / signs (i.e. systematic description of processes in a language) so that they may understand.[cite: 639]
points_notes_eng: Q5.If the believers are not allowed to retaliate or to take revenge against a killer. Then how can the killer hold accountable for his killing?[cite: 639]

english_translation: Surely the reward of those who wage war against Allah and His messenger and they move around in the earth to cause corruption, is that they will be killed, or they will be crucified, or their hands and feet will be cut off from the opposite sides or they will be exiled from the land. For them that is a disgrace in this world and in the hereafter is a great punishment for them.[cite: 639]

Except those who repented / turned from before you (i.e. believers) evaluate / gain power over them (by guiding them that how Allah has accepted their repentance). Then surely know that Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.[cite: 640]

Surely those who are divided in their judgement and become a sect you had no concern from them in anything. Surely their order is towards Allah. Then He will prophesies / inform them with what they were doing.[cite: 640]

O' you who believe! Seek answer / response for Allah and for the messenger. When you are called for that He will give you life. And know that Allah comes between the man and his heart and surely you will be gathered towards Him.[cite: 641]
points_notes_eng: Q6. How can one person gives the life to another person which is like the giving of life to all mankind? Can you clarify?[cite: 641]

english_translation: Is he who was dead so We gave him life and We made light for him. He walks with it in the people. Is he an example of him who is in darkness and will never come out from it. Likewise for the rejecters it is being decorated what they were doing.[cite: 641]

And likewise from Our order We have inspired rooh / spirit towards you. You did not have the perception what was the book and the belief, but We have made it (rooh / spirit) a light We guide from Our servants with it (rooh / spirit) to whom We will. And surely you (bashar) guide towards the straight path.[cite: 642]

Whosoever does correction, from male or a female and he is a believer then We will give him life, a good life. And definitely We will reward them their wages with the best that they were doing.[cite: 642]

Surely Allah has purchased from the believers their souls / selves / psyches and their wealth, with that garden is for them. They fight in the way of Allah then they kill (their souls / selves / psyches) and get (their souls / psyches) killed. A promise on Him in truth in At-taurah / the law and Al-injeel / the good news and in Al-Quran / the reading. And who can fulfill with his promise than Allah, then rejoice with your deal that you bargained with Him. And that is the supreme achievement.[cite: 643]
And whosoever is dim-sighted about the remembrance of the most Gracious, We barter for him a shaitaan / satan so he will be connected for him.[cite: 655]
And they will definitely oppose them about the way and they calculate that they are the guided ones.[cite: 655]
And without doubt We created human We know what psyche whispers with it and We are nearer / closer towards him from his jugular vein (which carries deoxygenated blood to the heart).[cite: 655]
And I do not acquit / free my soul / self / psyche orders with / psyche hurtness / badness except on whom my Lord did mercy. Surely my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.[cite: 655]
And no, I swear with the soul / self / psyche of blaming (herself or others).[cite: 656]
O' the satisfied soul / self / psyche.[cite: 656]
Return to your Lord pleased, pleasing.[cite: 656]
So enter in My servants.[cite: 656]
And enter My garden.[cite: 656]

And definitely We will test / try you with something from the fear and hunger and loss from the wealth and the souls / selves / psyches and the fruits. And give good news to those who are patient / perseverant.[cite: 657]
Those to whom when calamity reaches, they say surely we are for Allah and surely towards Him we are returner.[cite: 657]
They are those on whom are prayers and a mercy from their Lord. And they are those who are guided.[cite: 657]
Nothing reaches from calamity in the earth and nor in your souls / selves / psyches except it is in a book from before that We release / set b it free. Surely that is easy over Allah.[cite: 657]
So that you do not grieve over what passed / slipped away from you and you do not rejoice with what He gave you. And Allah does not love every deceitful, boastful.[cite: 657]
And definitely if We made the mankind to taste the mercy from Us, then We removed it from him, surely he is despairing / hopeless, rejecter.[cite: 658]
And definitely if We made him to taste the blessing after harm touched him, definitely he will say that the hurtness / badness went away from me. Surely he is rejoiceful, boastful.[cite: 658]
Except those who have patience and did corrections. They are those, for them is forgiveness and a great wage / reward.[cite: 658]
And you do not weaken / loose (hope) and you do not grieve and you will be higher class if you are believers.[cite: 659]

If a wound touches you so without doubt a wound has touched people with the likeness of it. And these are the days We give in turns between mankind, and so that Allah knows those who believe and He takes witnesses from you. And Allah does not love the oppressors.[cite: 659]
Those who sought / seek out an answer / responded for Allah and the Messenger from after the wound reached them, among them for those who do good and take guard have a great reward.[cite: 659]

And the shaitaan / satan said when the order has been completed, surely Allah promised you the promise of truth and I promised you then I opposed you and it was not for me from the authority over you except to call you, so you sought / seek out / answered for me, so you do not blame me and blame your souls / selves / psyches. I am not with your screams and you are not with my screams. Surely I reject with what you were associating me from before. Surely a painful punishment is for the oppressors.[cite: 660]
And without doubt you were wishing for death from before that you meet it. So without doubt you had seen it and you are viewing it.[cite: 661]

Whosoever suspects / assumes that Allah will never help him in the world and the hereafter. So he should expand with the means towards the sky. Then he should cut off, then he should view if his machination takes away that which enrages him.[cite: 661]

Wherever you are the death will perceive / catch you and even if you were in erected / lofty towers. And if goodness reaches them they say this is from the nearness of Allah. And if hurt / badness reaches them, they say this is from your nearness. Say all are from the nearness of Allah. Then what is for these people that they are not near enough to understand any event / narration.[cite: 662]

Whatever reaches you from goodness then it is from Allah. And whatever reaches you from hurt / badness, then it is from your soul / self / psyche. And We sent you as a messenger for the mankind. And he is enough as a witness with Allah.[cite: 662]

And We did not send from any messenger except to be obeyed with the permission of Allah. And if surely when they oppressed their souls / selves / psyches, they had come to you then they had sought forgiveness of Allah, and the Messenger would have sought forgiveness for them, definitely they would have found Allah Returning, Merciful.[cite: 663]

If you do not help him (i.e the companion) so without doubt Allah helped him when those who rejected expelled him, when they were in the hollow / sinking (condition of the heart). When he the second of the two (i.e the messenger) said to his companion, you do not grieve surely Allah is with us. Then Allah sent down His tranquility / calmness on him and strengthen him with forces you can not see them. And He made the word of those who rejected lower and the word of Allah is that which is higher. And Allah is Mighty, Wise.[cite: 664]

And when My servants ask you about Me, so surely I am near. I answer the call of the caller when he calls. Then they should seek answer / respond for Me and should believe with Me that they may become sober.[cite: 665]
And when your Lord said call Me, I will answer / respond for you. Surely those who seek greatness about serving Me. Soon they will enter hell degraded / lowly.[cite: 665]

O' you who believe! Seek answer / respond for Allah and for the Messenger when He calls you for that He will give you life. And know that Allah surrounds between the man and his heart and surely He is the One towards Whom you will be gathered.[cite: 666]

Whosoever does correction, from male or a female and he is a believer then surely We will give him life, a good life. And definitely We will reward them their wages with the best that they were doing.[cite: 666]

And is that who is dead, so We gave him life and We made light for him, he walks with it in mankind, like that whose example is in darkness, never to come out from it. Likewise We adorned for the rejecters what they were doing.[cite: 667]

Surely the (acceptance of) repentance is over Allah for those who do badness / hurtness with ignorance then they repent from nearness. Then they are those on whom Allah returns (accept repentance). And Allah is Knowledgeable, Wise.b[cite: 667]

And there is no repentance for those who do badness / hurtness until when death presents to anyone of them, he says, surely now I repent. And it is not for those who die and they were rejecters. They are those for whom We have prepared a painful punishment.[cite: 668]

Say O' my servants! Those who exceed over their souls / selves / psyches you do not despair from the mercy of Allah. Surely Allah forgives all guilts together. Surely He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.[cite: 668]
And deputize towards your Lord and submit for Him from before the punishment comes to you then you will not be helped.[cite: 668]
And follow the best of what has been revealed towards you from your Lord, from before that the punishment comes to you suddenly and you are not conscious.[cite: 669]
That a soul / self / psyche says, O' alas / sigh to me for what I neglected / wasted in taking side of Allah and I was definitely from those who mocked.[cite: 669]
Or she would say, surely if Allah had guided me definitely I would have been from those who take guard.[cite: 669]
Or she would say at the time when she sees the punishment, surely if I had another chance for me then I will be from those who are good doers.[cite: 669]
But of course without doubt came to you My ayaat / signs, then you belied with it. And you sought greatness and you were from the rejecters.[cite: 670]
And on the day of judgement you will see those who belied over Allah, their faces blackened. Is it not in hell a dwelling for those who are proud / haughty.[cite: 670]

Surely those who say our Lord is Allah then they are steadfast the angels descend on them that you do not fear and you do not grieve and have the good news of the garden that you were promised.[cite: 670]
We are your aulia / protectors in the worldly life and in the hereafter, and in it for you what your souls / selves / psyches desire and in it for you what you call / ask for.[cite: 671]
A revelation from a Forgiver, Merciful.[cite: 671]
Those who believe and their hearts get satisfy with the remembrance of Allah. Do not the hearts get satisfy with the remembrance of Allah? b[cite: 671]
Those who believe and do corrections, goodness is for them and a beautiful place of return.[cite: 671]
O' the satisfied soul / self / psyche.[cite: 672]
Return to your Lord pleased, pleasing[cite: 672]
